26.instruction: Okay, now you are in a room facing towards two bathtubs, one on the right side and the other on the left side. Now turn to your left and slightly move forward. Now you are standing on the second step with white bathtub on the left side and this is the end point.

27.instruction: You are currently facing towards a bathtub which is in the centre of a room, turn to your left, take a few steps forward, now turn to your right and you can see a couple of steps, climb them and move towards the white bathtub on the left. Now you can see a couple of more stairs, climb up. Move a few steps forward and you can see a white bathtub on your left and you are facing a glass window, that is your end point.

106.instruction: You are standing in between a counter on your right and laundry machines on your left, turn around and exit the laundry room, straight ahead, once you exit laundry room, turn right and move a little bit straight ahead towards the window in front of you, turn right when you are near the window and turn right go downstairs, once you are at the middle landing you are done.

259.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn around and move out of this room. Turn right and move towards the open door. Turn slight right and move towards the painting. You are facing towards the long sofa, which is your final destination.

Walk towards the sliding door and stop near the sofa in front of you to the right side. That is the end point.

354.instruction: Begin in front of an arched entrance. Head into that. In front of you will be a set of curtains. Turn right through another arched entrance. Once you get to the 2nd platform by the window you've arrived.

453.instruction: Standing in the middle of the stairs, walk up the stairs. Once you reach the top of the stairs, take a left and continue walking up the next flight of stairs. Once you're just before the top of the spiral staircase, four stairs down from the top, stop, because you've reached your final destination.

655.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a door. Turn left and move forward, you have a sink in front of you. Move forward towards that sink and this is your final point.

656.instruction: Now you are facing to the door. Turn to your left, move forward you can see two washbasins move towards it and stop.

784.instruction: `Begin facing a pool table. Pass it and head down it. At the end of it you'll reach a multi coloured wall. Turn left and head into the bedroom. Head to the fuzzy chair then turn right and head into the bathroom and you're done

831.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the wall. Turn around, and move forward, you can see the bed in front of you. Now enter in to that room, and move forward until, you reach the window in front of you. Now, you have reached your destination."

832.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn left and move forward. Turn slight right and move towards the open door which is near the sofa. Now turn right and move towards the white chair which is opposite to you. Turn slight right and move towards the open door. Now you can see open door to your left. Move towards that door. Enter into the room. Now move towards the sofa. Now you can see 1 on the window. The position you are standing is your final destination.

894.instruction: You are facing towards the open glass door, turn right and enter the living room, through the open door. Turn slight right and move towards the open glass door, which is in front of you. You are now standing at the entrance of the open glass door, facing towards the swimming pool, which is your end point.

895.instruction: You are facing towards a glass door, turn around and there is an open door right in front of you, enter through it and move forward. You can see a huge couch on your left side, walk straight until you reach the open glass door. You are now standing just before the entrance of an open glass door and facing towards a pool and this is your end point.

911.instruction: Our starting point is in a bedroom, on your right there's a bed covered with white and yellow sheets and on the left there's a window. Turn left and exit the room. In front of you there's a wooden door, walk towards the wooden door and then turn right... We're looking at a long hallway and on the left there are five pictures on the wall, walk pass the five pictures... On your right there's an open door, and on your left there's a bedroom, walk towards the bedroom, turn left and walk towards the edge of the bed, turn around... You're now facing a short hallway, walk towards the hallway, in front of you there's the bathroom, walk towards the bathroom, your destination is near the sink.

938.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, slightly turn right and get down the stairs, go forward towards the round table which is having chairs around it, slightly turn right and go forward towards the arch, slightly turn left and pass through the arch, slightly turn right and go forward towards the opened brown door, turn right and go one step forward, turn left and go forward towards the closed brown door, turn right and go one step forward, go forward, turn left and go forward towards the opened brown door, turn right and go one step forward, go forward, turn left and go forward, go forward, turn left and go forward until you reach the wall, here facing towards the wall you have reached the destination.

939.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the wall. Turn to your right and get down the stairs. Turn slightly towards your right and go towards the round table. Turn towards the right and enter the arch. Turn slightly towards the left and go into the corridor. Turn slightly to right and exit the door, at this point there are two cars in front of you. Turn to your left and go forward towards the closed wooden door. Turn to your right and go forward till you reach the wall. Turn to your left and go outside the room, go forward till you reach a few wooden cardboard's which are in front of you. Turn to your left and go forward till you reach a platform and there is TV on your left. Turn to your left and go forward till you reach the wall, at this point you have reached your destination.

1138.instruction: We are in a very rustic bedroom. Facing the bed, let's walk to the left and walk in front of the bed and exit the door that's on our left. Once out we will walk to the left towards the pool table. Leaving the pool table on our right, let's continue walking forward towards the wall and stairs heading down. Let's go down, all the way down to the checker-board flooring and go left. Stopping at that large family table, we will go to our left towards the head of it. Once we are at the head of it, facing the refrigerator we are going to our right about 45 degrees to stand in front of the cabinet. We've reached our destination. In front of us on the counter you'll see a block of knives and a crockpot. Done!

1205.instruction: Facing the couch, with the TV on the left and the coffee table straight ahead, turn 180 degrees and exit the room. Go inside the room, take a left into the bathroom. Once in the bathroom, turn 180 degrees and head back, not straight but veer right into the open area just to the left of where you came out of and to the right of the small area between the bar. To the right you'll see a glass dining room table with 7, 8 white chairs around it. To the left 3 bar stools and in front of you a TV on a translucent wall. Walk straight ahead with the TV and translucent wall on your left and the dining room chairs on your right. Once you're between the dining room chairs and the TV, you're done.

1311.instruction: Exit from the bedroom which you are currently in. Turn towards left and then walk towards the door which is in front of you. Enter the room and turn towards right and reach the sink. Now you could see western toilet, walk towards it and stop there.

1312.instruction: You are facing towards the open door, slightly turn right and exit the room and take an immediate left, walk through the narrow passage till you find an open door in front, enter into that room, and take right you can find a bed walk straight, and there is an open door towards washroom enter into it, there is a seat in front you can find your destination above the seat.

1410.instruction: You begin in a corner next to some kind of machine that looks like something a dentist would use. Turn to your right and move to the door with a swoosh on it. Step through that door, and once you're outside you're going to continue directly across into the hallway opposite. Keep going through that hallway, making the little adjustment to the left and then skirting around the glass square divider on your right. Once you're around that divider you're going to take a step down the hall next to the reception desk with two stools behind it. Once you are next to those two stools that are themselves next to a water cooler and the reception desk, you're done. You should just be right on level with those two kind of beige weird saddle-looking stools.

1446.instruction: Our starting point is in a sitting area, we're facing towards a glass door and towards two glass windows. Turn around, we're facing towards a hall, on the left there are two open doors and on the right there are two open doors as well, walk towards the second open door on the left, enter the room in that's in front of you, and that's your destination.

1574.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn right and exit the room, move a bit forward, now you are facing towards a cabinet, that would be your end point.

1575.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn right. Walk a few steps ahead and stand beside the wall towards your right side. There is a cabinet towards your left side. You have reached your point.

1648.instruction: You are in a small room facing the table, move towards it, turn left side, walk straight and climb up the steps, enter the room on the right side, turn right side and stand in front of the easel beside the couch, turn left side and stand in between the two couches and the table, that is your destination.

1649.instruction: You are facing towards the door, turn slight left and move out of the room. Turn left you can see a narrow pathway, move in the path till you reach the staircase. Climb up the staircase completely. Now you are standing in between the 2 open doors which is to your and which is to your right. Turn right and move towards the carpet which is in front of you. You are facing towards the windows, turn right and move towards the painting. Turn left and move towards the single seat sofa. Now you are facing towards the window and standing in front of the sofa, which is your final destination.

1669.instruction: You're currently looking into a whiteboard. Turn around, and face right. Take a step forward to the wooden desk, passing the double glass doors on your left. Turn slightly to the right. Take a step forward to the wooden news stand, holding a pile books. Turn around, and face right. Take a step forward, passing a long tan table with a potted plant on top. Take another step forward, keeping that long tan desk to the right of you. Slightly in front of you, you see a white bookshelf. Take two steps forward, passing the white bookshelf on your left. Now, turn around and face right. You see a white computer desktop on a tan desk. Take a step forward to your left. Once you're standing slightly in front of, to the left of a black computer chair connected to a tan desk with a silver computer desktop on top of it, you're done.

1790.instruction: Begin in an office. Head through the door by the bookshelf and stop when you're to the left of the printer.

1904.instruction: Now you are facing the dinning table, from there take a left turn search for the chair which is placed in the corner and go near to the chair. From there, take a right turn start walking straight until you find a way to your left side, take a left turn search for the photo frame which is on the wall and stand in front of it.

1905.instruction: You are standing in front of the dining table, facing towards it, turn left and move towards the chair, which is in the corner of the room, now turn right and move forward towards the small stool, beside the wooden table, which has a lamp on it, turn left and move forward, here you can find the kitchen area onto your left, turn slight right and move forward towards the wooden cabinet and the portrait on the wall. You are now standing beside the chair, facing towards the portrait on the wall, which is your end point.

1959.instruction: You are now facing towards a portrait, turn slightly left and move forward. You can see three steps, climb up the steps. Now turn to your right and enter through the open door. Turn right and move forward. You are now standing facing towards a shelf and this is your end point.

1960.instruction: You are facing towards the photo frame and the wall. Turn slightly left and move forward, and stop at the starting point of the stairs where in you need to take slightly right and move towards the brown colour sofa which has a table in front of it and there are also books on the table, with a lamp on it. Stop at the corner of the room. You are facing towards the cupboard which basically contains photo frames and also some books, and this is your end point.

2084.instruction: You're standing beside the door, go few steps forward, and exit the room, then go straight along the glass doors, at the end, you'll find ash chairs, and tables, from there turn left, and enter the room, go near the wall, then turn left, to the left you'll find brown table, and black chairs, two steps away from the right corner, opposite to the table, you'll find your destination.

2085.instruction: You are facing towards the glass door, slightly take left and exit the room through an open glass door, move forward, there is a pillar at the right side and a sofa in front, take left and enter into the entrance through an open glass door, take right and walk straight towards the brown table with a chair, turn left and move forward, there is a flower pot on the white platform and a table with a chair at the left side, the position now you are standing is your destination.

2426.instruction: You're standing facing some wooden portraits that are hanging on the wall. Turn to the left and step towards the stone edge of the fireplace. Now walk in between it and the round dining tables and head int he direction of the wooden doorway with the off white curtains that will be on your right. oh and now take a small step inside this room and walk back out from the place you came and turn right into this wooden doorless doorway and into a small hall. You will see a pink stalled restroom and an open door at the end of the hall on the right. Which turns out to be a men's restroom. Stop at the entrance of it and for reference, there will be a fire extinguisher on the wall next to you. You're done.

2438.instruction: You are facing a vanity which has towels and lilies in a vase. Walk towards the go near the end of this room and enter a closet in front of you. Turn left from this closet. And exit and enter the open door which will take you inside a hall way where their are hanging lights black lights on your right and a railing and on your left their will be another room with brown furniture. Go across this hall way. Crossing the stairs on your left. Going towards the open door on your left. Enter this room which has camel color carpet and white furniture with blue throw on the bed. Go near the washroom door and turn around now from this point go near the blue throw and this is where your destination ends.

2611.instruction: Facing the bathroom, take a left into the living room.

2715.instruction: You will start by facing an open doorway. Turn around and you will see a hallway. Walk towards the hallway where there's a painting on the wall. Once you're there, on your right you will see the kitchen. Turn to your right and walk straight down. Standing in between the sink and the stove. Continue walking forward until you've reached the dining table. Once you're at the dining table, you will see on the right. There's a painting on the wall and another hallway on the right. Walk towards the hallway and when you're there, you will see a room. Walk inside the room. AS you can see there's a couch with purple or black cushions and the bed. Walk towards the right side of the bed and when you're at the right side of the bed, you will see on the right an open door. Walk inside the washroom, Standing at the right side of the bathtub. Keep walking all the way to the closet. Once you're in front of the closet, on your right you will see an area where it's all decorated with tiles. Small tiles. Walk inside that area and as you can see now in front of you is a shower area with black shower head and shower hose. Take another step forward until you're right underneath the shower head. Once you're there, you're done.

2771.instruction: We're going to start in a room that has a very long brown table. If we look directly to the left of us we're going to see an open door. so we're going to walk towards that open door to be right in front of it. Then we'll see another open door directly in front of us. We're going to walk towards that open door until we're inside and it is a ladies bathroom. so we're going to walk inside the ladies bathroom. ON the left we'll see the sink and we'll see the bathroom stalls right in front of us. and we're going to go ahead and walk inside the opened bathroom stall. once we reached the opened bathroom stall we'll notice the small window right in front of us with the toilet to the left of us. And we will stop inside this bathroom stall

2808.instruction: You are facing towards the wall and the wooden cabinet. Turn left and there is an open room in front of you. Enter into the open room. Now you are standing at the entrance of a washroom facing towards the towel hanger. That will be the end point.

2809.instruction: Okay, Right know your in a position where you can see a table and to your left there is a wall, Now turn left and after that turn slight left where you can see a door, enter the door, then you will reach your destination.

2872.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the pillar turn slightly right and keep moving in a forward direction where you can see an open entrance in the opposite to you enter in the open entrance. Then turn slightly right and move forward, then turn slightly left and move forward. Again turn slightly right and move forward towards the living area and the wooden table in the middle. Now turn slightly left you can see a door which is opened enter the room through it now turn slightly right you can see a white chair. Go and stand near the chair in the middle of the room, you have reached you're destination point.

2873.instruction: You are facing towards the wooden pillar. Slightly turn right and walk straight till you reach the open entrance in the front. Stand near the entrance and turn right. Slightly turn left and enter into the room in the front. Slightly turn right. There is a table and two chairs in the front. Walk straight and stand in front of the table. You have reached your point.

3019.instruction: You're looking at a picture of a dog, turn to the left. And go down this hallway past the picture of the zebra. And turn left and go through the doorway with the white open door. And then take through this doorway that's across from the mirror on the right. And take one step into this closet and you're done.

3021.instruction: Look around there is grand staircase in a huge house. We will head towards the room that's in front of us with the piano, leaving the two statues on our left. Head towards that piano, stepping on the carpet. Continuing forward towards that piano, with the chairs and table on our left. We will walk towards the glass doors, stopping before we exit. Standing with the doors directly in front of us looking outside to another set of table and chairs, but staying indoors on the carpet. We have reached our destination.

3205.instruction: You are in the bedroom and standing in front of the open door, now exit the room. Turn left and move towards the brown color pillar which is in front of you. Turn slight right you can see a narrow pathway, move in the path until you see an closed door which is opposite to you. Turn slight right you can see an open door which is next to the closed door, now move towards the open door. Now you are standing next to the door turn slight right, now move towards open glass door which is to your left. Turn slight left and move towards the small glass round table which is in front of you. Now you are standing in between the two chairs and facing towards the open lawn, which is your final destination.

3206.instruction: From the point your standing move forward and turn slightly right. Go near to the pillar which is at your opposite from their turn slightly right and keep moving in a forward direction. Go towards the exit door which is at your opposite, and now turn slightly right, and enter into the bedroom which is at your right side. Now move through the left where there is an opened glass door enter into the balcony that will be your final destination point.

3214.instruction: You will start by facing a dining table. Take a step forward. Turn right jump over the chair at the head of the table towards the fireplace. Turn left take a step forward and turn right once again. Exit this room through the french doors on your right. You will see a tiny pool in front of you. To your right there's another french doors walk towards that. Enter the room and stand behind the white arm chair on the right. You will see an opening on your right. Walk towards the opening. Continue to walk down the hallway. You will walk past a bunch of openings and once you're facing an opening in front of you. Turn right take a step towards the sink don't go inside just stand on the doorway. Turn right once again. Continue to walk forward you will see an opening with white carpet. Continue to walk forward towards the large plant. Once you're facing the large plant, turn right you will see the french doors take a step outside and you're done.

3234.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn around and move forward. You are now standing in front of a glass cabin and on your right side you have a table with a computer. You can see a table with a black chair right in front of you. Walk between these two tables and move forward. Now you can see a table with orange chair on your right side. Move forward towards the centre table which is right in front of a couch and that is your end point.

3235.instruction: You're standing beside brown color table, from there go few steps forward, then turn left, then go straight till the end, go near whit color sofa, below it you'll find a table there you'll find your destination.

3281.instruction: Our starting point is in a living room, on your right there's a wood door and on your left there's a white chair, and in front of you there's an exit door, walk towards the exit door, and that's your destination.

3387.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing and exit from the door. Now turn left and go straight near the wall. Now turn right and go straight. Now slightly turn left and go straight near the beds. Now move a step forward. Now slightly turn right. You will find an open door. Now exit from the door and keep moving forward. You will find stair case. Now go straight. Right now you are in front of the large portrait. That will be your final destination.

3388.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn left and move forward, again turn left then turn right and move forward, move towards the bed, again move forward then turn right and move towards the open door move forward, move forward towards the stairs, move forward towards the curtain and stand, this is your final destination.

3561.instruction: You're standing in a living room. On the left you can see a blue sofa with a picture above it. If you turn around you'll see two double doors that are white that are open. Walk through this doorway. You'll be standing in front of two white chairs. To your left you'll see a white sofa, walk towards this white sofa. To your left you'll see a large opening to another room and a white table in the middle. Walk towards this white table. And look towards the left you can see a white bench with some pillows on it, walk towards this bench. And to the left you'll see a door that's open walk towards this door. And to the right you'll see a stairway, go up the first two stairs. Once you're standing on the first two stairs you've reached the end.

3899.instruction: Right now you're facing towards the windows. Turn left and exit the room. Now slightly turn left and walk in the passage till you reach a wall. Now, slightly turn and you can see a staircase. Walk all the way down through the stairs. Now, you can see a brown cupboard in front of you, move towards that brown cupboard. Now, turn right and you can see a white cupboard with few shelves in front of you. Move towards that white cupboard and that is the end point.

3900.instruction: You're standing near the window. Turn left, move forward and exit through the open door. Again turn left and move forward towards the stairs. Walk all the way down to the stairs. Now move forward towards the computer table. Turn right and walk behind the couch. Go stand near the white cupboard. This would be your end point.

3934.instruction: You are facing a bedroom, turn around and now you should be facing two chairs on the wall and straight ahead their is a kitchen with blue cabinets and the steel oven and the blue cabinets looking outside at the rocks turn right and move towards the same area with the chairs on the wall. Once you are standing next to the black chairs look straight ahead more towards the black chairs their is an opening to go outside. do not go outside just go near and stand. Once you are standing near the open door just at the back door you should see a room or another door at the back of it  and walk towards that and now you should be standing near a desk and  at the back of the brown chairs, when you are standing at the chair turn right and now you should be standing near the foot of the bed, once you are here you are done.

4025.instruction: We're in a patio, and we;re facing towards some pillars... Turn towards the left... On your left there's a cabinet and on your right there's a handrail, walk past that handrail towards the console table that's on the left, walk past that console table, and then walk towards the wall that's in front of you, once you reached the wall, once you reach the wall, turn towards the right, and you'll come across a hallway... On your right there's a mirror and on your left there's what appears to be a mirror as well, walk past those and walk past the archway that's in front of you... We're now facing towards an open door and on the left there's a lamp... Actually, we're facing towards an arch door and on the left there's the lamp, and on the right there's a room which has a billiard table in the middle, walk past those and.... Walk past the open door that's on the left, and stop right in front of a picture... of a movie scene, or something that says casino... Once you're facing that picture, turn around and enter the door that's on your right... You're now facing towards a home theatre, turn around and walk towards the room that's in front of you... On your right there's the billiard table and on your left there's a kitchen area, walk past the billiard table towards the room that's in front of you, walk past the glass doors, turn slightly to the left... On your right there's what appears to be arch doors, they are probably arch doors, walk towards the second door on your right, turn slightly to the left... On your left there's a grey sofa, take a few steps further... Walk towards the right side of the fireplace, once you're facing a small arch window, and once you have the TV on your left and the fireplace on your left, you have reached your destination.

4255.instruction: Now you are facing towards the cupboard where there is a washbasin on top of it, slide right and walk straight towards the wall, now slide left and exit the room, now again slide right towards the another open door, exit the door, walk straight, now slide left and walk straight towards the staircase, now walk down the steps, now slide left and move little bit forward, turn around, now slide left and walk straight towards the open glass door, enter into the room and stop at the middle of the room and you have reached your destination.

4256.instruction: You are in a washroom, facing towards a washbasin. Turn towards your right and keep moving forward. In front, you can find a white wall, walk towards that wall and turn towards your slight left. In front, you can find a white door, go pass through that door and turn towards your right. You can find an other white door. Go near that white door and turn towards your slight right. Keep moving forward and go pass through that door for few step and turn towards your left. In front, you can find a white wall, walk near that wall and towards your left, you can find a staircase. Get down the stairs, all the way to the ground floor. On the ground floor, you can find a white wall, which has a big painting hanging on it, in front of you. Turn around towards your left and move forward for few steps. Then, turn around towards your right and in front, you can find a glass door, go near that glass door and turn towards your slight left. Walk through that door and move forward for few steps. Stand there and you reached your destination.

4273.instruction: Okay, now you are facing towards the wall, slightly turn right and move a bit forward. Now slightly turn left and in front of you there are few stairs, go straight and stand on the second step from the bottom. Now in front of you there is an open entrance, go straight towards that open entrance. Now you are standing at the entrance of the store room, turn left and move a bit forward. Now you are standing in a room with an open entrance behind you and this is the end point.

4274.instruction: Now you are facing the wall, slightly turn right and climb down the stairs. Now move towards the open entrance, which is in front of you. Turn left and stop under the projector. This is the endpoint.

4376.instruction: Facing the bathtub, walk to the left towards the closed brown doors. Taking one step left, walk up the two stairs i front of you keeping the left end of the bathtub on your right and walk towards the white bathtub to the left. Once you're standing next to the kind of white bathtub to the left, you should see two stairs in front of you again and then two podiums and then another bathtub on the left, walk up to the podium on the left. Just before you reach it, stop. On your left should be a bathtub with a window above it, in front of you should be two podiums, one with a sink and one with something else. Once you're standing there, you're done.

4450.instruction: You begin in a bathroom looking towards a corner over a bathroom counter. Turn right and exit through the open door, then turn left and exit the bedroom through an open door. As soon as you're out of that door, you're done. Just standing in the threshold, you are done.

4558.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the wall. Turn to your left and move straight passing through the tables and chairs. Now, turn right where you can find an open white door in front of you. Pass through that door and turn to your left and move forward. You will find another white door in front of you. Enter through that door and take left and walk straight passing through the table and chairs and that will be your end point where you can see many tables and chairs in front of you in a big room.

4559.instruction: "Now you are facing towards the wall, turn towards your left, walk forward at the dead end, you can see a door, exit from it, turn left, walk straight you can see another door, exit from it, walk forward, towards black chair and turn left, move forward go near the second table, where you can find black chairs towards the corner, go and stand near the black chairs."

Move to the right in between the desk to your left and the leather arm chair to your right move in between both sets of furniture and make your way to the wall that has that shredder. Stand in front of that shredder and you are done.

7631.instruction: For your start point you are facing an entry way that leads into a massage room. Turn around and you will see another massage room directly in front of you. Move forward through that open doorway you will see a white massage table that has a black and white checkered throw. Turn to the right and just walk to the end of that massage table. You will be at the foot of the table in the corner facing a tiled wall to your left and a floral wall to your right, and your done.

7663.instruction: Right now you are in front of the shoe shelf. Now slightly turn left and go straight. Now turn right and step out of the room. Now turn left and go straight. On the right side you will find gym equipment. That will be your final destination.

7664.instruction: Right now your facing towards the rack turn slightly left and move forward. Then turn right and keep moving forward, and turn left stand in front of the pillar, and that will be your final destination point.

7667.instruction: You are standing beside a glass window, go forward, here there is a carpet on to your left, go forward until you reach an opened brown door on to your right, slightly turn right and pass through the opened brown door, here facing towards the wall you have reached the destination.

7668.instruction: You are standing beside the big glass window, turn slight right, walk straight to the corner of the open wide arche. Walk straight until you reach an open door, on your right side, turn slight right, you are standing in-front of an open door, enter the wash room. You are facing towards the wall, which is your final destination.

7700.instruction: You are standing in a kitchen next to a counter top with a sink.  You will see a door on the left of you.  Right next to the door will be a shelf with pots and pans.  Exit that door.  You will come into a hallway.   You are going to veer to the right and go thru that door.  You will enter a long hallway.  You are going to make a left and enter a bathroom.  You are going to just step inside that bathroom next to the grey door and you are done.

7814.instruction: Turn right from the place where you're standing and move forward until you reach an opened door on the left side. Now, turn left and exit the room through that opened door. From here, turn left and walk in the passage till you reach a wooden wall in front of you. Now, turn right and you can see a staircase. Walk all the way down through the stairs and turn right. Now, you're facing towards a portrait. From here, turn right and move forward towards the narrow entrance. Enter into that entrance and that is the end point.

7815.instruction: You are in a bedroom, facing towards the wall. Turn right and move towards the open entrance, which is beside the TV, now turn left and move towards the open door, turn left and continue straight in the narrow path, continue straight towards the brown wall, from here turn right and get down the stairs, turn right and move towards the painting on the wall, from here turn right and move towards the second open entrance, from here turn slightly left and move towards the open door, this is your end point.

7878.instruction: We're facing towards an arch door, walk towards it, turn towards the right slightly and you'll come across a staircase, walk down the stairs, enter the narrow doorway that's in front of you, turn towards the left... After you reach an open door, walk into the bathroom that's in front of you, take one step towards the window, and that's your destination.

7948.instruction: Turn away opposite the toilet and face the T.V. and fireplace. Take one step towards the fireplace. Turn to the left and you will see an open door, walk through the open door. Keep walking straight onto the hardwood floor. Facing straight down the hardwood floor hallway, take a left and go up the stairs. Continue up the stairs all the way to the top. At the top you'll see a couch with an American flag on it, walk towards the couch and stay just to the right of the lamp. Turn right and you will see a fireplace with an American flag on the left hand side. Head down that left hand side staying to the left of the American flag, but to the right of the chair. Walk just past the American flag and stand next to the clock on your left. You've reached your final destination.

8029.instruction: You are facing a wooden wall, turn around, walk straight. Move a step forward, turn right, walk straight and exit the room. Walk straight towards the railing, turn right and walk straight. Now you are standing in front of the drums. In the right there is a wall and above there are guitars. This is the end point.

8030.instruction: Now you are facing towards the wooden wall, turn slightly left and move forward, here you can see a black colour board in front of you, now go straight and turn right. Move out through the open door, now move towards the wooden fence and turn right till you find black coloured musical instruments in front of you and here you reach your final destination.

8113.instruction: You are facing a couch.  You are going to turn to your right and you will see 2 grey chairs sitting next to each other.  You are going to hop over those 2 chairs landing in between the back of the chairs and a dining room table on your left.  You are going to move forward passing the table on your left.  You will see a walkway in front of you and to your left you will see a desk area in the kitchen and an island with chairs on your left.  You are going to walk in between that desk area on your right and the island kitchen on your left heading towards the walkway. You are going to enter this walkway.  You are going to make a left into a bathroom. And once you have entered this bathroom standing in front of the sink with an oval mirror over it you are done.

8213.instruction: Now you are facing towards the white coloured couch, turn slightly right and move forward through the narrow passage till you find stairs on your right side, now get down the stairs completely, here you can see a glass window in front of you, from there take right turn and move forward here you can find the billiards board on your left side. Now take right turn and enter into the open door and move forward and beside the bed is your final destination.

8214.instruction: you're facing towards a sofa turn right and move forward and walk straight to the end on the right side you can see the stairs which is completely wooden. Get down the stairs, In front you can see the window in front of you and turn right where you can see the entrance of another room and it is a living room and turn right and walk straight towards the game room on the left side you can see a snooker table. From there turn right towards the door and here you can see the entrance for another room. Enter into that room on the right side you can see the bed, Which is made with wooden and on the right side. You can see the wooden bath tub. And in front you can see the lamp and now you had reached your destination.

8232.instruction: Move forward from the place where you're standing and turn right to exit the washroom . Now, slightly turn left and stand in the bath tub. From here, slightly turn right and move forward towards the opened door. Now turn left and exit the room. From here, turn left and move towards the dining table. Now, slightly turn right and move forward. Now, slightly turn left and move towards the cupboards, which is in front of you. Now, slightly turn left and move forward and stand at a point, where you can see a dining table on the left side and that is the end point.

8233.instruction: "Now you are facing towards European WC, walk forwards turn right and exit the door, you can see a tube, which is towards your left, walk inside it and move forward till you see a door, which is to your left, exit the door and walk forward in between the dinning table and black sofa, after crossing the dining table, turn left and walk forward, stay in between the dining table and cupboard, your destiny has been arrived."

8432.instruction: Right now you are at the exit point of the bath room with a door. Take a left from the bathroom. You can find a door to exit from the bedroom. Go outside of that room. Take a right from that room and then, take a left from the wooden pillar and then you can find a stair case. Go upside through the stair cases. There are photos of some persons on the wall. Go upwards through the stair cases. Once you reach the upstairs, you can find the sofa and the lamp with tables. Go right from the lamp and then go straight and then you reached the final destination exactly in front of the flag and then stop.

8433.instruction: `We are near the rest room go straight to exit the room go straight from the door go straight near the pillar and make a slightly left turn there you u will find the stairs get up the stairs and a slight right turn to the stairs and reach to the top of the stairs go straight near to the sofa and go straight, here we reached the destination near to the england falg.

8493.instruction: We're going to start in a bathroom facing some sinks. We're going to turn to the left, to where we'll have bathroom stalls to your left. We're going to walk towards and out the door. Once out the door, we're going to hang a right in the hallway with tile and wood paneling. When you get to the door in the hallway, it will have a sconce on either side and with a drinking fountain to the right. Turn to the left and go into the main room which has a table in the center and various benches. We're going to walk to the left into this main room, to where you'll have some stairs to your right, a door, and a ficus tree on the left. Continue walking forward, until you are next to a table covered in a white table clothe, and over by the large fire place with a heavy wooden mantle on  your left. Turn to your right and go into the humidor area. You'll have a cabinet with some cigars and a leather bench. Walk forward towards the exit, but don't go through it. Instead, hang a right. Through the doorway, by the exit, is going to be a tufted upholstered chair and some champagne flutes, as well as a bathroom. Go into this room and hang a right. From here you will see the bathroom in front of you, a mirror and vanity to your right, as well as another mirror in front of you. And this is where we will stop.

8554.instruction: Now, you are facing towards a plant. Turn to your left side and move forward. Now, take slight right where you can find an open glass door. Enter though it and move towards your right side. Now, take left from the white chair which is on the right side and move forward crossing the mirror on your right side. Now, you will find an open door in the right side. Enter through it and turn right. Move forward crossing the two black stools and turn left. Move forward and turn to your right side where you can find an open door. Enter through it. Now, walk straight towards the brown open door. Enter through it and take left. You will find a white open glass door. Pass through it and turn to your left side where you can find a white chair. Pass through it and turn to your right side passing through the cream coloured sofa on your left side and that will be your end point where you are facing a chair and a table with a lamp in front of you.

8555.instruction: You are facing towards the plant pot, turn slightly left and walk straight towards the open door, get got of the room, slightly turn right and go near the white chair, walk straight again towards the another white chair which is in front of you, get out of the room, turn right and walk straight few steps and take immediate right again, this is a kitchen area, go straight till the cupboard, turn left and get out of the kitchen area, walk through the walk way and get out of the room, slightly turn left and go near the door, slightly turn left again and go near the sofa, from there walk few steps straight towards the sofa chair which is in front of you, now you are in front of the sofa chair, this would be your final destination.

8561.instruction: Right now we are facing towards the wall slightly take right and move forward and exit the washroom through the open door in front you can see the bed, slightly take left on the left you can see the open door move towards it near the open door is your final destination point.

8562.instruction: You are facing towards the wall and the mirror. Turn slightly right and exit the room, you are now facing towards the bed. Turn slightly left and move out of the bedroom, you are now facing towards the arch and to your left there is a closed white door, and this is your endpoint.

8584.instruction: You are standing inside a living room, in front of a brown coffee table, on your left their is a beige sofa which has grey and white flower cushions, walk straight ahead, once you are near the black coffee table near the beige sofa, turn a slight right and  go downstairs.Once you are down on the floor you should see a green vase with white flowers turn left and go towards the glass door on your left, go through the glass door and this should be an entrance to the garage with laundry machines inside, go towards the laundry machines , do not go towards the laundry machines just take a step inside this room and you are done.

8713.instruction: Now you are facing towards the white coloured couch, turn slightly left and move forward towards the brown coloured sofa on your left side, now move forward by passing through the round table and the chairs on your right side and walk till you find the stairs on your right side, now go up the stairs completely by passing through the plant pot in the middle. Now move straight and move out through the open entrance here you can see the sofa chairs in front of you, from there take right turn towards the plant pots, now walk until you find the two black coloured plant pots on your left, Now move forward towards the grass and turn your left and now stand in the grass near the black coloured plant pot is your final destination.

8714.instruction: You are facing the couch. Slightly turn left and walk straight.Walk straight towards the chair. Turn slightly right and climb up the stairs. Completely climb the stairs and walk straight. There is a glass door, exit the room and turn right. Walk straight, pass through the fountain which is in the left and walk straight. Slightly turn left and walk straight by passing through the potted plant. You are on the lawn facing the plants. This is the end point.

8800.instruction: you are facing towards the flower pot, move slightly to your right and move forward in the narrow way towards a white chair and a pet house. Move towards the third flower pot, turn slightly towards your right from flower pot. Enter into the dinning room, face towards the white dinning table. Move towards the open way, towards living area near the sofa. Move from back of sofa and table and table lamp to your left. Move forward near the white chairs and a portrait frame to your left wall. Move straight, there will be a white round table and a white flower vase on it to your left. Move forward where there is a portrait on the wall and a study table and book shelves to your left. Move forward into the kitchen area near to the stove, turn to your right from the stove, move forward near to the white table and blue sofas. It will be your end point.

8801.instruction: Now we are near the small table, take slight right, move straight and take slight left, move straight and take slight right, move straight and take right, move straight and take right, move straight and take slight right, move straight and take slight right, move straight and take right, move straight and take right, move straight and take slight right, move straight, there is a table, on the table there is a bowl and we reached the destination.

8868.instruction: You are facing towards the wall where in you need to take right and exit the room. Then turn right and move forward, then you would be seeing two open rooms, then you need to enter into second one which doesn't have open door. Enter into that room and move towards the table and stop at the glass. In the left you would be seeing a dustbin and in the right you would be seeing two chairs, and this is your end point.

8869.instruction: You are in a empty room facing towards the wall, take a slight right turn and move forward to the door, from there take care right turn and go straight in the corridor near the door, and move forward, from there take a slight left and enter into the meeting room where you can see some chairs, table , and PC, take a slight left and go straight to the glass wall near the dustbin and the cabinet. This is the endpoint.

8874.instruction: You're going to start in a bathroom facing some sinks and a mirror. You're going to turn slightly towards your right. Take a step forward towards the first door opening that you see that's right in front of you. You're going to take one small step forway right before the next door opening. On your right there should be a shower with on a hook on the side with a robe. On your left should another robe and some more hooks and what might be a closet. This will be your stopping point.

8924.instruction: Now you are in a bedroom and facing towards the open door. Turn slightly right and move forward to the open door. Turn right. Move forward into the open door in front of you. Turn left. Move forward to the wall. Turn right. You can see a small walkway, walk in to the walkway. You can see an open door in front of you. Go into the open door and stand behind the sofa. You have reached your destination.

8925.instruction: You are in your bedroom, facing towards the bed. Turn towards your slight right and walk across the bed, In front, you can find a brown door, go near that door and turn towards your right. On the other side of a corridor, you can find an other door, go near that door and turn around towards your left. You can find a corridor, go pass through the door and enter into that corridor. Now, turn towards your slight right, keep moving forward in the corridor and you enter into a hall, which has a sofa set on your left side. Keep moving forward through the hall and go through the section of a corridor in front of you. Keep moving forward and in front, you can find a door, which is brown in color. Go pass through that door and you will enter into your balcony. In front, you can find a sofa set, go and stand near that sofa set and you reached  your destination.

8950.instruction: You're facing a platform, take a slight right turn and go straight and exit the room . Go straight near the chairs and take a slight right and enter the room. Here you can see a sofa at the corner. Take a right turn and go near the middle of the room where you're below the fan. it is your destination.

8951.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a platform. Now slightly turn right and exit the room through the open door which is in front of you, there are three chairs in front of you, move towards the chairs and slightly turn right. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. Now you are facing towards a chair. Now slightly turn right and move a bit forward and stand in front of the shelf and it is your end point.

9028.instruction: Go down through the staircase, after reaching bottom of the staircase take right and go little forward and take left, you will be finding a mirror in the washroom which is your destination.

9029.instruction: Now you are on the steps and facing towards the wall. Turn right and get down the steps. Turn right. You will see an opening in front of you. Go inside the opening. Turn around. Move forward near the door. Turn left. You will see an open door. Go inside the open door. Turn left. You will see another open door. Go into the open door and stand in front of the wash basin and mirror. You have reached your destination.

9042.instruction: You're currently staring at a brown-framed painting in a dining room. Turn a hundred-and-eighty degrees and take two steps forward, until you're right in front of the open brown double doors. Once you're at the entrance to this art gallery room, enter the first door to your right, slightly passing the silver bath tub to your left. In this new room, you see a silver staircase, take one step forward to the base of the silver staircase. Now, you see the silver staircase going up to the left, or up to the right. Go up the silver staircase towards the left, and once you're halfway up the staircase, and staring directly in front of a white wall. To your right, you see the end of the white railing, you're done.

9104.instruction: For your point you will begin in a bathroom facing a towel rack turn to the left and exit it straight ahead. Look to your left you will see an open door, go through it. You will enter into a hall move forward through that hall you will pass an open doorway to your left. Continue moving straight a head you will see an open doorway that leads into a bedroom. stand at the thresh hole of that doorway. And your done.

9119.instruction: Slide left and walk below the down stairs and walk towards the steps with white marble in between the two pillars, now move towards the wall, turn right and turn right were the brown doors are open, and walk straight near to the brown table which is at the center of the room, you have reached your destination.

9120.instruction: You are facing the stairs. Turn left, get down through the stairs. Pass between the two pillars and get down through the stairs and walk straight. Turn right, walk straight in the red carpet. Pass through the railing which is in the front and stand beside the teapoy. In the opposite you have chairs and a closed door. This is the end point.

9138.instruction: In the hallway with the black leather chair with metal arms, you can see into several rooms. One of them has a toilet. Step in front of the toilet with the sink to your left.

9142.instruction: Right now you are in a home theatre room, move forward and exit the room. You will find a hallway in front of you, move forward towards the hallway and you will find a door opened towards your right which enter into the kitchen area. Take the immediate left once you enter into the kitchen area and you will find a black sofa in front of you. Move forward towards the sofa and here is your destination.

9143.instruction: You are in the room facing towards the projector screen. Slightly turn right and move towards the wall. Now slightly turn left and move towards the projector screen. Turn right and exit the room. Now slightly turn right and walk straightly in the passage till you find an open room on your left side. Turn left and enter into the room. Now you are in the washroom. Turn around and now you are facing towards the wall. Slightly turn right and walk straightly towards the oven. Now slightly turn left and move towards the couch. Now you are standing behind the couch. That will be the end point.

9170.instruction: You're facing to a door. Walk towards the open door. Turn right, walk to the opposite open door. Walk into the room. You can see dining table in front of you. Walk towards the dining chair in front of you. Turn left, you can see an arch in front of you. Walk towards the arch. Go to the window in front of you. Turn slightly right, you can see the armchair in front of you. Walk towards the arm chair. It is your destination.

9171.instruction: From the place your standing exit the room by moving forward now in the opposite there is an another room enter into it, then turn slightly left. Keeping moving forward towards the arch then turn slightly right there is an another open arch go and stand back of the couch, you have reached your destination point.

9172.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the sofa. Turn slightly left, and move forward, you can see the fire place in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the stair case in front of you. Now go up through that stair case, and move forward, you can see the another stair case in front of you. Now slightly turn right, and go up through that stair case until, you reach the second step on that stair case. Now turn around, you can see the open door in front of you. Now enter into that room, you can see the brown colour chair in front of you. Now turn left, and move forward, you can see the books in front of you. Now turn slightly right, and take one step forward, you can see the two lights in front of you. Now, you have reached your destination."

9173.instruction: You are facing towards a stand lamp, slightly turn left and move towards the couch, slightly turn left, you can find steps, go up the steps, now you are facing towards the pillar, slightly turn right and stand on the second step, slightly turn right and enter into the room, now you are facing towards a chair, slightly turn left and move forward, slightly turn right and move a bit forward, where to the left, you can find a book shelf, that would be your end point.

9214.instruction: You're looking into a closet. Turn around and take a right into the bathroom, and take another right into a hallway that leads to the toilet. Continue straight to the bidet. Stand in front of the bidet, and you're done.

9231.instruction: You are facing a corner. Turn left and exit the room through the opened door. Turn right you can see a hall. Go forward towards the grey chair which is behind the white couch. Turn left and go forward until you reach the table with white marble beside you. You can see an entrance which is beside a brown cupboard, go forward and enter the entrance. Turn left go through the passage and enter the room straight ahead. Towards right you can see a room with an opened door, go towards the opened door. Go forward towards the blue portrait which is on the wall, turn right and go towards the window which is beside the blue chair, you have reached.

9232.instruction: Now you are in a washroom facing towards a toilet seat, turn to your left and exit the room through an open door, now move forward and take right, you can see an open arch, enter into it and take left, you can see a white sofa to your left and a  two grey colored chairs to the right, move forward till you reach a opened door in-front of you, enter into it and take left, you can see a narrow path in-front of you, walk through the narrow path, there is a mirror to your right and open door in-front of you, enter into the open door and take right, now you can see an open wide door, enter into it and take left,  you can see two portraits on the left side of the wall and a glass table with a blue color chair in-front of it, go near the window which is in-front of you, that's your end point.

9277.instruction: We are in a living room. I would like for you to hop over the couch that is closest to the stairs. Go up the stairs following the path on the left hand side. At the top of these stairs then go to the open doorway on your right hand side. Entering into a bedroom that has two chairs turning to your right. You'll see you are in a little hallway. Go down this hallway. Entering into a sitting area. Go past the chair that is by itself. Now go to that pink huge bathtub. This is where you will stop.

9468.instruction: Right now you're facing towards an open door. Now turn left, there is a closed glass door in front of you, move towards the door. There are staircases to your left and right, move towards the staircase which is to your left and turn left. Now get down the staircase. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. Now turn left, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. Now slightly turn left, there is a round dining table in front of you, move towards the dining table. There is a cabinet beside the chairs with two flower pots on it, move towards the cabinet and slightly turn right. There is a table in front of you and a red chair beside it, move towards the table and stand in front of it and it will be your end point.

9469.instruction: You are facing towards an open door, turn left and move towards the staircase which is near the closed door. You can see staircase to your left and to your right, get down of the staircase using the left one. You are standing near an open door, take few steps forward. Turn left you can see bathtub and an open door, move towards the open door. Turn slight left, you can chairs and round table, move towards them. You can see books on the table right in-front of you, move towards the books. Now you can see 4 chairs and a table, move towards the table. You are standing in-front of the table, which is your final destination.

9559.instruction: You will start by facing a doorway. Go inside this doorway and turn right. Walk towards the foot of the bed and exit the bedroom. Once you're on the hallway and facing the arched opening. Turn left and there will be a doorway. Go inside this doorway you will see another bedroom. Continue to walk forward passing the bed on your left. Towards the bathroom. Once you're standing in front of the sink then you're done.

9628.instruction: You are facing towards a wooden door, turn slightly right and move forward. You are now facing towards a comot, turn to your left and exit the bathroom through the open door. You are now in a bedroom facing towards the bed, turn to your right and exit the bedroom through the open door, move forward. You can see four steps, climb up the steps and move forward. Walk straight, you have a table with two chairs on your left, move forward. You are now facing towards the gas stove and you are standing between two kitchen countertops and this is your end point.

9629.instruction: Okay now you are in front of a open door and towels are hanged to a hanger, on the door. Now move out of this entrance and in front of you, there is a bed and to the left there is a table, which is brown in color. As you exit take right and move forward and in front of you, there is a open entrance. Now move out of the entrance and also there are some stairs, in front of you. Now move above the stairs and move forward in a straight path. As you move forward you will enter into a kitchen area. Now to the right of you, there are some cupboards and chairs beside it and to left there is a table and some plates on the cupboard. Now stop here and this is your final destination.

9670.instruction: You're in the washroom near the toilet seat. Turn right, take a step forward and exit through the door. Now you're in the bedroom, turn slightly left and move forward towards the bedroom entrance door. Exit the bedroom. Turn right and walk into the arch which is a hallway. Walk through the hallway till you reach a piano onto your right and dining table onto your left. Now go and stand near the closed glass door beside the mirror. This would be your end point.

9720.instruction: You are in a restroom, facing a wooden door. Take a slight left turn. Get out of the washroom. You will find a walk way. Take a right turn, where you will enter a room. Take a right turn.You will have a kitchen onto your left and a snooker onto your right. Take a long left turn. Walk straight towards the wall, with a lamp attached. Take a right turn. Walk straight. Enter a  restroom onto your right side. Go straight. Here is your destination in the restroom.

9721.instruction: Right now you are in front of the door. Now slightly turn left and step out of the door. Now you will find another open door in front of you. Now step out of the bathroom and go straight. On the right side you will find an open door. Now exit from the room you will find narrow opening in front of you. Now enter into the narrow opening and again turn back and step out of the narrow opening. Now turn right and go straight you will find bathroom on your right side. Now enter into the bathroom and stand in front of the commode. That will be your final destination.

9793.instruction: You begin staring at some gray curtains in a corner. Turn to your left and note the dining table to your left. Walk between the dining table and the windows, and towards the kitchen island with three bar stools. Once you are behind the left bar stool, turn right and move to the other side of the island. Once there, you should see that, upon turning left, you see a staircase. Go up the staircase. It turns left, in the middle, but you want to go all the way up. Once you're at the top you should see four paintings... Well, four pictures. One of them is a picture of a woman riding on a surfboard carried by four men. If you see that, you're in the right place. Turn left down the hall, and take the first door to the right. This leads to another hallway which you will go all the way down. You should end up near some green chairs. They're on the opposite side of a desk to a leather chair. Move towards that leather chair, next to the painting with all the abstract birds. Once you're behind the leather chair, near the abstract bird painting, turn back the way you came. You should be able to look through the wooden sliding door and see the door that was on the right when you were heading in. Go inside that door from here. You should be in a bedroom, with a bed with a green and white comforter. There's a picture of a giraffe on the right hand wall, and a poster that says 'Love' with a heart and less than symbol creating the... Or, with a three and less than symbol creating the heart. Turn to the left, moving along the foot of the bed. And you should end up next to a Campbell's tomato soup painting, and a dog bed. If you're in that corner you're done.

9848.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Slightly turn right and walk through the open arch which is in front of you. There is a staircase on your right side. Turn right and climb the steps. Now you are facing towards the wall. Turn left and stand on the third step. Now you are facing towards the wall. There are railings on your left side and a glass window on your right side. That will be the end point.
