Turn slight right and enter into the toilet room, you are now facing towards the wall, which is your end point.

12873.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the brown colour door. Turn left, and move forward, you can see the books in front of you. Now slightly turn right, and move forward until, you reach the bed room in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the mirror in front of you. Now slightly turn right, and move forward, you can see the bath tub in front of you. Now turn left, and move forward until, you reach the photo frame hanging on the wall in front of you. Now turn left, and move forward, you can see the bath room in front of you. Now enter into that bath room. Now, you have reached your destination."

12918.instruction: You are facing towards the open door. Turn right and walk straight till you reach the closed door in the front. Turn left and walk a few steps ahead. Turn right. Walk straight till you reach the wall with six photos hanged on it. Slightly turn left and walk straight till you reach an open door towards your right side. Turn right and exit the room. Slightly turn left. Walk straight and stand in front of the round table. You have reached your point.

12919.instruction: You are standing towards the open door, turn right, walk near to the closed door, turn left, walk forward, you are in the living room, turn right, walk near to the wall, turn left, walk forward and exit through the right side of the open door, walk forward, now you are standing in front of the chair, slightly turn left, walk forward, you are standing towards the glass window. This is your final destination.

13070.instruction: You're in a bedroom to your right is a bed and you'll see some double doors to the left of the fireplace that are open, walk towards these. And then turn to the left you'll see a hallway with several brown double doors, walk through this hallway. Then walk towards the chair against the wall, then you'll see a shower at the end of this room, walk towards it. And you should see a bathroom to the right and you should be looking in front of the shower and you've reached the end.

13179.instruction: You're facing a wooden door with a window in it. Walk through this door. And on the inside you'll see a chair in front of you and wood floors. Go to the right and you'll see a Christmas tree, and at the Christmas tree go up these stairs. To the top. And then when you get to the top go to the room right on your right. Walk over the bed towards the window. And then take a step towards the air conditioning and you've reached the end.

13256.instruction: You're standing in front of a couch turn to the left and you'll see an armchair. Take a step to the left of this armchair. And then turn right and walk towards the stairs in front of you. Walk up the stairs. All the way to the next floor and then turn right. You'll see a pool table, take a step towards this pool table. And then walk to the left of the pool table. And walk towards the base of the stairs you  see in front of you. And step towards the stairs and go up. And go up until you're about three stairs from the top and you've reached the end.

13305.instruction: Now you're facing the wall. Turn around and walk towards the white color door and then take right, you will find the white color sofa on your left. Walk slightly right from the white color sofa and in front you will find a sliding door. Walk into the sliding door and take immediate left. Now walk in between the sliding door and behind the sofa and then take immediate left again. Now walk slightly right towards the swimming pool and you will find two door mats before a sliding door. Enter the room which has sliding door. Now you will see a circular table and a sofa on your right. Walk right towards the white color sofa and turn slightly left and walk towards the entrance. Stand before the entrance, you will reach your destination.

13306.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the white door, turn back and walk straight, now you can see the glass window and a chair to the right go near it you can see the open door present on the front walk till the open door and exit the room through it as soon as you exit the room you can find sofa set in the front walk behind the sofa set to the left side walk straight and turn left now you can find a plant in the front to the right of the plant you can see the open door, enter into the room through it after entering the room to the right side you can find sofa set and a television walk near to the two sofas and turn left now you can see the open door right in front of the open door is the end point.

13666.instruction: Right now you are in front of the window, now turn back, and go straight, you will find open door, now exit from the room, and turn right, there you will find sofa, now go near the sofa, and stand in front of the portrait, now turn left, you will find stair case, walk all the way to the top of the stairs, and turn right, you will find flower pot, now go straight, there you will find three rooms, enter into the middle room, on the left side, you will find small pink chair, and you will find glass window in front of you, go and stand in front of the window, that will be your final destination.

13667.instruction: You are facing towards the window right now, turn back and exit the room, to your right you can find a couch, go near the couch, there is a green portrait infront of you, go near the green portrait, now turn to your left, you can find a stair case, go up the stairs, now you can find three rooms to your right, go near the first room which is to your right, now you are at the entrance of the first room, slightly turn to your left and enter into the middle room, you can find two windows infront of you, stand infront of the window which is straight to you, that would be your end point.

13714.instruction: you're staring at a doorway. turn to your left. take one step toward the glass case. you're done

13868.instruction: You begin by standing at the bottom of a set of stairs. You initially begin looking up at the ceiling. What you should do is turn to the left and look up the stairs so you can see the landing which features a large window and two paintings on the wall to the left. SO make your way to the top of the stairs and keep following the little landing as it turns to the right. Now here you're going to see another set of stairs leading upwards along with two pictures on the left wall with another one of those long windows in the middle. Once again, follow the stairs all the way to the top. Now what you're going to see is an open door straight ahead, so walk through that door. You're going to see a carpeted hallway that branches off to the left and to the right. We're going to ignore the right side and turn to the left. Now this is a much much longer hallway, featuring a brown and gold carpet on the floor along with paintings on either side of the wall. So we are going to walk all the way up and stop at the edge of the first room on the right. You'll know that you're in the spot because directly in front of you just to the left there's going to be a window with a small pot of flowers on top and on the right there's going to be what looks like a thermostat on the wall. Now, here we're going to turn right into this room, and you'll see that it is a bedroom featuring a large window with some beautiful drapes directly ahead of you and a bed on the left. So take one step into the room and tunr yourself to the left and you're going to walk right up to the lamp post that is right beside the bed, and once you're here you'll be facing the lamp, with the bed directly to your right. And you are done.

13938.instruction: Okay, Right now we are facing toward the table, to your slight right there is a chair and there is a way, move forward towards the wall, move forward towards the door. Exit this room, To your right there is a path follow, move  forward in the same path. Exit the door in front of you. Now to your right there a table and few chairs, move forward in that direction. Now to you right there is shelf and books in it and to your left there is a pillar, move forward to that. Now to your left there is the pillar and in front of you there is another pillar, move forward in that direction. Now to your slight left there is sofa, move forward in that direction. Now in front of you there is door, move forward in that direction. Enter that door and this your destination.

13939.instruction: You're now facing the table with stairs. Turn slightly right and walk behind the chairs towards the door and exit the room. From there, turn right and walk straight through the passage till you enter the open entrance in front. From there, turn right and walk straight towards the table with white colour chairs. From there, turn slightly left and walk towards the white colour pillar in front. From there, turn slightly right and walk straight. You will now find a sofa set on the left side, walk straight towards the sofa set and walk towards the cycles behind it. From there, turn left and enter the room. Stand near the entrance, you will reach your destination.

13942.instruction: We're inside of a bedroom looking at the bathroom. To our left is a window with a view. Behind us is the exit out of the bedroom. Head out of the bedroom towards the corridor on our left. We can see that there is a lot of cabinets. To the right are some steps. Take a step towards the steps. At the base of the steps is a room on the right. Take a step inside it and stand next to the desk with the computer screen. You have arrived!

13982.instruction: Alright, you begin next to a silvery cushioned wall... Oh, man, if you look around... That is... That is like a horrible silver couch has slowly overtaken the room. Like it's spreading to the other surfaces. That is garish and not great to look upon. Alright, well, you'll want to exit this room, through the open door with the circular window in it, and once you've exited, head immediately to the right, into the bathroom... Oh, that is not a bathroom, that is an area behind a bar, excuse me. Once you've just stepped into the area behind the bar, turn around and move towards the painting mounted on the side of the dining table. Once you've taken a step towards that turn left and head across the head of the dining table, towards the back of the bar stools. Continue until you are behind the right-most bar stool, and you're done.

14024.instruction: Right now you're facing a window in the bathroom. Now turn left and exit the bathroom. Now turn left, you can see an opened glass door in front of you, move towards the door and exit the room. Now, you can see a portrait to your left and an opened glass door to your right, move towards the opened glass door and turn left. You can see a stair case in front of you, move towards the staircase and slightly turn left. You can see a portrait in front of you on the wall, get down the staircase and stand in front of the portrait and it will be your end point.

14025.instruction: okay yourself your located in bathroom , take left and exit from the bathroom , now you have been entered into a bedroom , slightly turn to your left  and exit from bedroom , there is a path in between the portrait and a wall , slightly turn to your right and there is open glass door enter into it , your in the entrance of a bathroom , now turn to your left and go near the staircases now get down from the staircases , you will be seeing a white wall in front of you and slight left a portrait on the wall it is your destination point .

14065.instruction: You begin in a kitchen looking at a cabinet full of mugs and teacups and such. Take an immediate left turn and move towards the seating area, to the right of two gray chairs. You should see some tan couches in front of you, step between the nearby tan couch and the coffee table, and then climb over the other tan couch towards the open sliding glass door. Once you're in front of that sliding glass door just take a step through it and you're done, that's all you needed to do.

14210.instruction: Starting facing a wall turn left, walk down the stairs and turn around. Now slightly to your right you'll see a long glass table. Jump over the the railing towards that table. Now here you'll see a doorway to your left passed some stairs leading down, you're going to step towards that doorway. Looks like it takes into a bathroom. Now you're going to look back out the bathroom, take one step out the bathroom. Slightly look left and you'll see a black couch to your right will be that glass table. You're going to step over towards the black couch and looking straight ahead you'll see those red chairs around another glass table, and to your left looks like a long bar. You're going to go to the edge of the bar. Now those red chairs are to your right and straight ahead looks like an exit to the outside. You're going to jump over the corner of the bar towards that open door and stop.

14303.instruction: You are facing towards the open door, turn left and move forward towards the wall, now turn left and stand at the entrance of the changing room, now turn right and exit the washroom, now turn left and walk straight till you reach the treadmill on your right side, now turn slightly right and move towards the caution board, which is at the swimming pool, now turn slightly right and move towards the open door, now turn slightly right and move towards the stairs, continue forward, and reach the big photo mounted on the wall, now there is a staircase behind you, and there is a big photo in front of you, this is your end point.

14304.instruction: Turn left from your position, move little forward there is a sink at the right side, move forward towards the wall, slightly take left and move forward, now you are facing towards the wall, turn right, you can find an open door, exit the room, and take left, you can find a saloon chair, walk straight towards it, move forward in the walkway, slightly turn right and move forward towards the swimming pool, take right, you can find two beds and an entrance, enter into the entrance at the right side, walk straight, you can find stairs, move forward, you can find a banner of system professional, in front of it is your destination.

14419.instruction: you start looking at a staircase, the staircase is heading down. head down the staircase to the first landing, turn your body to the left and take one step down the staircase. you should still be on the staircase now, turn your body to the left and you will see a doorway to a study. head into that doorway. and walk up to the back up to that chair in the study, the brown leather chair. you are going to jump over the brown leather chair and land right in front of the bookcase that is right in front of you. once you are standing in front of the bookcase you will see someones graduation picture once you are there you are done.

14430.instruction: Now you are facing to the wall turn around you can find a open door, enter into it, move forward by passing the bed and exit the room, if you look forward there is a closed door, move towards the closed door and stop in front of the door

14431.instruction: You are in a walkway facing towards the wall, turn left towards the open door, enter in to the room, it's a bed room, walk towards the small table which is beside the bed, exit the bed room, get on the mat which is in front of you, towards you right there is a washbasin, go straight towards the closed door, now you are in front of the closed door, towards your left there is a shower room, this would be an end point.

14459.instruction: Look around, you're currently at the backyard of a house. Walk straight towards the stairs passing the brown and red arm chairs to your left. Walk up the stairs, and enter the house. Turn left towards the staircase, until you've reached a black window pane in front of you. Turn left and walk up the stairs, after passing the black-and-white painting to your right, you have reached your final destination.

14494.instruction: Slide left and walk straight towards the yellow color cupboards, now slide right, move towards the yellow cupboard where there is a sink on top of it, slide right and enter into the room which is the second room from the side of the potted plant, enter into the room and walk straight towards the wall, now turn right and move towards the corner of the bathroom and you have reached your end point.

14495.instruction: Now you are facing towards the steps turn towards your left and walk towards yellow shelf in front of you and then slightly turn towards your right there is an opened door through which you can see a wash basin go into it now you have entered the bathroom go near the bathing tub and this is your final destination.

14579.instruction: You are in a living area, in front of a television set. Turn towards your right and move forward. On your right, you can find a door. Go pass through the door and you enter into a corridor. Turn towards your right again and keep moving forward. On your left, you can find a bedroom. Go pass through the door and enter into that bedroom. In front, you can find a cardio machine, walk across the cardio machine and go near the window beside the bed. You reached your destination.

14580.instruction: Turn to your right and go near to the brown color door and take a right turn, walk straight facing the wall and take a right turn, now start walking straight through the narrow corridor and stand in front of the door which is on your left side. Turn to your left and enter into the room, go near to the exercise machine and from there start moving to the corner of the room where there is a glass window near the white color bed.

14602.instruction: You are in a boiler room, turn right until you see a room past a watercooler enter the room. Head toward the green storage case. Look left of it youll see a door in the distance past a shelving rack, go past that go past the stairs. Enter the next room standing on the rug. You will be looking at a green door and a bookshelf.

14611.instruction: You are facing towards the corner of a door, turn slightly left walk beside a big clock wall in front, there is an open door beside the two chairs on your left stand at the entrance of the door and this is your end point.

14612.instruction: You are facing towards a passage, just turn to your left, you can see a huge clock on your right side, walk towards the clock. After reaching the clock, on your left side you can see an open entrance just beside the basket of charts, go and enter into that open entrance. You have reached your destination.

14676.instruction: You are facing towards the cup board in front of you, slightly turn right, there is an open door in front of you, go straight and exit the room, slightly turn left, go straight, there is an arch in front of you, go straight and enter the arch, turn right, there is an open door in front of you, go straight and stand at the entrance of the open door, turn around, go straight, turn right, there is a round table and chairs in front of you, go straight near the table, slightly turn left, there is a window in front of you, go straight and stand in front of the window, this is your final destination.

14677.instruction: You are facing towards a small table, slightly turn to your right and exit the room, you are facing towards a pillar, slightly turn to your left and move forward towards the opening which is infront of you, slightly turn to your right and move towards the opened door, now you are facing towards the door, turn back and move a bit forward, turn right and move forward, to the left, you can find a round table, move a bit forward, now you are facing towards a small table, that would be your end point.

14689.instruction: You are standing in a  threshold of a washroom, turn around and walk towards the abstract painting and a white stool with pillows on the wall. once you are near that stool exit through the open door, and move straight ahead towards the window which has outlook of the city. Once you are near the window, take first right before that and this should be taking you by jumping off the white stool and the foot rest in to the patio, once you are near the bench on the right at the patio, with the lined cushions you are done.

14741.instruction: Begin facing into a bedroom. Head onto the rug on the right side of the foot of the bed. Turn left and you'll see an open door. Head out the door and turn right. You'll see a flight of stairs. Ascend it. When you get to the top you'll see an open door on your right. Enter into the home theater and stand beside the coffee table to the right of the first couch. Done

14871.instruction: You're standing in a bedroom with wooden furniture, turn to your right and you'll see a double door that is open that leads out of the room. Walk towards that door, and stand in the doorway, you'll see painting in front of you and another archway on your right side, walk towards that archway and you'll see a dining room on your right side, a living room on your left. Further ahead, there's a kitchen, walk towards the kitchen and in the direction of a hallway that's on the right side of the kitchen, walk past the kitchen island on your left, and past the sink on your right, and walk into that hallway that leads to a secondary kitchen or service area, and to the left there's an open door. Walk towards that open door, you'll see in front of you a round table on the left and sliding door on the right and in front of you there's a planter also. Walk towards the planter. And keep walking towards an archway next to that planter and now you'll see there are, there's an opening on the left, an opening in front of you, where you can see a door with a glass panel and a ceiling lamp and there's another opening on your right. Walk towards the arched opening in front of you and stand right at the edge and then turn right. Now in front of you you'll see another living area with a carpet, walk towards the right edge of that carpet and turn left. Now walk towards the fireplace in front of you and stand as close to the fireplace as you can, right in front of the wood and next to well, candles, and a round coffee table. That's your spot.

14973.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the wall. Turn around, and take step forward, you can see an open door in front of you. Now go near to that open door, and slightly turn right sorry left, you can see an another open door on the left side. Now go near to that open door, and slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the narrow path way in front of you. Now move forward, and slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the grass in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward until, you reach the black colour door in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the switches in front of you. Now turn left, you can see the stair case in front of you. Now go up through that stair case. Now, you have reached your destination."

14974.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn around, walk towards the open door, slightly turn left you can see an open door, walk towards it, step out of the room through the door, walk straight in the narrow path, slightly turn left and walk towards the pillar, now walk towards the black gate, slightly turn left and walk towards the pillar, turn left walk towards the staircase, climb the stairs. Once you are done climbing, you have reached your destination.

15023.instruction: You're starting outside on a balcony, facing a door to the bedroom. Turn left and take a step to the end of the banister. Then turn right and enter the green, glass door. Walk down the floral carpet, keeping the banister on your left. Pass the triangular table and then you'll enter the second room on the right. Take one step inside this room and then turn around to face the hallway again. You should see a room in front of you that has stairs in the distance and a small bright light on a table. Take a step toward that light on the table. The fireplace will now be to your left and the staircase is to the right. Walk in between those into the room that's open right in front of you. You'll see two doors, but go to the one on the right. You'll pass the stairs on the right. It says "Safari" above the door you go into. Then walk up to the fireplace. Once you're as close as you can get to the fireplace, you're done.

15061.instruction: You will begin facing a wall, turn to the right, and you will see a black gate and black pillars, take one step forward towards the plants in front of you, you will now be standing next to the black gate, turn to the right, you will see the house and a swimming pool, you are going to head towards the swimming pool so take 4 steps forward. You should now be standing in front of the swimming pool, there will be doors to your left and doors to your right, go through the doors on your right, take one step, take another step to go in the door, you will see a very long panting, abstract painting, go to the left of the painting towards the vase. You will see that you are in a bedroom with a white bed, a vase to your right, a TV to your left and you will see that their is a chair. Follow the carpet on the floor, take 3 steps, you should now be standing in the middle of the room, with the bed to your right, the chair in front of you, the TV and the vase behind you, you are done.

15118.instruction: You begin looking towards a dining table with a lot of white chairs around it Turn somewhat right and move towards the open bathroom door, then turn back towards that dining table, and you're going to move to the left side of the glass divider that's past it. Once you're to the left of that glass divider, continue forward until the foot of the bed on your right. once you're at the foot of that bed, turn left, go into the bathroom door that's left of where you're looking, and then turn back around, to the right. You should see a blue chair. Just move towards that blue chair, and you're done.

15206.instruction: You are facing a window.  You are going to turn all the way around and you are going to go thru the open door right in front of you.  You are going to go thru this door and you have now stepped into a hallway. You are going to hop over the wood banister on your left and then you have landed next to a white cabinet.  You are going to move forward and go thru the open glass door.  You are going to take 1 step out and then you are going to turn back around and you are going to hop onto the stairs jumping thru the banister on your right.  You have landed on some steps.  You are going to go down the steps.  Once at the bottom of the steps you will make a left and you are going to turn into the first room on your left.  You are going to head to the left corner of this room and you are going to hop up onto the counter right underneath the 3 hooks on the wall on your left.  And once you are on the counter you are done.

15274.instruction: You're standing between two brown doors. If you turn around, go into this room towards the left of the rug. And then go into the room to the left where there's another rug. And then if you turn around you'll see two open brown doors, walk towards these doors. And then walk through into the next room where you see another rug. And then take a right towards the brown doors in the center. And walk outside these doors. And then walk to the left. And walk all the way to the end of this pathway. And you'll be standing to the left of two pillars and to the right a window and you've reached the end.

15291.instruction: Right now you're facing towards the doors. Now turn behind and move a bit forward  towards the fireplace which is to your right. Now slightly turn left, there is a wall in front of you, move towards the wall and turn left. There is an arch to your right, move towards the arch and turn right. Now enter in to the room, there is a sofa to your left, move towards the sofa and move a bit forward. Now turn left, there is an open door in front of you and a staircase to your left, move towards the staircase and climb up the stairs. There is a closed door in front of you, move towards the closed door and turn right. There is a walkway in front of you, move forward in the walkway up to the end, where you can see an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. There is a bed in front of you, move forward and stand in front of the bed facing the chair. Now turn right, you can see a portrait on the wall beside the closed glass door, move towards the portrait and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

15292.instruction: You are in a hall, facing doors. Take a U-turn. Move forward. Go near the wall. Turn left. Go forward. Turn right. Move forward. Slightly turn left. Move forward. Turn right. Move forward. Turn left. Go up the stairs. Turn right. Go near the closed door. Turn right. Move forward. Go through the open door. Go near the bed. Move forward. Turn right. Go near the closed door. You have reached your destination.

15394.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing and go near the open door. Now slightly turn left and exit from the bathroom. Now on the left side you will find chair. Now slightly turn left and go straight. You will find an open door. Now enter into the open door. Now go straight and turn left. You will find an open door. Now enter into the bathroom. Now slightly turn right and go straight. Now you are in front of the shower area. That will be your final destination.

15395.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn left and move towards the open door. Now turn left and step out of this room. You are facing towards the railing, turn left and move towards the gaming machine. Slightly turn left and enter into the room. Move towards the bed. Turn left you can see an open door next to the bathtub, move towards that door. Now slightly turn right and enter into the rest room. Now you are facing towards the window and the curtain. The position you are standing is your final destination

15486.instruction: We are going to start facing two sliding doors. We are going to take the right sliding door and get into the house. We should see a staircase on our right side. We are going to go all the way down the stairs. Now that we are downstairs, we are going to turn 45 degrees to our left. We are now going to have a living room on our left, we are going to have a sliding door right in front of us, and another door on the right. We are going to walk towards the open sliding glass door right in front of us. We are going to stop facing the open sliding that leads into a grass area. We should have the living room on our left and a brown closed double door on our right. This is going to be our destination.

15508.instruction: Right now you are in front of the glass open door enter into the glass open door move towards the bed in the front you can see the opening go straight, now you can see an another open door in the front walk straight and cross the open door on the left hand side on the wall there is an portrait and towards the right there is a staircase which is going towards up right in front of the portrait and a staircase is the end point.

15509.instruction: Right now you are in a balcony facing towards the glass door, now turn slight right and enter into the glass door, which is a bedroom, now move forward towards an entrance which is in front of you, here you can see a pathway in front of you, pass through the pathway until you reach an open door which is in front of you, now pass through the door and move little bit forward, where you will find a staircase on your right and a portrait on a wall on your left, this is your end point.

15555.instruction: You start out in an open room, standing between a coffee table and console table with a big black and white picture of sailboats above it. Directly ahead of you, there is a small black and white footstool. Walk directly to that footstool and then turn to your left. You will now be facing a teal couch with some framed photographs on the wall behind it and a large plant in front of a window. Walk directly to the large plant and then walk behind the sofa, between the back of the sofa and the wall with those pictures on it. Walk past a lamp that is behind the sofa and towards an open doorway. When you get to that doorway, you will see a bedroom in front of you. You can see the foot of the bed and a burnt orange chair directly ahead. Walk into that bedroom. Once you are inside that bedroom, you will see an open closet door on the same side of the room as that burnt orange sitting chair. You want to walk just up to the opening in the closet and when you are standing right inside the door frame of the closet where you can see the inside of the closet, that is where you will stop.

15565.instruction: You begin in a laundry room. Look slightly to your left and proceed forward out of the most direct door out. This should take you to an immediate left turn, after stepping out of which you will be in a kitchen area. Step left, toward the island, but then, step right, towards the circular table with what appears to be a coffee or tea set. Once you are standing near the circular table full of nick-nacks that have nothing to do with coffee or tea, you're done.

15596.instruction: You're standing in a bathroom take a step out towards this door in front of you and then take a step towards the open door on the right. And then you'll be in the bedroom go to the take a step towards the coffee table. And then take a step to the left of the bed and then exit this door on the left. And take one step out of the room and take a right and go down the stairs. And continue to go down the next flight of stairs all the way to the bottom. And then turn to the right and you'll see a white chair next to a rug, step towards this white chair. And then you'll see some stairs going down in front of you  take one step towards these stairs. And you've reached the end.

15640.instruction: You are standing inside a washroom, take one step inside the closet and you are done.

35387.instruction: Go straight from the place you are standing. On the right side you will find an open door. Now keep moving forward. You will find narrow opening. Now slightly turn left and go straight. On the left side you will find glass table. Now slightly turn right and go straight near the open door. Now slightly turn left and step out of the door. Now turn left and go straight. On the left side you will find an open door. Now move a step forward. Right now you are standing in front of the small table. That will be your final destination.

35388.instruction: Right now you're facing towards the narrow path and walk all the way from the narrow path. Turn slight left and move forward. Now you're facing towards the open glass door. Turn right you'll find an another open glass door, move towards the open glass door, turn slight left and go outside from the open door. Turn slight left you'll see two black tables which are in front of you, go and stand in front of the second table and that is your end point.

35397.instruction: You are facing a sink. Turn to your left. Go near the dining table. Again take a left. You can see a sofa and two lamps beside it, and also you can see an air conditioner above the lamp. Go and stand under the air conditioner and this is the end point.

35398.instruction: Slightly turn to your left from the place you are standing, you can find a dining table infront of you, slightly turn to your left, you can find a lamp placed on the black glassed teapoy which is left to the couch, stand beside the lamp, that would be your end point.

35489.instruction: Our starting point is in front of a wall, turn towards the right... We're now inside a bedroom... On the right there's a closet, on the left there's a bed and in the opposite side of the bed there's a window, a table and two chairs, walk towards the left side of the table, turn right, and exit the bedroom through the door on your left... We're now in a hallway, on the left there's  fence and some stairs going down, and on the right there's a grey wall and a beige painting… Walk towards the wall with the painting, turn slightly to your right, and walk up the stairs. Walk all the way up the stairs, and then enter into the room on your left. On the right there's a bed covered with white sheets and on the left there's a brown cushion, walk towards that... On the left there's a set of windows, and your destination is between the cushion and the set of windows.

35538.instruction: You're starting in a library, facing a row of chairs on your right, and a long, locked bookcase on the left. Turn around, and stop at the very end of the longest table that's right in front of you, to your right. You're going to stop on the rug, between the last two chairs at the end of that table. Literally, it's just the one step. So, whenever you're looking at the table, the long table, it's just- you can just see straight down it. That's your end.

35592.instruction: Okay, now you are standing in front of an open entrance, turn right and go straight through the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now you are in the bedroom, slightly turn to your right and go straight through the open entrance, which is on the right side. Now slightly turn to your right and go straight towards the switch board, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to your left and go straight through the arch shape open entrance, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to your right and move forward. Now you are standing next to an open entrance, which is on the right side. Now slightly turn to your left and go straight towards the dining table, which is in front of you. Now you are facing towards the dining table and this is the end point.

35593.instruction: You are facing an entrance of a room. Turn right, walk straight. Turn right, exit the room through the open door. Walk straight, move slightly right and walk straight towards the dining table. Now you are standing in between two pillars and opposite to the dining table. This is the end point.

35660.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the garden. Turn around and move towards your right and pass through the flower plants. Move forward, there will be plants on your left side. Go straight through the walkway. Now, turn slight left. There will be a table and two chairs on your left side. Pass through them and you will find the big entrance on the left side. Enter through it and go straight. You will find a staircase downwards. Take the stairs and go down. You will find a big flower vase in the corner of the steps. Pass through it and take left, you will find another staircase. Get down. Once you reach down, take right. Go towards your right and that will be your end point where there is a pathway in front of you and a portrait on your left side.

35661.instruction: You are in the garden facing towards the other side of the buildings, Turn around and go straight near the plants at the left side, go straight to the plant pot. And move forward Up to the next plant, move forward up to the chairs and some plants near the plants and table and chairs. Take slightly Left turn move forward towards the door at the left side walk through that door And go straight at the staircase near the table. Walk down all the way through the staircase near flower and vase, take left turn walk down through the staircase, take right turn near the door and move forward take slightly right an enter into the corridor. At the right side there is a painting and the left side also.

35724.instruction: You will start by standing on a carpet and in front of you there's a rope. Turn right and walk towards the opening that's closest to you. Walk along the hallway. At the end of this carpet, turn left following the carpet and take one step forward, now you're done.

35757.instruction: We are going to start facing a window. Turn to the right, and let's walk towards the couch with the white pillows. Turn right and walk towards the blue/gray curtains that we can see in front. We should see an open door on the right side of the curtain, we are going to take that door. Go all the way until the end, passing the sinks and that bathroom area, and take the first door on your left. This is the toilet area. Take one step towards the toilet. Once you're here, you're done.

35844.instruction: You begin looking at a bathroom, and a toilet in particular. Turn to your right, and exit the bathroom into the living- or, into the bedroom. You're going to step directly from the bathroom door into the bedroom door, then turn slightly right, move towards the left corner of the bench at the foot of the bed, and then move towards the left side of the armchair to the left of the bed. Once you're standing in front of that armchair's right arm, you're done.

35846.instruction: You begin facing a bunch of plants at the top of a stairwell and some windows, take one step forward and then turn around, facing the same spot that you started from, take one step towards the cabinet at the very end of the room, you should be standing in a doorway, facing the cabinet and a orange seat, you are done.

35862.instruction: You begin on the second story of a wooden home with drums to your left. Turn slightly left from your beginning orientation and move along the railing, towards the stairs. Once you're at the stairs go ahead down. Once you're all the way down the stairs, hop up onto the couch next to them, and once you're on the couch, jump off and move towards the yellow kitchen island. Go ahead between the kitchen island and the counters, and then move into the corner by the fridge. At least I assume that's a fridge... Once you're in the corner you're done.

35987.instruction: You are facing towards the wall in front of you, turn around, go straight, in front of you there is a white color open door, go straight and exit the door, go straight, in front of you there is a room visible to you, go straight near the room and turn around, in front of you there is a white color open door and a room is visible to you, go straight and enter the room in front of you, slightly turn left, go straight, now you are standing beside the bed facing towards the table and two chairs in front of you, stop beside the bed, this is your final destination.

35988.instruction: You are facing the wall, turn left, walk straight. Pass through the bed and move a step forward. Slightly turn left and exit the room through the open door. Walk straight, in the right you have an open entrance, enter into it and turn around. In the opposite you have an open door, enter into the room. Walk straight closer to the bed. In the opposite you have a table with two chairs and this is the end point.

36347.instruction: Now you are facing towards an open door. Turn left. You will see an opening in front of you. Go out through the opening. Turn left. You will see two open door in front of you. Go out through the open doors. Move forward by passing through an open door to your left. Turn left. You will see the steps. Get down the steps. On the sixth step you have reached your destination.

36348.instruction: You are facing towards an open door, turn left, exit the washroom, turn left and exit the empty dressing room. You can see an open door on your opposite, step out of the room through the door, now walk straight in the corridor till you see a staircase on your left, get down few stairs, you are now standing on the fifth stair. You have reached your destination.

36387.instruction: We're going to start inside a kitchen, facing the fridge. Turn to the left. Take one step past the stove on the left, and turn to the left. We now should see a gray couch, we're going to take one step towards the left side of that couch. We shouldn't be looking at the TV on the left side and a lamp on the right side. That is going to be the destination.

36409.instruction: You are facing a corner.  You are going to turn slightly to your right and you are going to go thru the door on your right.  You are going to step into this walkway and move forward.  You will see a console table against the wall in front of you.  You are going to turn to your right and move forward heading towards the opening on your right.  You are going to go up the steps in front of you.  And at the top of the steps you are going to make a right.  You are going to move forward and make another right into this foyer passing a white stool with black and white pillows on it on your right and heading right towards in front of the white and black stand against the wall on your left under a picture.  You are actually going to go right past that white and black table and step right into the doorway on your left.  And once you are in the threshold looking in at a sink and toilet you are done.

36422.instruction: You will be facing an open door, turn left and exit through the door where you can see a black painting. Turn right after exiting the door, and you will see another open door on the right, move towards it. Walk towards the red painting. Walk into the room next to the red painting. On you right there is a bathroom next to the mirror, walk towards it. Stop at the entrance of the bathroom.

36423.instruction: Now you are facing towards an open door. Turn left. You will see an open door in front of you. Go out of the open door. Turn right. You will see another open door. Go towards the open door. You will see another open door in front of you. Move forward to the open door. Go into the open door. Turn slightly right. You will see an opening in front of you. Go towards the opening. Now you are in the entrance of the washroom. You have reached your destination.

36442.instruction: Turn to your left. Go up the steps by the Christmas tree. Its a curvy staircase. When you get to the top go in the first door on the right. Walk past the bed. Stand in front of the sink. Turn to the left. Walk in front of the toilet. Turn to the right. Step into the shower and this is where you end.

36588.instruction: You can find yourself facing towards a swimming pool. Turn to your left and walk straight to the door, through the pathway where towards your left you will find the gym setup. And walk to the corner chair, that is the makeup chair. And from here take slightly left and you will find a three door openings, just walk to the second door which has the massage bed and just walk into the room and Enter the room. And you will find two doors inside it. Walk to the door which has a door mat in front of it, and walk inside the room and stand in front of the stone slab. This is the final endpoint. You have reached the destination.

36589.instruction: You are facing the swimming pool. Turn around, now walk beside the caution board there are some treadmills to your left. Walk straight towards the black colour chair. At the black colour chair, turn left and walk straight. Now enter into the left side open door which has two white beds. Move forward, now enter into the right side open door room and stop facing the marble table, and this is your endpoint.

36658.instruction: You're looking into an office, turn around and take one step out. And then walk to the right of this table towards the room in front of you. And then take a step towards the sofa in this living room . And then turn to the right you'll see some stairs, walk towards these stairs. And then walk down about half way and you'll see a window on you're right and you've reached the end.

36703.instruction: You are in a living room, facing towards a chair. Take a long turn onto your backwards. Walk little straight and exit from the room. Move little forward, you will enter into the other living room. Go forward, you will find the entrance onto your left. Go straight and take a left turn. Exit from the room. Take a right turn, you will find the other entrance of the room. Go straight and enter into the room. Walk little straight. Move straight. Take a left turn. You will find a staircase in front of you. Walk forward. Take a right turn. Now take a left turn. And here is your destination beside the staircase.

36704.instruction: You are facing a chair and a couch. Turn around to exit the door, slightly take a left turn and pass through the couches and the chairs. Towards the right and left there are few portraits. Exit the room, there is a table, turn right and enter the next room. Walk straight, now you are beside the round table. Slightly turn left and walk straight. Walk closer to the steps, you can find a passage to the right. Walk straight and take the immediate left. Now you are standing beside the stairs and opposite to a glass door. This is the end point.

36713.instruction: We are going to start facing four pictures and two lamps on top of a table. Turn around completely. Now, we should see a big couch on the right side and three columns on our left side. There should be an open door on your left as well. We're going to take one step forward between the couch and the big columns, and turn left and exit that living room area using that open door. Take two steps towards the staircase that we can see on our left. Go all the way up the stairs. Take one more step towards the other staircase that we can see in front of us. Once you're here, you should be looking at the set of stairs, and on the right side, we should have a tall tree. That would be the destination.

36736.instruction: You will see a doorway from your starting position. There will be a fireplace on the left and a circular mirror hanging atop. Go through this doorway and into the hall with the lone floor clock. There will be a two way staircase on the left. Go to the stairs on the right and stop when you’re halfway up. You’re done

36742.instruction: You are now facing towards the sofa and the table. Turn left and exit the room, you are now facing towards the white colour sofa. Turn slightly left and walk straight, then walk towards the glass table sorry marble table and also there is a open glass door to your right, then turn left and walk straight towards the open door which is to your left and also there is a portrait beside the wall. You are now facing towards the staircase, climb up the two staircase and stop facing towards the wall, and this is your end point.

36743.instruction: You are inside the room where there is a blue color sofa set onto you left side and a table in front of you. Take a left turn you will find a door which is open step out of the door, you will find yourself in a room where there is white color sofa 2 table lamps on to your right and left side and a open door. Take a slight right few steps ahead you will find a walk way. Walk through the walk way. You will find yourself in a room where there is a table and a flower vase. Onto your right side you have a open door. Now take a left, take few steps towards your left where you can find a rest room and the door is open. Take a right turn you will find staircases take few steps near the staircase and climb two staircases. You have reached your destination.

36767.instruction: Okay now you are in the balcony area facing towards the big windows. Turn to your right, in front of you there is an open door, enter through that open door and turn to your left. Now you are at the entrance of a big hall. Now in front of you there is a chair leaning on the wall, go towards the chair. Turn to your left, now in front of you there is an arch shape entrance, enter through that entrance and go straight, until you reach another room with mat on the floor. Slightly turn to your left and go straight near to the table with portraits on the wall. Turn to your right, now in front of you there are cream color chairs and a big portrait in between the two windows. Go straight near to the portrait and that is the end point.

36768.instruction: Now you are standing in an open area, slightly  turn to your right, you can see an open door, enter into it and take left, you can see an open door in-front of you, go near the open door and enter into another room, now take left, stand beside the second window and take right, stand in between the two brown color chairs and two photo frames on the wall in front of you, that's your end point.

36790.instruction: You are facing a stair case in front of you. Go down the stairs now you are standing in front of a kitchen counter and a vase which has white and blue flowers inside it. Turn left as you come down the stairs near the wooden dining table. Turn left from the end of the dining table near the red pig figure. Go down the stairs when you cross the figure to the hall. Exit through the open door now you are outside patio. Go back from the first door on the left inside the room which has animal carpet sofas on both sides and its a lounge and walk at the back of the leather sofa just near the air condition at the bottom. Turn right from the large white lamp on the animal carpet near the animal carpet and you are done.

36819.instruction: You are facing the corner of this colorful floral pattern wallpapered room. Turn around and step towards the foot of the bed. Now make your way out through this curtained pathway. Take a left and exit the bedroom and into a small hallway. Walk your pretty feet on this elegant red runner and stop on the other end of it. There will be a closed door with a wreath hanging, there will be a tapestry hanging in front of you and multiple rooms on either side. You're done.

36934.instruction: You will start by standing at the top of the stairs. Jump over the couch in front of you and stand in between the coffee table and the arm chair. Turn left and walk up the steps. Take another step forward towards the right side. You will see an opening in front of you. Take one step towards the stairs on your left. Now turn back around and enter the opening on your left. You will see a brown table. Take a step towards the left side of the table. Now stand behind the grey arm chair and you're done.

36974.instruction: Slightly turn right and enter into the small room in front, you can find a rack in front and a door at the left side, at the entrance of the room you can find your destination.

36975.instruction: You're now facing an open door. Enter into it and face towards the open shelf, you will reach your destination.

36990.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a wall. Now turn left and move forward towards the open door which is in front of you and exit the room. Now turn left and move forward towards the back of a sofa and move towards the swimming pool, which is in front of you. Now turn left, there is a walkway in front of you, move forward in the walkway and enter in to the second entrance which is to your left. Now turn left, there is a sink platform and a stove platform in front of you, pass in between them and move towards the wall which is in front of you. Now turn left and move forward towards the steps which are to your right. Now turn right and climb up the steps. Now again turn right, there is a staircase in front of you, climb up the steps and stand in the middle of the staircase and it will be your end point.

36991.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a wall, slightly turn left, you will find a entrance. Move forward and enter the entrance and take left. You will find sofa'son your right, move forward by the sofa's. Once you move forward you will find a swimming pool, take a left in front of the swimming pool. And move move forward and take the second left into a room which enter's into a kitchen area. And you have a white table on your right side. Slightly move forward, you will find a white partition in front of you. Take a left, then after you will find three stairs on your right side. Climb the three stairs and turn right side. You will find a stair case and climb the stairs. Stop in the middle of the stair case and here is your destination.

36994.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the door. Turn slightly right, and move forward, you can see the wash basin in front of you. Now turn left, and move forward, you can see the glass window in front of you. Now turn right, and move forward, you can see the table in front of you, and there is a potted plant on the right side. Now, you have reached your destination."

36995.instruction: You're facing towards a door. Turn right and move forward. Turn left and exit the room from there turn right and walk towards the table. Few steps away from the table is your destination.

37025.instruction: You will start by standing at the foot of the stairs on your left. Take a step in the middle of this little hallway. Facing the round table with a flower pot on top of it. Walk towards the black and white stools on your left. Now turn left and continue to walk forward walking past the kitchen island. You will see a doorway in front of you. Walk towards that. Enter room this room and turn right. Take a step on the doorway of the laundry room and you're done.

37158.instruction: We're going to start by facing a closed wooden door and if we turn slightly behind us we're going to see that we're in a bedroom. we'll notice two open doors. One right next to us on the left and one further back in the room. We're going to go out towards the one that's closest to us. The opened door. We'll see that it leads to small living room and we're going to step out into the room. We're going to turn to the left to see another open door. we're going to go towards the open door. It leads to a passage/hallway thing but we're just going to stop here at the open door.

37360.instruction: You are facing a corner of a kitchen. Turn left so you are facing almost the sink on the counter. Go around that counter to the left and outside of the kitchen.  You want to face to the right where you will see a dark square carpet with a table and chairs that are in front of some windows. Walk to the front of the table. Now turn to your left facing the grey carpet with the white couch and two chairs. Walk straight to the living area as if you are walking to the coffee table with the couch and chairs. Now you are going to go to the end of the couch near the L shape. You will actually be behind the couch at the very edge left corner of the very colorful painting. If you stop right there you will see a pink stripe, an orange stripe and on top of that some green and red. You will be behind the white couch not quite to the L shape and to your left you will see a dark vase with a plant in it. You are done.

37448.instruction: You are facing towards the wall in front of you, turn right, there is a white color open door in front of you, go straight near the white color open door, slightly turn right, enter the door and go straight, there is another open door in front of you, go straight and exit the room, slightly turn right, go straight, now you are inside the bedroom, go straight and stop in front of the mat which is present on the floor and there is a bed in front of you, stop there, this is your final destination.

37449.instruction: You're facing the wall, turn towards your right, and go straight, to the right you'll find frame on the wall, go straight, and enter the room, you're in a bedroom, go near the bed, you'll find cream carpet on the ground, one step away from the bed, you'll find your destination.

37489.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn around and walk straightly in the corridor till you find an open door on your right side. Slightly turn right and walk through the open door. Now turn right and move towards the open entrance. Now walk straightly towards the round wooden table. Slightly turn left and move towards the staircase. Slightly turn left and walk all the way to the top of the stairs. There is an open room in front of you. Slightly turn right and enter into the room. Now you are standing in front of the wooden cabinets. Turn left and move towards the black movable chair. That will be the end point.

37490.instruction: "Now your are facing towards wall turn towards your backside you can see a swimming pool walk towards it. There you can see plant pots beside of it there is an glass door walk inside it. Take immediate right after entering into the door. There finds your kitchen. Beside kitchen there is a way enter into it. It can take you to upstairs through steps. there you can find cabin which consist of two chairs on front side on the other end there is other chair go and stand near the black chair. Your destination point has been reached."

37559.instruction: Starting it looks like in an office space. Turn around, you can see there is a staircae to your right and directly ahead of you is a big opening in the far distance. Step to that opening in the far distance. once you are there you see there is a piano and two double doors leading to oustide behind it. Step in front of these double doors. Once you are directly in front of these doors you are done.

37701.instruction: You are in the washroom, facing towards the washbasin. Turn around, exit the washroom and reach the entrance of the bedroom, from here move towards the open entrance. Turn slightly right, and move towards the wall, from here turn left and go straight, till you reach the entrance to the backyard. When you reach the entrance of the backyard, turn left and move towards the table lamp, now you are standing behind the couch, facing towards the lamp, and a glass door is on your right side, this is your end point.

37702.instruction: You are in front of a mirror in a washroom, turn around and walk through the door. You enter into a bedroom, keep moving forward in front of the bed and go near the brown color door. Walk through the door and you enter a corridor. Turn towards your slight right and walk beside a black color chair, on your right. Turn towards your right, you can find an other corridor. Walk beside a glass door on your right and keep moving forward near the wall in front of you. Go near the wall and turn left, you can find a glass dining table, keep moving forward beside the glass dining table and you can find an other wooden separation. Go pass through that wooden separation and you enter into a living area, which has white color sofa sets on your left. Keep moving forward, near the glass entrance in front of you and turn towards your left. Walk beside that glass entrance and go near a brown color table, which has a lamp on it. You reached your destination.

37918.instruction: We're in a bedroom, and we're facing towards a wooden table with two chairs, turn towards the right, actually, turn around, turn towards the right... Actually turn around and exit the room, on your left there's a potted plant, walk past that plant, turn slightly to the left and you'll come across a grey sofa, turn slightly to the left... Once you reach the staircase, you've reached your destination... You'll be facing towards two windows and that's it for you.

38050.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn right and walk in the narrow space till you see a staircase on your right, climb the stairs, take right and walk straight till you see an open door on your opposite, step into it, you can see another open door on your opposite, step into that as well, you are now at the entrance of a washroom, turn around, turn right and walk straight towards the white curtain, get closer to the curtain, you have now stepped out of the room. Turn left, you are now at the entrance of a bedroom, step into it, slightly turn right and walk towards the glass railing. You are now facing towards a beautiful view of the city, you have reached your destination.

38051.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn right and walk straight till you reach the steps towards your right side. Turn right and climb the steps. Slightly turn right and walk straight till you reach the open door in the front. There are three paintings towards your left side. You are now standing beside the open door. Walk two steps ahead till you reach another open door in the front. Turn left and walk towards the plant. Slightly turn right. Walk straight towards the curtain and exit the room. Turn left. You are now standing in the bedroom. Enter into the bedroom and slightly turn right. Stand in front of the glass railing beside the plant. You have reached your point.

38089.instruction: You're standing in a doorway in a white room with a window looking outside. If you turn around you'll see a hallway and you'll walk to the right to the end of the highway. You'll pass an open door. Pass another open door with a white desk and a black chair in it and a window. Take another step and you should be standing in front of a glass window and you've reached the end.

38259.instruction: Now you are standing in a balcony, move towards left, you can see a blue colored open door enter into the room and move forward, you can see a bed to your left and a bath tub to your right, move forward till the open entrance which is in-front of you, now take right you can see an open door to your right side, stand near the open door, that is your end point.

38260.instruction: Right now you're standing in a balcony. Turn towards you're left side and you can see a half opened door. Enter into the room through that half opened door. Now you can see a bed on the left side and a wash tub on the right side. Move forward and now you can see a green chair in front of you. Turn slightly towards you're right side and walk towards that opened door and that is the end point.

38343.instruction: You are in a shower. Turn around and step over the brown bathmat and stand in front of the white towels that are hanging on the rack. Turn right. Step in front of the tv. Turn slightly right and hop over that square in the middle towards the sink diagonal from you. Turn slightly right towards the open doorway. Walk through said doorway. You're in a hallway with a family photo on the left and another sink and a microwave on the right. You are going to step out of this hallway onto the wood floor, and then you're going to stop when, right after you get through that archway when your standing with that open wood door out of this bedroom to your left. And that's the end.

38362.instruction: You're standing outside in front of a building. Behind you there's a set of stairs, in front of you there's double doors. Walk through the double doors. Continue to walk through the second set of double doors. You're now in a large room with wooden floors, to your right there's a stair set, to your left there's two armchairs. Continue to walk forward past the bear statue. Walk towards the fireplace on your left. Continue to walk forward past the stairs on your right. Take a right and go half way up the stairs. Turn around and go towards the doorway next to the carpeted hallway. Continue to walk down the carpeted hallway. Past the painting on the wall. Walk pass the doorway on your right. Take a right into the room before the exit sign. Walk into the room towards the bed in the middle. Walk to the left of the bed. And you've reached the end.

38468.instruction: You will start by standing in a bedroom. Right in front of you there's an opening. Exit this bedroom. On your right there is a pool and in front of you there is an opening which is on the right side of the painting of a car. Continue to walk inside this opening. You will see a sink on your right and you will see the toilet. Once you are inside this room then you're done.

38520.instruction: You're starting in an unfinished bathroom in a room with cedar paneling. Go out the open door toward the plant. And then walk through the open door just to the left of the plant, into what looks like a bedroom. Once in this bedroom, there will be a closet on the left hand side. Go inside that closet and you are finished.

38521.instruction: You are facing the door, enter the room and go straight you can see brown table, turn left there you can see the door open, now enter the left side room, now you have entered into the kitchen area stand infront of the stove, that would be your final destination.

38546.instruction: Right now your facing towards the wall turn right and move forward, now turn slightly right and keep moving in a forward direction towards the mirror in front of you. 52989.instruction: Right now you are at the open area, turn back, there you will find a table with chairs, go near the table, and now take right, there you will find a door, enter into the door, now you will find a round table with black chairs, go near the table and go straight, you will find stair case, walk to the top of the stairs, there you will find three chairs in front of you, and on the left side you will find sink, walk in between the sink and the chairs, and now turn right and go straight, and on the left side you will find open area with two chairs and a round table, now go straight near the table and turn left, now you will find two couches in front of you, go near there and take right, you will find bed, now go near the bed, that will be your final destination.

Continue moving forward, you will see an open doorway on your right and you will see a round table in the middle with lots of things on it.  You are going to head towards that table.  Once you are in between the table and the long narrow table with lots of chairs you are going to veer to the right and head towards a marble table statue.  Once you are standing next to that white marble tower statue you are going to go thru a walk way.  In front of you will be a large mirror on the wall and you are going to veer to the left thru that walk way. You are going to enter the first room on your right.  You have entered a bedroom. You are going to hop over the corner of the foot of the bed towards the open door.  You are going to enter that open door.  And you will see a towel rack on the wall on your left and a chair on your right against the wall.  You are going to go slightly past the chair on your right against the wall and stop right next to the chair.  There will be a little floor lamp next to the chair and you are done.

65347.instruction: Walk out the bathroom, once you get to the foot of the bed, take a right just before the TV and walk outside, keep walking straight towards the blue basketball court, short of the blue basketball court take a right and walk to the end of the basketball court on your left and the fence on your right. Keep walking around the basketball court keeping the fence on your right and the court on your left. Once you reach the end of the court, where you're facing the green lawn out in front of you and on the left a couple archways to get back underneath. Stay to the left archway, keeping the court on your left and the archway will be just to the right in front of you. Standing in front of the pillar between the two arch ways, you're done.

65611.instruction: You begin facing a doorway, go through it, go through the powder room into the hallway and then go to the right of the hallway, go through the doorway and then turn into the room immediate to your right, it will be  a bathroom, stand in front of the toilet and you're done.

65636.instruction: You are facing towards the steps. Turn around and walk straightly through the open door. Slightly turn right and walk straightly till you find black railings in front of you. Now you are standing in front of the black railings and there is a dining table behind you. That will be the end point.

65637.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the stair case. Turn around, you can see the open door in front you. Now slightly move forward, you can see the railing in front of you. Now, you have reached your destination."

65654.instruction: You are standing at the entrance of the room, facing towards the open glass door, take slight right and move towards the white couch. 65957.instruction: Facing the glass wall with a reflection of an exit sign in one room and a white table in the next one. Turn to your left, past the exit sign, down the hallway. Straight ahead will be an open office. When you get to the black chair, you have arrived.

67314.instruction: You're facing towards the washroom sink, turn around slightly turn to your right, walk a few steps forward, you can see an open wooden door exit the door, and slightly turn to your left, go straight and slightly turn to your right, walk a few steps forward, now you can see an open wooden door towards your right, enter the door, you have a narrow path in front of you, go straight, now from the carpet slightly turn to your right, you're facing towards a small bed, cross the bed and walk towards the open wooden door, stand facing towards the open wooden door and that is your final destination.

67315.instruction: You're standing near the door facing the white wash basin, turn around, then turn right, and go straight, exit the room, and turn left, go near the wall where you'll find photo frame, from there turn right, and go straight, again to the right you'll find frame on the wall, from there turn right, to the left you'll find chairs, and table, go straight along the chairs, at the end, to the left you'll find plant pots on the railing, from there turn right, you'll find bed, at the end you'll find one open door, stop in front of the door, which is your final destination.

67385.instruction: You're facing towards a wall. Turn left and exit the room. 67386.instruction: You are now facing to the corner of the room, from there take a left turn. Start walking straight out of the room and stand in front of the white color door. Enter into the room which is in front of you beside the black color door and start walking straight and stand in front of the wall where there are some stickers placed on it.

67511.instruction: You are at the corner of the room with the wood table with an old fasioned that is wired into the wall. There is.. Past the loveseat is an exit to the room in front of what looks like three vertically stacked, round, quarter circle shelves. Ok. You are now looking at an entryway with a few doors. Take the door that is lined with the white big blocky bricks on your left. You are in a room. On your right is a stairwell. On the left there is some kind of wooden curved shelved. If you look along and past that wood shelving there is a door. Go to the door. On your right is a metal gate. Stand in front of that metal gate. Now turn directly around. In front of you there are two plants in white curved pots go stand to the right of the most right plant. Now you see a curved covered walkway. And on the left side of that curved walkway is going to be the outside. Ok. You are going to see, two round barrel cactuses and that's going to be between two metal poles. You are going to step, I guess that's three, once you get closer you can tell it's three little barrel cactuses. You are going to step off the walkway. Past those barrel cactuses. The final point will be between that tree and that closest metal pole.

67533.instruction: You're starting in an entryway, facing a hallway with two steps. Go ahead and walk up the steps toward the table in front of you. Once you're in the middle, between all the arches, you'll take a right and go down that hallway. You'll pass the mirror with the silver fancy frame around it and go through the arch into the hallway. Once you are standing right in front of the bookshelf, in between the red couch and the desk, you're done.

67594.instruction: Face the patio furniture, walk to ti, turn left just before, walk through the open door inside, walk behind the salmon chair and around the living room furniture. step to the right of the two pillars just into the kitchen and turn left immediately before the counter, past  the candle sticks on the wall turn right down the path on your right and then left through the first open door. Stop

67603.instruction: Slightly turn to your left from the place you are standing, you can find a chair to your left, go near the first chair, slightly turn to your right, you can find an opened door, go near the opened door and step out of the house, you can find steps infront of you, stand on the fifth step, that would be your end point.

67604.instruction: Move forward. Turn right. Go on to the steps. Go forward. Go forward. Go forward. Go forward. Please ascend the steps. You have reached your destination.

67626.instruction: Slide little left and walk straight towards the open door and enter into the house, now slide left and walk straight along the path, now slide left towards the open door, enter into the room, now slide left towards the open entrance beside the lamp, now slide left towards the open door and enter into the bathroom and you have reached your destination.

67627.instruction: Right now, you're facing towards the small pillar. Slightly turn left and move forward towards the opened door in front of you. Enter into the room and move towards the railings. 67654.instruction: You're facing a shower curtain, turn around. Move out of the bathroom. On the right you will find a door which leads outside the room. Turn left, move towards the sofa. Continue straight towards the chest. Turn left, move forward towards the coffee table. Continue straight. Move forward towards the wall where you can find a lampshade on the right. And it is your destination.

67703.instruction: Right now you are facing a table and a television move towards the right, here you can see an open door get out of the door take right now towards your right, you can see the upstairs, go upstairs until you reach the wall now take left and go again upstairs, take left where you can a glass door move towards it get out of the door where you can see a balcony move out of the door and here you reached the destination point.

67704.instruction: Right now you're facing towards the cupboards. Now turn right and move a bit forward, there is an open door to your left. Now turn left and exit the room. Now you are facing towards a cabinet with a doll on it. Now turn behind, there is a closed door to your right with a curtain to it, move towards the door and slightly turn left. Now exit the room and stand in the balcony facing towards the pillars and it is your end point.

67765.instruction: "Now you are facing towards the stairs, climb the stairs and enter the right side room, which is near by portrait, you can find the bed go near it, walk forward and enter the first right room, stand in front of the door, that will be your final destination."

67766.instruction: You are facing towards a staircase, climb the stairs, slightly turn right and walk towards the open door on your opposite, enter into the room through the door, turn right, walk towards the bed, turn right, take a few steps ahead, turn right and enter into the room through the open door. 67783.instruction: Right now you are facing a lamp, now turn around and move towards the white chair, which is in front of you, now take right and move forward towards the white chair, which is beside the staircase, this is your end point.

67784.instruction: You are facing towards the stool take a about turn, move forward take a right turn you can see a white chair, go and stand back side of that white chair.

The closet is your final destination.

67985.instruction: Now you are facing to the arch. Turn to your left, you can see three steps, get down, pass through the open door and move forward and turn left, there is a brown cupboard beside the bed move towards it and stop.
