Go all the way down to the right of the brown door. Once you are there in the corner, you are done.

85516.instruction: Look around, you're currently standing at the entrance of two white doorways. Take one step forward and walk down the marble staircase on the right. Once you're at the end of the white marble staircase, turn around and face left and take one step forward towards round brown table with a white flowers on top, with white flowers on top. Now turn, around face left and walk straight towards the living room. Once you're in the living room, you'll see two white sofas and a black piano. Veer towards your right, keeping the black piano to your left. Once you're at the entrance of a new room, take one step forward behind the blue couch and veer towards your left, keeping the white doors overlooking outside to your left and the blue couch to your right. Take two steps forward until your right in front of the fish aquarium. Once you, once you're right in front aquarium and you see a blue mat behind you, under a white coffee table, you're done.

85535.instruction: You are standing on the staircase facing towards the painting which is attached to the wall. Turn left and walk all the way to the top of the stairs. Slightly turn right and walk straightly in the till you find a table which has a lamp and a telephone on it. Slightly turn left and walk through the open door. Now you are in the bedroom. Turn left and move forward. Now you are standing in front of the suitcases facing towards the glass window. There is a bed on your left side. That will be the end point.

85536.instruction: You're facing a portrait and you're on the staircase. Go up the staircase. You will find a siting area on your right, go straight  and you will find a open door beside the table lamp which is on your right and, piano which is on your left, go straight into that door and enter the room and you will find a bed, go straight and stand beside the bed and in front of the luggage. It is your final destination.

85560.instruction: You will start by standing in between the living room and the glass window on your right. Take a step forward. Take a step on the hallway to your right. Once you've done that you will see a stone wall and a staircase behind it. Take a step on the left side of the stone wall and you're done.

85645.instruction: You're going to start facing a black and red cabinet. Turn slightly to the left, and walk towards the blue couch that we have in the middle of the two red couches. Now, we should see an open door that leads to a long hallway. We are going to take that glass door. We should have a statue, a red statue/figure on the right side. We're going to keep going straight, when the path is smaller, we're going to turn this lightly slightly to the right, and we should see a big tree in front of us, we should see two trees, one small and one large. We're going to walk towards the large one. We should be standing next to the tree. If we'll look to the left, we're going to see the glass railing. If we turn to the right, we're going to see the small tree and the right figure. We are done.

85699.instruction: Right now you're facing a wall. Now turn left and move a bit forward, you can see a curtain in front of you. Now turn left, you can see a sofa, a table and a fireplace in front of you, move forward towards the fire place and stand in front of it and it will be your end point.

85700.instruction: Okay, now you are facing towards the wall, turn to your left and enter the room through the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to your left and move towards the fire place, which is in front of you and that is the end point.

85725.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing and go straight. Now you are in front of the red couch. Now turn right and go straight. Now slightly turn left. 85726.instruction: You find yourself in a living room facing towards a black and red couch. Turn right and step forward, you find yourself facing a black pillar. Turn around and go forward near the dinning table. Step forward near the glass dining table, you find yourself next to the glass dining table and facing the wall. This is your final point.

85774.instruction: You are standing at a threshold of a room, turn left and take few steps towards the foot of the bed, turn right and proceed towards the tub in front of you, once you are inside the tub, step down and walk inside the open door inside a washroom, the pot is on your right and the shower on your left, take one step inside the shower , you are done.

85775.instruction: You begin standing in a door next to a balcony with a loud leopard print sectional in front of you. Step around the leopard print sectional, onto the dark shag rug. Continue to move along the shag rug towards Spiderman. Keep going, keeping Spiderman on your left, as you move towards the Pulp Fiction poster, past the candy laden table on your left. Continue past the Pulp Fiction poster, into the more narrow hallway to its right, and keep going forward past the wooden door. You will see a staircase and banisters on your left but avoid those and keep going forward, into the hallway across from where you entered the banister area, and up the two steps into the room past them. You should soldier on forward towards the wooden desk slash table, and then towards the white armchair beyond. Once you're at the near corner of the white chair, on its light gray rug, head left towards the bookshelf. Once you're standing between the black bookshelf and the white chair, you're done.

85890.instruction: Now you are facing to the projector screen. Turn to your left and move towards it and turn right, you can see a couch move towards it, on your right there is a open entrance move forward, go beside the pillar, now pillar is on your right, if you look forward there is a swimming pool move towards it, now you are facing the swimming pool. On your right there is a small railing and stop.

85891.instruction: You are facing towards the screen, turn left and move out of this room. You are facing towards the wall, turn right and move towards the sofa. Now you are standing behind the sofa, turn slight right and move out of this house. Turn slight left and move towards the narrow path. Turn slight right and move towards the railing. You are facing towards the pool and to your opposite there is a railing, which is your final destination.

85914.instruction: You are facing towards the staircase. Turn around and move towards the purple couch. Slightly turn left and walk straightly towards the staircase. Turn left and climb the steps. Now move straightly towards the bar chairs in the kitchen. Slightly turn left and move towards the refrigerator. Slightly turn right and walk straightly towards the red cupboards beside the stove. Turn left and exit the kitchen. Now you are in the open area standing near the two chairs. Turn left and walk towards the red relaxing chairs in the bedroom. Walk straightly and exit the room. There is a staircase in front of you. Walk down the stairs and stand on the third step. That will be the end point.

85915.instruction: Right now you are in front of the steps, turn back, you will find red and blue sofas, go near the blue sofa, on the left side you can see blue chairs and steps, go near the steps, go up there you will enter into a kitchen, you can find three chairs in front of you, keep moving forward and go near the stove, on the left side you can find a door, now step out of the kitchen, you will enter into open area with two chairs and round table, go near the table and turn left, you will find a door, now enter into the room, you will find two chairs, now keep moving forward and exit from the room, you will find steps, now get down of the steps, there will be your final destination.

85927.instruction: Now you are facing towards the door, slightly move towards the right and exit the room, now take right and enter into the bedroom, take right and move forward, you can see a white color cabinet to you are left side and open door to you are right side, exit the room and take left through an open arch and move forward till the end of closed door which is in-front of you, now take right, there is an open door to your right, enter into it and stop near the toilet seat, that is your end point.

85928.instruction: You are in the washroom facing towards the open door. Slightly turn right and exit the washroom. Now turn left and move towards the bed. Turn right and move towards the white cabinet. Again turn right and exit the bedroom. Now you are facing towards the wall. Turn left and walk straightly in the hallway till you reach near the closed door in front of you. Now turn right, there is an open arch in front of you. Slightly turn right and walk through the open door. Now you are in the washroom standing near the commode. That will be the end point.

85960.instruction: You begin facing a opening, turn around and go forward, then turn to your right, you see 2 white chairs, take a step between the 2 white chairs, and then turn to your right again, you will see a long table with a bunch of black chairs, go towards the right side of that table, there will be painting, a large painting of some ships on the wall, keep that painting next to you and the table to your left and just go forward towards the staircase, once you get to the staircase, turn to your right and take a step behind the black office chair in the study, you are done.

86109.instruction: You are facing a TV.  You are going to turn around and you will see you are in a bedroom.  There will be a bed to the left of you and to the right a seating area.  You are going to walk in between the bed and the seating area.  And you will see a sink in front of you on the wall to the left there will be an entrance way. You are going to go towards that couch.  Once next to the couch if you look forward you will see to your right an archway into a large room and next to it you will see on the wall a mirror with 2 candle holders on each side of the mirror on the wall, you are going to go towards that. Once you are next to that you will see on your left a door opening into a room with a wood floor and you can see a vanity and a round mirror over the vanity.  You are going to walk in the door and step in front of that vanity and you are done.

86150.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn right and move a bit forward. There are two open rooms in front of you. Slightly turn right and enter into the open room. That will be the end point.

86151.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn slightly right and move towards the glass door in the left. Now you are facing towards the two room. Now you are facing towards the wash basin and there is a mirror above it. 86195.instruction: We're facing a study room. Let's turn around and go straight, passing dining room. Keep going straight. We should be able to see a staircase. Climb up the stairs. Enter the very first room we see in front of us, and stop at the doorway.

86267.instruction: You are facing towards the open glass door, turn left and move towards the round dining table, from here turn left and stand on the third step, now turn right and climb the step, now turn slightly right and stand at the entrance of the narrow space, this is your end point.

86268.instruction: You are facing towards the open glass door, turn back and move towards the orange color sofa, turn slight left and move towards the dining table, turn left and move towards the stairs, go up the stair, turn right and move towards the orange color door, this is your end point.

86275.instruction: You begin looking directly at a wooden wall with a painting. Turn far to the left, like, all the way around, nearly, and towards the foot of a bed with large bedposts. Keep moving to the right of that bed, through a sliding wooden door, and then go straight forward past the painting on your right and some bar stools. Once you're nearly, nearly past those bar stools, you're going to take a right past the bar and towards a lit up bathroom that you can see a light bordered mirror through the open door. At least, you can see a part of that mirror. Once you're standing in front of that door, turn left and enter the movie room with the horrible shiny couch that seems to be overtaking the room, like a... Like a blood borne infection, just spreading. It looks like this couch was deposited in the room some time ago and has just slowly grown to fill the space, and then overtaken the nearby walls with its horrible dimpled surface. Absolutely terrible. Move to the left side of that couch, all the way across the room from the entrance, and you are done.

86276.instruction: Our starting point is in a living room, and we're facing towards two black chairs and a red and white rug, turn towards the right... We're facing towards two room, on the room on the right there's an empty shelf and on the left there's a staircase, walk towards the room on the left, walk down the staircase, you're now facing a seating area, which has a brown sofa with some black and brown pillows, turn to towards the right... In front of you there's a staircase, walk down the staircase, pass the door on your right, and continue walking down the staircase, and once you land you'll come cross a long white sofa, turn towards the right slightly, in front of you there's an exit to a patio, on your right there's a black chair, take three steps forward and your destination is between the chair and the sofa and you'll be facing towards the sofa.

86340.instruction: You are facing towards the open door, move forward towards it, now turn left and move towards the curtain, now turn right and move forward towards the small shelf, now turn right and move towards the closed door, now you are standing in front of the closed door, this is your end point.

86341.instruction: You're facing towards a door entrance exit the door turn slight left towards the curtain. From there turn right and exit the door. Move forward towards the wooden chair. From there turn right in front, you can see a door is closed. Few steps away from the door is your destination.

86347.instruction: We start off looking up a flight of stairs. As you turn around you look down the stairs. Take one step down the stairs and take a step towards the center area in the white tile. Turn to your right and face the circular table in the center. With a cushion chair on one side of the table and the cushion chair on the other side closest to the flight of stairs that you just walked down. Take one step in front of that cushion chair on your right. Take another step towards the living room area. You will now see three couches or two couches and two chairs. You are going to walk between those two couches and chairs . And continue to walk until you have taken a step outside. You will now see patio furniture in front of you and a table with two blue pots. Hop over the table and take two steps towards the pool. To the right of the pool you will see circular lounge chair and other lounge chairs behind it. Walk in between those lounge chairs and the pool. And continue to walk down that path until you have reached the cabanas in the back. Once you have reached the cabanas slightly turn to your right and you will see two steps and a pair of double doors. Take a step to the right of those double doors and you will now be facing more patio furniture. Take one step forward and you will now see that there is a couch on one side and two chairs on the other side. Take one step towards the chair closest to you.

86367.instruction: We start off looking at a chair a grey chair at the head of a dining table. Turn to your left so that the dining table will be on your right hand side. Walk around the dining room table to the other head chair. You'll now be facing into um or towards bookshelves. Take the open doorway in front of the bookshelves. Turn right walk down the hall and you'll see a zebra painting on your right. And the back left you'll see an open door. There'll be like a dividing walk next to that open door. Take a step next to that dividing wall and you'll actually be now be looking into a hallway into another room. Walk down that hallway passing the closet and you'll get to the first doorway that has the restroom. Take a step into the restroom next to the sink stop there you are done.

86368.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a brown colour chair, turn right and move forward and exit the room. So that you will find a bed in front of you and a door opened beside the bed. Enter into the door and you will find a door opened in front of you. Enter into the door and you will find a dinning table on your right and a table kept with some things on your left. Slightly move forward and you will find a door opened in front of you. Enter into the door and turn right, you will find a cupboard with wine bottles in it. Move forward towards the cupboard and here is your destination.

86369.instruction: You are standing in-front of a chair facing towards the window, turn right and move forward. You can see an open door, enter into the bedroom. Now turn right and move towards the bed. You can see an open door right in-front of you, move towards the door. Now step out of the bedroom. Now keep moving forward, you can see a path in between the round table and the dinning table, move in the path till you reach open door which are right in-front of you. Move few steps ahead. You are facing towards a shelves filled with glasses and other items, turn right and move towards the shelves with wine bottles. You are standing next to the shelves with glasses, the position you are standing is your final destination.

86379.instruction: At the top of the stairs, facing the two closed white doors, take a step towards those closet doors and turn to your right, you'll see a stairway going up, take those stairs. It's only three steps, once you're at the top, you'll see a statue to the right, you'll see a chair to the left that looks like it's at a dinner table probably, walk just the right of that chair on the left. Now, turn back to your right, walking between the end of the red wall on the right and the kitchen island on the left. Go right, there's more stairs tucked in behind the red wall. Ascend those wooden stairs to the right. Continue onto the purplish floor in front of you in the room where there's two yellow futon looking beds. Head to the right, in front of the farthest right bed. Still facing the bed from the foot of it, with two grey pillows. Jump over the right side and head towards the second set of visible windows on the right side of the wall. Close to the blue or purple bed in the distance behind the curtains. Once you've reached there, orient yourself so the windows are on your right, the new purplish bed is on your left, straight ahead you can see the bathtub. Walk straight toward the bathtub, stopping at the wicker basket just in front to the right of the tub. Once you're there, you're done.

86507.instruction: You are now facing towards a glass window, turn to your left and move forward. You are now standing near a painting on the wall, turn around and exit the room through the open door. You are now at the entrance of a bedroom, turn around and move forward. you are facing a potted plant, turn slightly left and move forward. You are now standing facing a portrait on the wall, turn to your right and enter the bedroom through the open door, turn slightly right and move forward. Can see an open arch in front of you. Enter the arch. You are now standing in between  white cabinets on your right side and an open bathroom door on your left and that is your end point.

86508.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a closed door and a window. Slightly turn left and you can see a portrait in front of you. Move towards that portrait. Now turn left and exit the room. Right now you're facing towards a white glass door. Slightly turn right and move forward. Here you're facing at the edge of a wall, where on the right side you can see a small potted plant and on the left side you can see a portrait. Turn left and move towards the portrait. Now turn right and enter into the room. Now slightly turn right and move forward in between the couch and the bed. There is a entrance in front of you. Move towards the entrance and stand at the starting point of the washroom and that is the end point.

86509.instruction: You are going to start facing some stairs going up. Turn right. Take one step towards the stairs in front of you. Turn left. Walk to the right of the round table with the flowers. Take another step towards the right of the mirror. Turn right, and take the room on your right with the staircase. Once you are inside the room, you are going to take the stairs going down. Once at the bottom, turn left, take one step towards the black bench and turn right. Take two steps towards the bar stools. Turn slightly right, and take the archway that is on the right side of the bar stools. Pass the rectangular table on your right and turn left. Take two more steps inside the area towards the pool table, and stop right in front of the second trash can and the telephone on your left. That is your destination.

86510.instruction: You are going to start facing a locker. Turn 90 degrees to the right and walk all the way down. Take that door that you have in front of you to exit that area. Take one more step towards the reception area that you are going to see on your right, and now you are going to turn to your left. There is...  you should see two doors ahead of you, you are going to take the one on the right. This is a men's bathroom. You are going to walk all the way down that hallway. Pass the lockers, and almost at the end of the hallway, there is an opening on the right, take that opening, and stand right in front of the sink before the showers. Once you are there, you are done.

86578.instruction: You are facing a bed, slightly turn right and take one step towards the brown chair, slightly turn right and go forward and exit the room through the opened door, go forward towards the brown railing, go forward through the corridor, until you reach the last room on to the left side with an opened door, here at the entrance of the last room with an opened door you have reached the destination.

86579.instruction: Right now you are standing in a balcony area. Make a slight right near to the single chair and go closer near to the open door. Step out the room and make a slight left turn and walk through the corridor. At the left side you will find a entrance. Here we reached our destination near the open entrance.

86655.instruction: You are facing towards a cupboard, turn around and go one step forward, slightly turn right and go forward towards the wall, go forward towards the couch, slightly turn right and go one step forward, slightly turn left and go forward towards the opened glass door, go forward towards the chairs, go forward towards the table which is in front of the chairs, go forward towards the pillar, now you are beside a chair, go forward towards the plants, continue going forward in the path which is beside the pool until you reach the end of the path, now go forward towards the railing which is in front of you, slightly turn right and go forward, here beside the two small pillars you have reached the destination.

86656.instruction: Right now we are facing towards the cupboard slightly take left and move forward in front you can see the dinning table, slightly take right on the right you can see the portrait and walk behind the chairs in front you can see the sofa set move towards it slightly take right in front you can see the open glass sliding door move forward and get out of the room in front you can see the sofa set move towards it, slightly take left in front you can see the pillar move towards it slightly take right and move forward near to the bushes, slightly take left and move forward where you can see the stone pillar move forward in front you can see the three stairs get down the three stairs on the left you can see the swimming pool move little forward on the right you can see the grass move little forward in front you can see the two steps climb up the steps and take right on the left you can see the metal railing move little forward, now you are in between the stone pillars and this is your final destination.

86728.instruction: We're going to start in the dining room area with a round table on the left side, and a kitchen in front of us. We're going to take two steps toward the kitchen. Turn to the right, and walk between the sink and I think that's the dishwasher. Keep surrounding the kitchen island. Now, we should see a china cabinet on the left side, and a couple of colored plates on the right side, we're going to take that hallway there. Now, we should be facing a large dining room area with chandelier, and on the left side, we should have a round mirror, we're going to just take one step straight into the, towards the fish tank that we can see in front. Now, we should be facing a telephone on the wall, the fish tank in front of us, and on the right side, the big dining room table. That is going to be the destination.

86880.instruction: You begin facing a glass door and a pool area, turn around, you will see a main entrance, with a white rug next to it, next to a kitchen, take 3 steps towards that entrance, and then right before you go out the entrance, turn to your left, you will see a walkway with a mirror to the left, take 2 steps going down this walkway, turn to your right, head into the washroom on the very right, take 3 steps in the washroom, once you're in front of the toilet, you're done.

87035.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a lamp. Now turn behind and exit the room. There is a walkway in front of you, move forward in the walkway up to the end. Where you can see a closed glass door in front of you, move towards the door and pass through it and stand in the balcony facing towards the trees and it is your end point.

87036.instruction: You are facing towards the table lamp, turn left and move towards the door. Now move out of this room. Slightly turn left and move towards the closed door which is opposite to you. Now you can see an exit board on top the door, move into the balcony. Now you are standing near the railing, the position you are standing is your final destination.

87370.instruction: You'll start with an open door to your left, and looking through glass looks like a whole bunch of cardboard boxes. You're going to turn around and you'll see another open door, and kind of see an exit sign. You're going to step over to that door. Once you get to this door you're going to look straight, and go down the hallway passing the fire extinguisher to your right and looks like the fax to your left, or the copy machine. Once you get to the end of this hallway to your right should be red stairs, you're going to look left and you're going walk all the way down this hallway passing all the doors on your left hand side. Once you get to the end of this hallway you can either go left or right, you're going to want to head and go left, you';re going to pass your first door on your right, and once you pass the first door on your right you're going to step into the second door, and once you do that you have reached your destination.

87474.instruction: For your start point you are in a home theater. In front of you there is, it looks like it's over 80 inch flat screen TV or projector that is surrounded by four wall speakers. Once you are in between the doorway straight across you will see a picture of a woman behind a Champaign glass. Turn to the left exiting the room. On the right you will now see an open doorway that leads to an outdoor balcony.Pass that open doorway going down the stairs. Once you are in the doorway move forward passing the hall on your left and passing the hanging portrait on your right. Sorry its not a microwave its actually a white TV. So once you are in front of the white bar stool that has the potatoes in the ceramic bowl.

87487.instruction: You're standing on the stairs facing towards the wall. Walk up to the stairs and move forward towards the glass door. Make an exit from the glass door, go near the railing. 87488.instruction: Right now you are facing the wall and you are on your stairs. Turn to your left and climb up the stairs. Once you climb up the stairs, in-front of you you can see a glass door which leads out side of the house. Walk straight towards the glass door and you can see a black dining table to your right. From the dining table walk straight and you can see a door which is to your left and is open. Enter into that room. Once you enter into the you see a brown table to your right and a brown vase to your right corner. Walk towards the vase and take a  left. Now you can see a abstract painting to your right. You see a small glass table and a lamp on it. Go near the table and stop. This is the end point

87573.instruction: Now you are facing towards the cupboards. Turn left. Move forward towards the bed. Turn left. Move forward towards the open door to the left. Turn left. Move forward beside the washbasin. You have reached your destination.

87574.instruction: You are facing towards the yellow colored wall, turn left, exit the closet room, and move towards the bed, now turn left and move towards the open doors, now turn left and enter the washroom, now you have a washbasin on your right side, this is your end point.

87674.instruction: You begin on a bed, looking towards a window. Get off the bed with your dirty feet, they don't belong there. Move out of the door of the bedroom. Once you step out of the doorway, you should see an open door to the left, and further down that hallway, several more doors. But you're not going to go through those two doors, you're going to go to the right, once you're out in that hallway. Follow the runners until the end of that hall and the open white door, and then continue through the open white door, moving next to a small Christmas tree, and then behind a writing desk. You're going to have your face pressed right up against a closed door, that leads outside. And I'm just gonna want you to melt straight through that door, just, press yourself up against it and try really hard to melt out onto the porch. Having achieved osmosis through the door, you are going to the left, next to a wrought iron bench. The door's still closed mind you, you went through the door. Not through the doorway, through the DOOR, just straight through. Maybe you seeped through its hinges, or maybe you phased through it astraly, like a phantom. Up to you, I suppose, anyways, just step in front of that wrought iron bench and you're done. That'll be on the left side, that wrought iron bench. It's- it's a neat bench, you should sit at it but not- not now, later... Because you're done, now.

87733.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a glass open door. Make a slight right in front you can see a open door just enter into it and move forward in front you can see a another open door just enter into it and move forward. On you are right side you can see a bear. Turn to you are right and move forward, on you are left side you can see a fire camp. From there move forward, turn to you are right in front you can see a staircase. Just climb the four steps stand on the fourth step and turn towards you are left. In front you can see a narrow path walk through the narrow path until to the edge of the narrow path. On you are right side you can see a open door. Turn to you are right and enter the room in front you can see a relaxing chair. From the relaxing chair you can see a bed stand beside the bed. Here we reached our destination.

87734.instruction: Right now we are standing in front of the main door, enter the main entrance and keep walking slightly turn towards the right side and walk near to the stairs and claimed till the fifth step and turn back and get down then turn right and take left and walk straight till the exit door and turn right go inside the room till the chair and go straight turn right walk till the fireplace and this will be your destination point.

87819.instruction: You are facing towards the glass door. Turn slightly left and move forward. Turn slightly right and move towards the marble table. Turn slightly left and move forward to the cupboards which are in front of you. You are now facing towards the sink and the window. And you are in the kitchen, and this is your endpoint.

87820.instruction: You are facing a glass door, slightly turn left and walk straight. Turn right, walk straight. Enter into the kitchen area and walk straight. Pass through the oven which is in the left and walk straight. Now you are facing the small cupboards. There is a sink and a window in the front. This is the end point.

87867.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing, you can find an opening, move towards the opening and exit the room, move forward, move towards the right side of the tv, now you are facing towards the window, slightly turn to your left and move towards the bed, slightly turn to your right, you can find an opened door, move towards the opened door and stand at the entrance of the opened door, move a bit forward, to your right you can find a wash basin, that would be your end point.

87868.instruction: You are in the washroom, turn back and move little forward and exit the room, walk straight towards the brown cupboard in front and take left, where you can find a flower pot at the corner with a portrait on the wall and an open door, enter into that room, you will find your destination at the entrance on the mat.

87869.instruction: You will start by facing a wall with a lamp beside it. Turn around and exit this room. Turn left and you will see a doorway to the washroom. Take one step on the doorway. Don't go inside. Turn around and take one step again on the hardwood floor. In front of you, there is a doorway. Walk towards the right side of that doorway just one step. Turn right and take one step towards the right side of the dining table. Turn around once again and go inside that doorway to the right where you can see the oven and once you're there you will see a sink in front of you. Stand in front of that sink. Once you're there, you're done.

87896.instruction: You are standing outside the house near the patio door, towards the grey sofa and the foot rest in front of you and proceed in the same direction jumping over the another grey sofa on the left side and approaching the stools on the counter in the kitchen, once you are in between the white cabinets which has lemons on the tray and the kitchen counters on your left, proceed straight ahead turning first right, now you should be in the narrow hall way, continue straight ahead ignoring the opening on your right and reaching the bedroom in front of you, the bedroom which has grey bed set and black throw, and the paintings on the wall and at the side of the bed the night stands are the shape of barrel's , so go towards the right side of the bed near the opening of the patio door, once you are here you are done.

87940.instruction: As you're standing between the fridge and the bed, just walk towards the dining table and before you get to the dining table, turn around and head back towards the fridge. When you pass the fridge, there will be a blue curtain in front of you. Head towards the curtain and veer slightly to the right. You'll see a bookshelf with magazines and a picture on the wall. This is your stop.

88072.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn around and exit the washroom through the open door. Slightly turn right and walk towards the carpet, now turn right and exit the bedroom through the open door. Take the immediate left and walk towards the open door opposite to you, step out of it. You are now in the dining area, walk towards the two stools. You are now facing towards a glass door with the kitchen on your left, you have reached your destination.

88073.instruction: Right now you are in front of the wall. Now turn back you will find an open door. Now exit from the bathroom. Now slightly turn right and go straight. On the left side you will find bed. Now slightly turn right you will find an open door. Now exit from the room. Now turn left and go straight. On the right side you will find an open door. Now keep moving forward and stand in front of the stool. That will be your final destination.

88129.instruction: You are standing in front of the table, turn around, take slight left, move few steps forward, you can see an open arch to your right side, move from the arch, there you can see stairs in front of you, climb up the stairs, turn to your right and again climb up the stairs, turn to your left, move forward up to the close door, there you can see the stairs again and stand in front of the third step, here is your end point.

88130.instruction: You're facing towards the system table turn around, walk a few steps forward, and towards your right, you can see wooden racks, from the wooden racks slightly turn to your right, you have an open entrance in front of you, pass through the entrance and you can see a staircase onto your right side, climb the stairs until you see a flower vase, from the flower vase, turn to your right, and climb the stairs towards your right side, now slightly turn to your left, you can see an open entrance towards your right side, enter through the entrance you find a black color stairs, climb until the second stairs and that is your final destination.

88176.instruction: You will start by facing a piano. Turn right walk towards the white couch. Walk up the marbled steps towards the staircase now go up  the staircase. Once you're on the first landing, turn right and continue to go up the stairs. Continue to walk down the hallway and walk in on the first opening on your right. Take a step inside this room you will see a bedroom and a workout machine in front of you. Now turn left there is another opening on your left towards the bathroom. Take two steps inside and stand in front of the shower and you're done.

88274.instruction: Right now you are in front of the cupboard, now turn right and exit from the room, now turn left and go near the white cupboard, and now exit from the room, now keep moving forward, you will find three chairs on the left side, now go straight and take left, you will find open door, now enter into the door, you will find dining table in front of you, now take right and go straight, you will find portrait on the wall, go near the portrait, and again keep moving forward, on the right side, you will find a room with two washing machines, go and stand in front of the washing machines, that will be your final destination.

88275.instruction: Okay now you are in a room facing towards a cream color cupboard with blue boxes in it. Turn to your right and in front of your there is a door, exit the room from that door. Now you are facing towards the wall turn to your left and move towards the cream color cupboard which is on the right. Now turn behind and in front of you there is an open door, exit the room from that door and continue going straight, until you are in front of closed door passing the three wooden chairs on the left. Turn to your left and exit the room through an open door in front of you, and you have a dining table in front of you. Turn to your right and move forward, now you are at the entrance with a portrait on the left side and in front of you there is another portrait on the wall. Move towards that portrait. Slightly turn to your left, and in front of you there is window. Move towards that window and turn to your right. Now you will be in front of the laundry room with two washing machines in it. Enter the room, now you will be in front of the two washing machines and that is the end point.

88290.instruction: You're in a living room. Look left, you'll see an island step to the island the sink will be in front of you. Turn around, look to where you came from and step forward. You'll be in line with a corner of the wall to your right where there is a light switch and the fireplace or TV of the living room across the pink and blue and yellow painting will be in line with you as well.

88315.instruction: Turn left from the place where you're standing and exit the room. Move forward and you will come across a staircase. Walk through the stairs and stand on the third step and that is the end point.

88316.instruction: You find yourself in a living room facing towards a painting. Turn around and exit the room from the open door. You find yourself at the bottom of the staircase climb the staircase and you have reached the destination.

88331.instruction: Right now, you're facing towards the chair, slightly turn right and take a few steps. Now, turn left and enter into the room, which is in front of you. Now, slightly turn left and move forward and stand at a point, where you will be facing towards the mesh window and that is the end point.

88332.instruction: You are facing the wall. Turn slightly right and move forward, you are facing the stairs. Turn around and enter into the right side open door room which some marbles to the right, move forward and stop facing towards the marbles, and this is your end.

88339.instruction: You begin on some spiral stairs looking towards an abstract piece of art. Turn to the right and move up the stairs. All the way up the stairs, even past the broken node. Once you're near the top turn to the right and move between the wall and the tan sofa. This won't actually move you between the wall and the tan sofa, but it will move you near a picture on the left, hanging on the wall. Continue, moving past the tan sofa and the keyboard on your left, into the white door and the strange lighting fixture within. Step inside, turn to the left, and move to the right side of the bed, and realize that that is not a strange lighting fixture, but just the reflection of the sun, seemingly magnified by the window. Looks just plain awful, but who am I to say? Once you are standing next to the head of the bed and a bunch of luggage seemingly floating next to the window, you're done.

88393.instruction: Starting off you are in a kitchen area that looks outside. Turn to your right and you will see a couch approach that couch in front of the couch there is a box TV and you will go to the front of that TV. Look to your right you will see a painting and two chairs beneath that painting. You will see an open archway leading into an office space past the staircase descending downwards. Go into that archway inside you can see boxes attached to the walls that hold various pieces of art. To your right you can see a low profile toilet and you will go the front of this toilet. Turning around and looking back out from where you came, you can see a glass table in the distance past the stairwell that goes downward and you will go to this glass table. Looking at the glass table and looking to the left of it you can see once again the top of the staircase that goes downward. You will go just to the top of that staircase and you destination is there.

88437.instruction: You are in a bathroom, facing towards the open door, turn slight right and move forward, turn right and move towards the bed, again turn right and move towards the open door, you are now facing towards the narrow path, turn right and move forward towards the open door, which is in front of you. Move forward and enter inside the room, you are now standing in front of an open entrance, move forward, you are now standing at the entrance of the bedroom, facing towards the window and the curtain, which is your end point.

88447.instruction: You're standing in a bedroom near the bed. Move forward and make an exit from the bedroom. Go near the stairs, move forward towards the glass window. Slightly turn right and walk in to the open door which leads to the balcony. Now go to the end of the balcony railing. This would be your end point

88448.instruction: You are in a bedroom facing towards the bed, take slightly left turn and go straight to the stool, from there take a right turn and go towards the door, on the front you can see a table, take slightly a left turn and go straight towards the railing, and go straight and walked between the two pillars near the glass window, from there take a right turn and go towards the staircase railing and keep moving forward to the open door, from there you can see the outside view, enter into the balcony and keep moving forward all the way up to the end of the balcony. This is the endpoint.

88476.instruction: To begin, you're gonna walk directly into the opening in front of you. You should have the rail to your right overlooking a swimming pool at the bottom. After you enter the double doors, you wanna make a left. You'll make another left to enter the bedroom. Once in the bedroom, you wanna go towards the opening to the left of the bed. You should see about 7 candles directly in front of you. At which point you're gonna make another left that's gonna lead you into the bathroom and just in front of the toilet is gonna be your stop.

88544.instruction: Turn to the left from the place where you are standing, you can see an open door, enter into it and move forward till the grey colored sofa, move forward, you can see a opened glass door to your right and a glass table with some books placed on it to your left, stand in-front of the opened glass door, that's your end point.

88545.instruction: Your facing to a white wall and dinning table on your right side, now slightly take right and move forward there is a open door on your left side, enter into the room move forward until you reach the wall, now slightly take left and move forward go near the open glass door, it is your end point.

88645.instruction: Facing into the bedroom, turn 180 degrees. Walk through the second open white door on your right. Walk out into the hallway you'll see a reddish painting on the wall. To the left of the reddish painting is a doorway. Walk in through that doorway and stand at the foot of the bed in front of you, you're done.

88716.instruction: You are going to start facing a pool. Turn to the right, 90 degrees, and walk to the left of that round table. Take one more step towards the kitchen stools, and turn left. Take one step towards the back of that brown couch, and turn right. Walk between those two brown pillars towards the kitchen counter and now turn to the right, just slightly. Walk through that archway that is on the left of the kitchen stools, and take a right turn right in front of the grand piano. You are going to take two steps to be on the left side of the china cabinet. Once you are there, you are done.

88736.instruction: You're facing a wall and you can see two washing machines in front of you and a table and chair. When you take right, you can see a door. Turn to your right and go forward in the straight direction. Go a bit more forward, turn to your right, go straight, go into the room. You can see a bed, a chair and a table watch and you can see a TV on the wall. Turn to your left and go straight, you will find a find a area you can go through and where you can see a mirror. Now you are at your destination.

88737.instruction: You're now facing the table with two chairs. Turn right, walk straight towards the brown color door and turn right again. Now walk through the passage and then turn right, get into the bedroom and walk in front of the television, then turn left. Now stand just beside the mirror on your left side and you will arrive at your destination.

88774.instruction: We start off looking at a wall. Turn to your left and you will see a chalkboard stand. Take a step towards that chalkboard stand. You will now see an exit to leave the room. Take a step towards the doorway. And turn right. Take a step out of the room. Take two steps to the wooden railing in front of you. Turn to your right. Take two steps to the drum step drum se set and you are done.

88797.instruction: We are looking at the corner of a gated fence, looking out onto hills. Behind us, we see that there is a large lawn and a pathway to the left of the corner. We are going to walk down that pathway, and take the route between the pool the and lawn, down the stone pathway, past a bush, and keeping to the left of the fireplace, the round fireplace. We are going to walk towards the stairs and take a slight right through the bushes and the gravel onto the patio where there should be some outdoor seating and a double door that is open. We are going to walk through the double doors. Inside, we see that it is a study / gameroom with a desk in the corner and a foosball table in there was well. We're going to walk towards the room that's next to the foosball table. Inside the room is made of carpet. We are going to take a step inside that room, and we are done. The room has two portraits on the right and a desk in the corner.

88821.instruction: You are in the passage facing the steps, climb them and move towards the wooden table on the right side, turn right side and move forward towards the white wall, turn right side and climb up the steps and enter the room, turn right side and move towards the bed, walk straight passing the windows on the right side and beside the bathtub facing the wall and the white grill, that is your destination.

88822.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the stair case. Go up through that stair case, and move forward, you can see the potted plant in front of you. Now go up through that stair case, you can see the open door in front of you. Now enter into that room, and turn right, you can see the beds in front of you. Now go near to that beds, you can see the open doors in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward until, you reach the bath tub on the right side, and there is a shower on the left side. Now, you have reached your destination."

88827.instruction: We are going to start facing a console on the left side and big windows on the right side. We are going to turn around completely and walk towards the black railing. Turn left and keep going around the railing until you see the first door opened on the left. Let's take that door to go outside. Proceed walking straight until the end of that path. You are going to stop at the end. We should be facing at the railing in front, if we turn to the right, we should see an opening that leads to the stairs to go down and on the left side, we should see the pool. That would be our destination.

88860.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing, go near the dining table which is infront of you, turn right, you can find a sliding door, go near the sliding door and step out of the door, turn right and move forward, you can find a half opened sliding door to your right, enter into the house through the sliding door, enter into the bedroom which is infront of you, stand infront of the bed, that would be your end point.

88861.instruction: You are facing towards the photo frame and the chair. Turn right and move a bit forward. There is a dining table on your left side. Turn right and move towards the couch and stand behind it. Now slightly turn right and move towards the sliding glass door. Turn right and exit the room. Now slightly turn right and move towards the sofa. Now move towards the pillar. Now walk straightly in the corridor till you find a sliding glass door on your right side. Slightly turn right and walk through the door. Now you are facing towards an open room. Enter into the room. Now you are in the bedroom. Move a bit forward towards the glass window. There is a bed on your right side. That will be the end point.

89001.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Take a slight left turn and walk towards the guitar. Now take a slight left turn and enter into the other room. Now take a slight left turn and walk straight towards the photo frames. Now take a slight left turn and walk towards the kitchen. Now take a back turn and walk towards the right side wall. Now you are facing towards the closed door, walk towards it. Now move towards the open room. Now take a slight right turn and walk towards the couch, walk forward and stand in front of dustbin. This is your destination point.

89002.instruction: You are in the bathroom, facing towards the wall beside the open entrance, turn slight left and move towards the open door, move forward and exit the bathroom. Now, turn around and move towards the narrow space beside the wall, which has photo frames on it, here on your right, you can see a photo frame in the shelf, now turn slight left and move towards the open door, turn slight right and enter inside the room, you are now standing beside the table, move forward towards the dustbin, you are now standing near the dustbin, now facing towards the wall, which is your end point.

89048.instruction: Right now you're in a workout area facing the equipment. Now turn right and move towards the entrance of the room. Now enter the bedroom and turn right, you can see an entrance to the meeting hall and move towards the table in the meeting room. You can see a glass sliding door in front of you, move forward and stand in front of the sliding door and it will be your end point.

89049.instruction: You are facing towards the gym equipment's right now, slightly turn to your right and exit the room, enter into the bedroom which is infront of you, turn right and move forward, you can find a glass door infront of you, stand infront of the glass door, that would be your end point.

89082.instruction: You're facing towards the steps turn left exit the door walk straight in front you can see the entrance beside the black pot. Enter the room. Turn left and walk near the fire place in front of the fire place is your destination.

89083.instruction: Right now your facing towards the wall turn around and move forward towards the open entrance. Pass through the arch which is in front of you. Now turn slightly left and move forward near to the white chair and you can also see a fire place which is in opposite to you. Now turn slightly right and move forward go and stand in opposite to the glass window, and that will be your final destination point.

89106.instruction: You are facing towards the glass wall, turn right and move towards the steps. Now get down of the steps. Now you can see a plant in front of you, turn slight right and move towards the glass railing. Now turn right and move towards the flower vase. You are facing towards the window and to your left there is a glass railing. The position you are standing is your final destination.

89107.instruction: You are facing towards a door, turn back, you can find a staircase, get down the steps, slightly turn right and move a bit forward, slightly turn right and move a bit forward towards the window which is infront of you, now you are facing towards the curtain, that would be your end point.

89108.instruction: You are in the kitchen facing towards an open arch. Move towards the stove which is on your left side. Slightly turn right and move towards the dining table. Walk straightly behind the chairs till you find an open room on your left side. Slightly turn right and move towards the couch. Move a bit forward. Now walk straightly towards the another pillar which is in front of you. There is a swimming pool on your left side and a tea-poi on your right side. That will be the end point.

89109.instruction: "Now you are in kitchen area move forward then after take slight right you can find dinning table go on. Again turn right you can find a sofa which is white in colour walk back side of it then after you can see another opening towards your left walk towards it you can enter outside of the room. Where you can see sofas which is black in colour walk forward there you can see some stones after that stones there is a pillar stand beside the pillar here comes your destiny."

89219.instruction: You are standing inside a bathroom, walk towards the exit of the bedroom. Take a step out and make the first left through this open brown/black door and you will find yourself standing at the entrance of another bathroom. You're done.

89226.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn left and go one step forward, turn left and go forward towards the window, turn left and go forward and pass through he opened glass door, turn right and go forward towards the opened door, go forward, continue going straight until you reach the glass which is being as a railing on to your left, here at the end of the glass you have reached the destination.

89227.instruction: Right now your facing towards the glass turn left and move forward, then again turn left and move forward towards the glass window from their turn left and move forward exit the room. Now you will seen two silver chairs in front of you next to the second silver chair at your right stand near to it that will be your final end point.

89247.instruction: Right now you're in a room facing a table and three lamps on the wall. Now turn left, you have a fridge to your left, move towards the fridge. You have an entrance to your right, move towards the entrance and turn right, you can see an entrance in to the bathroom, step in to the bathroom and stand beside the toilet basin and it will be your end point.

89248.instruction: Your standing in a living room, facing towards an wall, now turn to your left, to the left you have a platform with a sink, to the right you have an couch with a tea-poi in-front of it, walk straight. Now to the left you can see washing machines, to the right you have an open door. Now enter the room and stand beside the washbasin and toilet pan, that's your end point.

89298.instruction: You will be facing a wall with a plant on the right and the entrance to the balcony on the left. Turn towards your left to see a long white color stool, step towards the right side of that stool. Turn slightly right and step in between the last and the last second pillar which is black color. Take another step closer towards the pillar. Now move closer to the glass railing. Turn slightly left and step towards the stairway going down. Go all the way down the stairway. The end point will be at the bottom of the stairway.

89299.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn left and move forward. Turn slight right and move towards the last pillar. You are facing towards the pillar, turn slight right and move towards the glass railing. Turn left and move towards the staircase. Turn slight left and get down the stairs completely. The position you are standing is your final destination.

89415.instruction: You are facing towards a sofa chair, turn right, walk towards the open entrance, step out of it and turn left, walk towards the open door on your opposite, turn left and walk straight in the narrow path till you reach towards an open door, slightly turn left step into the room through the door, turn left and walk straight towards the end. You have reached your destination.

89416.instruction: You are facing towards the pillows. Take a right turn. Now exit the room. Take a left turn and walk towards the door. Now take a left turn and walk straight till the wooden door. Now enter into the room. Take a left turn and walk till the wooden cupboard, which is your destination point.

89434.instruction: You are going to start facing a white closed door. Turn around completely and take the door on the right after the dresser. Take the hallway to the left and you should now be standing in an area in front of the front door. Take the opening that is on the right side of the front door. This is a living room area. Turn slightly right. Jump over the coffee table towards the fireplace. Turn right, and you should see an opening on the right side of the fireplace, take that opening, and there is a door on the right side. Take that door to go outside the dining area into the kitchen, and take one more step to be in front of the sink. Once you are there, you are done.

89450.instruction: Our starting point is in a gym area, and we're facing towards two mirrors, turn around and exit towards the doorway that's in front of you, and enter the garage that's across the hallway. Once you enter the garage, turn towards the right and walk down the stairs that's in front of you... On your right there's  an exit door, walk towards it and exit towards a patio... In front of you there's a pillar, take a few steps towards it, and that's your destination.

89465.instruction: We start off looking into a seating area. Take two steps to the right towards the far grey chair. Looking at the brown leather couch take a step towards the lamp and the brown leather couch. You will now be on the backside of that couch. Looking at the table in front of you there is a large archway. To the right of that table take a step to the right through the archway. Take another step past the countertop and into the kitchen area. There is a dark doorway next to a desk countertop. Take a step towards that dark doorway. The door now opens up. But turn to your left and walk down that archway. Passing the refrigerator. Continue to walk down that hallway and continue to walk down that hallway until you have reached the entrance into a room at the end of the hallway. That is like a living area. Take a step towards the tv and stop once you are and take another step to the tv and stop you are done.

89466.instruction: You're going to start by facing a wall and a plant. You'll turn slightly towards your left and you're going to take a step forward so that you're right next to a plant and  in front of a room. Turn slightly towards your left and head towards the wall. Turn towards your right and take a step to the room along the wall. If you're looking at your left you should see a pool in front of you and then towards the back right of the room you should see some message tables. Head towards the... first one and then walk forward so that you're right next to the third.. to the last one. Then if you look towards your right you should see an opened door walk towards the opened door. Then walk forwards all the way to the... in front of the stairs but not at the bottom but just slightly in front of them. Then you're going to jump over the stairs and continue all the way forward until you're right in front of this window art piece thing. This will be your finishing point.

89484.instruction: You are facing towards the flower vase, slightly turn to your right there are some stairs, go all the way down through the stairs, now you are facing towards the closed door it is your end point.

89485.instruction: You are now standing near the stairs facing towards the flower vase. Turn towards your right and get down the stairs, walk all the way down the stairs. You are now standing in front of closed glass door, which would be your end point.

89553.instruction: You will start by facing a wall. Turn left and continue to go up the stairs. Take two steps standing behind the grey couch. On your left there will be an opening and you will see the white dining table. Take two steps towards the left side of the dining table. Passing the art piece on the left wall. Turn left and you will see an opening. Take one step inside this room and you're done.

89583.instruction: We're facing towards a seating area, and in front of us there's a brown couch and on the right side of it there's a brown chair, walk towards the right slightly, and you'll come across a staircase, on the right there's a long table with two benches, walk up the stairs, and stop right at the fourth stair... That's your destination.

89584.instruction: You are in a bathroom. Turn left and exit. Look left and you'll see an open door to another room. Step into the threshold of that projector room and stop.

89631.instruction: You are going to start inside a garage. Turn slightly to the right. You should see two doors. Take the one on the left. Go down the steps. You should see an opening on the right side. Take one step  towards that opening that has a bunch of construction materials. Turn around and take one step towards the garage door. Once you are there, you are done.

89772.instruction: Right now you are standing infront of the wall which is having switchboard, slightly move towards the right move forward from there completely turn back infront you can see the mirror on the right move towards it on the right you can see the open door this would be your final destination.

89773.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn slight right and move towards the open entrance. You are facing towards the portrait, turn right and move towards the open door which is next to the mirror. The position you are standing is your final destination.

89903.instruction: You are now facing towards the table. Turn slight left and move forward until you see the sofa in front of you. Turn slightly left and move towards the blue colour and stop behind the sofa. You are now facing towards the photo frames, then turn slightly right and enter into the straight open door room, then take right you are now facing towards the brown chair which is at the corner of the room, and this is your end point.

89904.instruction: You are facing towards a black coloured table. Turn slightly left and move forward towards the stool which is just beside the couch.
