You are now standing in front of the wall. Slightly turn right. You are now standing facing towards an open brown door. Enter into the room through the open brown door. Walk straight till you reach the two white wash basins in front of you. You are now standing facing towards the wash basins. There is a wall on your right side. Slightly turn right and walk a few steps ahead. Stand in front of the wall. You have reached your point.

92705.instruction: you are in a room there is a bed to your right pass through the bed towards the door of the room go out of the room towards opposite rooms door, turn right towards the living area go straight there will be a swimming pool and flower vase to your left, go straight there will be a exercise cycles pass through them go straight you will be having a chair to your left go straight you will be finding  a door enter into the door go straight you will be facing towards a wash basin and a mirror go straight and this is your destination.

92733.instruction: You are facing a glass shelf, turn right and exit the room passing through the passage, turn right and go forward until you cross the glass round table with two grey chairs and a white couch, turn right you can see an entrance just beside the white couch, go forward under the entrance, you can see four opened doors, turn left and get into the first door, here just beside the sink, you have reached the destination.

92734.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a glass rack. Turn towards you are right and walk in between the platform in front you can see a open door just step out from the open door and make a slight right turn and go straight. In front you can see white colour sofa. Go closer near to the white colour sofa from the white colour sofa make a slight right turn in front you can see a open door on you are right and the glass open door on your left side. just go closer near to the glass open door from beside the glass open door you can see a another open door it's a washroom just get into the washroom. Here we reached our destination in front of the wash basin.

92773.instruction: Right now you are on the stair case, now walk down through the stairs, and turn left, there you will find table with chairs, now keep moving forward, now turn left, and go straight, there you will find two steps, now get down the steps, there you will find open door, now enter into the open door, there you will find table with chairs, on the left side, you will find sliding door, now enter into the door, and now turn left, you will find glass window, on right side, you will find sofa chair, walk in between them, you will find lamp, now turn right, and go straight, now stand in front of the glass table, that will be your final destination.

92774.instruction: Now you are facing a rod. Turn right. Get down the steps. Move forward. Turn left. Go near the dining table. Go forward. Turn left. Go near the walkway. Go front. Go out of the room. Go near the door. Turn left. Go into the room. Go near the switches. Turn right. Go near the fireplace. You have reached your destination.

92879.instruction: You are facing a table and wall.  You are going to turn to your right and you will see there is a table in front of you.  You are going to head to the left of this table going towards the chairs against the wall.  You will then see in front of you with the burgundy chairs on your left there is 2 open doorways.  You are going to go into the arched doorway in the middle.  You are going to continue thru and move into the large room with the rug.  Once you have stepped into this room you are going to turn right and head towards the archway on your right on the wall.  You are going to turn into this archway and go thru into another room.  Once you step into this room you are going to make an immediate left and head towards the window with the drapes.  There will be an open door on your left when you are facing the window, you are going to walk into this room heading right towards the easel in front of you.  And once you have walked right in front of the easel with the open door on your left and the large window on your right you are done.

92945.instruction: You are in the washroom facing towards the wall, take a slight left turn and go straight to the door, from there take a slight right turn and come out of the room near the cabinets. This is the endpoint.

92946.instruction: Now your in a washroom, turn slightly left, walk towards the door, exit the washroom and walk towards the cupboard,  there would your final destination.

92970.instruction: You're currently in front of a double door. Take three steps in front of you, keeping the glass wall on your left. Once you're slightly in front of silver chairs with the pattern pillows on your right, turn around and face left into the TV room with the green sofa. Take a step forward to your right, so you're standing right in front of the brown desk in the room. Turn slightly to the right. Take a step forward towards the black statue on a black pedestal. Turn around, and face left. Take a step forward, keeping the brown desk on your left. Once the abstract painting is directly to your right, or you slightly passed it, you see, you're at the other end of the brown desk to the left of you, you're done.

93072.instruction: You will start by facing a cabinet with a minion stuff toy there. Turn around and exit the closet. Once you're facing the sink, to your right there's an opening. Walk towards the opening facing the doorway in front of you. You will see a children's room in there. Take a step on the right where you can see the railing. Walk inside the room on your right. Turn to your left and walk towards the front of the white cabinet. You should now be standing in front of the white cabinet and the railing on your left. In front of you there's an opening to the balcony. Take two steps towards the balcony. Once you're on the doorway. Turn around facing the staircase. Jump over over the railing towards the staircase. Once you're in the middle of the stairs and on your left is the staircase then you're done.

93141.instruction: You are facing a living room.  You are going to turn to your right and head towards the open door.  There will be a round table on a rug to your left.  Once you are near the open door there will be a door on your right and a thermostat right next to it.  You are going to enter that door.  You are going to take a step into the middle of this room.  There will be a white chair on your left and on your right is going to be a sink and wood open door and you are done.

93176.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing and go straight. Now slightly turn right and go straight. You will find sliding door. Now enter into the door. You will find an open door in front of you. Now enter into the room. Now slightly turn right. You will find lamp. Now go and stand in front of the lamp. On the left side you will find bed. That will be your final destination.

93177.instruction: You are facing towards a fire place, turn left and go forward, slightly turn right and go forward towards the entrance, pass through the glass door, go forward and pass through the opened brown door, slightly turn right and go forward towards the lamp that is on to the right side of the bed, here facing towards the lamp you have reached the destination.

93179.instruction: You are at the entrance, turn back and move forward, you can find a table with a white cloth, take left from there, and enter into the entrance at the left, near the entrance, before the sink you ca find your destination.

93180.instruction: You are facing towards the open glass door. Turn around and move forward, walk beside the white table and move forward. Turn slightly left and move forward. You are now facing towards the two frames on the wall and also the opening door, and this is your endpoint.

93201.instruction: You are starting facing a wall, if you turn to the left you realize you are on some stairs. You are going to walk to the top of the stairs. When you get to the stop of the stairs, you might have to turn to the right, but facing straight ahead you will see an open sliding glass door. You are going to walk through that door. While you do that the couch will be on your right. Once you go through the open sliding glass door, you are going to continue all the way until you are forced to stop and that will pass a table on your right. Once you get to the end you will see an open door, you are going to turn into that open door. You'll be standing in a little apartment. You are going to stand so that the table is on your left and the sliding glass door is behind you. To your right there is a picture, orange and white on the wall, straight ahead you see an end table with an orange lamp. You're going to walk up to that end table and then stop when you are standing with it in front of you. The wall is to your right and the table is behind you.

93244.instruction: Facing into the garage, turn 180 degrees and take a step towards the narrow doorway directly in front of you. Step into that doorway where there's a washer and dryer on your right. Turn 180 degrees again, now you should be facing two closed white doors next to the closed closet door and then to the left of both of those is an open white door. Jump towards the open white door on your left, you'll see a kitchen now on your left. Walk through the kitchen, down the hallway, keeping the white chair at the bar on your left. Bypass the dining room on your right. Going straight to the open area where there's a singular circular table in the middle. Once you're just in the open area, turn to the right, you'll see the front door in the distance. Jump towards the front door. Staring at the front door, on the right you'll see the stairs. At the bottom of the stairs there's two stairs to the first landing. Just turn to the right and go just onto that first landing of the two stairs. Standing there, you're done.

93263.instruction: You are in the bedroom facing towards the cupboards. Turn around and move towards the black cabinets. There is a washbasin on your left side. Turn around and slightly turn left and move towards the sliding glass door. Slightly turn left and move forward. There is an open glass door in front of you. Walk straightly through the open glass door and enter into the room. Now move towards the red chair. Slightly turn right and move towards the bed. Now you are facing towards the bed. There are cupboards on your left side. That will be the end point.

93264.instruction: Okay, now you find yourself facing towards the cupboards. Turn around and head inside the kitchen and turn around and head towards the glass door and take a slight left towards the glass open door. Now you are facing two open doors. Head inside the glass open door which is onto the right. Go front near the arm chair and take a right immediately towards the bed and stop. You are standing next to the bed, this is your final point.

93346.instruction: Turn around. Walk into the bedroom towards the dresser. Walk towards the open doorway. Turn right. Walk into the bathroom. You'll end when you're standing all the way against the tub.

93366.instruction: You will start by standing on the doorway. Turn around and go down the stairs on your left. Once you're at the foot of the stairs, take a step on the right. Now you will see a counter in front of you. Take a step on the left side of it. Or jump over this counter and stand in front of the window. Once you're facing the window and on your left is the railing then you're done.

93367.instruction: Begin in a kitchen. Head past the island towards the stove. then head to the left side of the dining table directly in front of you. From here here head down the length of the table. Head to your right into the hallway behind the semi circular couch. Head past the couch. Turn slightly to your left towards a glass door that heads to an outdoor patio. Head onto the patio towards the couch nearest you. Turn left and head in between the 2 Corinthian columns nearest you. ten head to the on parallel with the far end of the table and you're done.

93419.instruction: We are going to start looking outside a window. There is a pool in the outside area. We are going to turn to our left. We should see an open door in front. We are going to exit that room into the hallway. You are going to turn to your left. We should see three paintings on the right side. We are going to keep going forward. Pass the three paintings. We are going to get to the end of that hallway. Now that we are looking at the wall at the end of that hallway, we are going to turn around to our left. We are going to see now a staircase right in front of us. We are going to go down the stairs completely. Now that we are downstairs, we should have a kitchen on the left side, and we should see a living room right in front to us. We are going to proceed towards that small computer on top of that desk with the plant on it. If we turn slightly right, we are going to see a couch and a window behind the couch. We are going to walk between the window and the couch. We are going to stop right in the corner, looking at the window on the left side and looking at a shelf with sculptures, has a rabbit, paintings, a pear. That would be our destination.

93495.instruction: You are facing towards a couch, slightly turn left and go forward towards the cabinet which is having a sink, turn around and go few steps forward, here at the center you have reached the destination.

93496.instruction: You are in the hall, facing towards the couch. Turn left and move towards the brown cabinet, from here turn around and move a little forward, now you are facing towards the dining table, this is your end point.

93518.instruction: You are facing towards a kitchen cabinet, turn around, walk in the path between the stove and the kitchen counter top, turn right, take a step ahead, turn left, exit the kitchen and walk towards the closed glass door, slightly turn left you can see two open doors, walk towards the open door which is beside the chair, step into it and walk straight towards an open entrance, slightly turn right and walk towards the washroom. You are now facing towards a window with a commode on your left, you have reached your destination.

93519.instruction: You are facing a counter-top of the kitchen. Turn around to your right and walk along the pathway straight towards the wall. Move closer to the wall and turn right. Move forward towards the opening on the left. Turn left and take a step forward on the left side of the blinds. Take a step forward towards the two rooms you see in front of you. Turn slightly left and move towards the bedroom in front of you. Enter the bedroom, turn slightly left and walk straight towards the other entrance. Move closer to the entrance and turn slightly right. Take another step to go inside the bathroom towards the toilet, that is your end point.

93687.instruction: You begin facing a cabinet, turn to your right, you will see the kitchen you're in and a door, take 2 steps to exit through that door, now turn to your right, you will see a potted tree in front of you, take 3 steps towards the potted tree, now you should be standing with the tree right in front of you, take 1 step behind the tree, there will be a white couch behind the tree, take 1 step behind that, you should end up facing a living space, now turn to your right, you will see a bunch of doors through an archway, take a step forward and immediate to your left, take a step into the bathroom, you should be standing in the bathroom with the sink and the mirror to your left, a toilet in front of you and another open door in front of you, you are done.

93721.instruction: Our starting point is in a reception area, we're facing towards an elevator and an entrance, walk towards the entrance... We're now in a swimming pool area, turn slightly to your left and walk towards the beige wall that's in front of you, once you've reached the beige wall, turn slightly to the right, and enter the small hallway that's in front of you, and your destination is in front of a massage room.

93749.instruction: You're are facing towards the swimming pool, turn right and you can see a chair on your left side, walk staright and in front of you, you can see few steps, climb the steps and go staright, where you can see a white colour bed in front of you and that is your final destination.

93750.instruction: You are facing towards the swimming pool, turn back and move forwards towards the bed, and stand in front of the bed.

93772.instruction: You are going to start facing a red couch and a steel column. Turn to the left and you are going to walk between the red counter and the blue couch. Turn just slightly to the left, and this time you are going to walk to the left of that round glass table, is it round? I'm not sure... oh no, it is not round, but has a bunch of black chairs around it. Now that we are facing that glass table with black chairs, turn to the left again, and we should see a set of stairs going up. Let's go up the stairs. Once you get to the top, turn to the right and take one step to be in a storage area where we can see a wine fridge. Once you are there you are done.

93776.instruction: Enter into the room through the sliding door which is opened infront of you, to your right, you can find a staircase, get down the stairs, slightly turn to your left, you can find a sliding door, stand infront of the sliding door, that would be your end point.

93777.instruction: Okay, now you are in the balcony area facing towards the glass door, slightly turn to your right and go straight through the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now you are standing next to a portrait, which is on the left side. Sightly turn to your right and in front of you there is a staircase, get down the stairs until you reach the bottom of the staircase. Now slightly turn to your left and move towards the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now you are facing towards the open entrance and this is the end point.

93876.instruction: Turn left from your position and walk straight till you reach a lamp at the corner left side, and right to it you can find an entrance with two open doors, enter into that room and take left, walk straight towards the pillar and turn right, walk straight, you can find your destination between the pillars, in front of a sink.

93877.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a closed door. Make a slight left turn and move forward until where you can see a open door on you are right side, stand near the entrance of a open door and make a slight right turn and step into that room move forward and make a slight left turn in front you can see a marble pole. From there make a slight right turn in front you can see a two entrance stand in the middle of them. Here we reached our destination.

93960.instruction: You begin facing a bedroom, take one step into this bedroom and then turn to your right, and exit the bedroom, continue going to the right, make a right turn again, go straight down the hallway and then enter the room on the right at the very end of the hallway, then turn to your left and enter the bathroom in this room and stand right in front of the bathtub, you are done.

93981.instruction: Take the secret latter down and enter a storage room and exit the storage room through the open door. You are now in a large room with the cool looking fireplace and some chairs, both red and blue. Take a step towards the coffee table that is between the two blue chairs on the right. After that one step, turn 180 degrees, you should see an open door to an area with red tile, walk that way, head down the stairs, the few five stairs or so that are in front of you. Now should be in front of a small little seating bench with brown sofa and kind of blue pillows with some others. Turn to your left, there's a little small circular table with two chairs around it. Walk towards that table. Once you're close to the table with the fruit bowl on it, you'll see there's a bench just behind the table, jump over the chair that's right to your left here. Jump onto the bench, once you're right between the bench and the circular table, you're done.

94105.instruction: Move forward and take right, you can see a staircase in-front of you, climb all the stairs and take right, now move forward and walk behind the sofa chairs till the half opened glass door, now exit the room and move forward, you can see a window to your left and a glass table with chairs around it to the right, move little forward, take left, you can see an open door, enter into the room and take left, walk in between a washbasin and a white cupboards, stop beside a fridge facing towards a opened door, that's your end point.

94106.instruction: Now you're standing at the starting point of the staircase. Move little forward and take a right turn. Now walk all the way up through the staircase. Right now you can see a sofa on the right and a portrait on the left. Walk the way till the end by passing through the sliding door. After you reach the end, take a left turn and enter into the room. Move little forward, now on the right side you can see a dining table and on the left you can see a entrance towards the kitchen. Turn left and move forward. Here you can find a sink on the left and a micro oven on the right side. Move little forward  and stand in front of the stove which is on the left side and that is the end point.

94133.instruction: We're facing towards a threshold of an entrance, on your right there's what appears to be an entrance to a library, turn slightly to the right and walk towards it... In front of you there's a long wooden table surrounded by chairs, and on the right there are bookshelves... Walk towards the pathway that's between the table and the bookshelves, walk all the way down this pathway, walk past the chair that's on the right side of the table... The last chair that's on the right side of the table, walk past that... On your right there are books and on the left there's a console table with some books on top and in the middle there's a chair, a brown chair, and on the right side of the chair there's a small table as well... It's either a table or a dresser, It appears to be a dresser, walk towards the chair, once you're facing towards the corner between two shelves, you have reached your destination. On your right there's a lamp and on your left there's also a lamp.

94139.instruction: You are facing an open door and a wall with lots of handles and door knobs on it. You are going to turn around and you are going to go to your right.  You are going to see a small oval table with things on it and a doorway.  You are going to go towards that doorway.  Between the white walls that have an opening to the doorway.  Once in front of that doorway you are going to see some steps to your right and to your left.  If you are in front of the doorway on the grey runner rug you are going to go down the steps to your left.  You are going to take the steps down.  Keep taking them down this curvy stairway.  All the way to the very bottom where in front of you will be double wood doors.  You are going to walk thru these doors. And you will see a room with faucets on display and a metal bath tub.  You are going to make a left in this room and walk past the bath tub which will be on your right.  You will go thru another set of open wood doors.  You will come into a large dining room.  You are going to head towards the chair at the front of the table.  Once you are at the chair at the front of the round table you are going veer to the left and jump over the 2 white chairs that are next to that chair at that table.  And you are going to head towards the corner where you will see 4 wood chairs against the wall and there will be a small table with a wood sunburst type mirror over a table.  You are going to go towards that table.  And there will be a small burgundy chair next to that table.  You are going to stop right next to that burgundy chair and you are done.

94368.instruction: You are in a car garage, facing towards the wall. Turn towards your right and keep moving forward. Turn towards your slight right again and move forward. In front, you find a door, which is white in color, go pass through the door and stand near that door step. You reached your destination.

94369.instruction: You are facing a wall, turn right, walk straight. Slightly turn right and walk straight. There is an open door in the front, take a step forward and stop. You are facing the gym room. This is the end point.

94381.instruction: Our starting point is in a patio, on the right there are two long chairs and on the left there's a swimming pool. Walk pass the swimming pool and then turn right, we're inside a living room, on your right there are two white chairs and a long white sofa, and there's also a paining on the wall, a blue carpet and a coffee table, on the left, there's a long dining table with black chairs, walk pass the white sofa, we're facing towards the other portion of the living room, on the left there's a long staircase and a small white chair, and on the wall there are three pictures, on the right there's a glass door, walk towards the glass door, we're facing towards a small hallway, on the left there's a sculpture, and there's painting on the wall in front of you. Walk towards the painting and then turn right, we're facing towards a long hallway, walk pass the hallway. We're facing towards a living room, in front of you there's a sofa, and there's a grey rug on the floor, walk towards the sofa, and that's your destination.

94400.instruction: Slide little right and walk straight towards the open door, exit the room, now slide right and walk straight along the path and move straight towards the open entrance near the brown cupboard, enter into it, now slide left towards the another open door, slide right and enter into the room, now walk straight along the path between the table and chairs towards left and open door towards right, move straight, now take a right turn where you can see a open door towards your right and potted plant towards your left, slide little left and walk straight towards the fire place and you have reached your destination.

94401.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a bed. Now slightly turn right and exit the room through the open door which is in front of you. There is an arch to your right, slightly turn right and pass through the arch. Now again slightly turn right and move a bit forward. There is a round table with chairs to your right and a sofa set to your left and an arch in front of you, move towards the arch and pass through it. Now turn left, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the open door and turn right and move a bit forward. There is an arch in front of you, move towards the arch and pass through the arch. Now turn right and move a bit forward. There is a piano in front of you. Now slightly turn left, you can see a fireplace in front of you, move towards the fireplace and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

94486.instruction: Starting between two round dinner tables, walk forward to the third round dinner table in front of you. Step to the right of that dinner table towards the outside patio on the other side of it. Take another step in front of the hanging swinging bench and fire place. Step between the black steel bench and the fireplace to the open double doors. Walk past the wooden long bar towards the set of stairs in front of you. When you reach the base of the stairs, turn around and go through the slightly open doorway on the right hand side just past the television you just walked past. When you enter in this little doorway, turn right and go through the open door on the right, past the antique telephone. Step into the bathroom, stop.

94576.instruction: Right now you are in front of the towel. Now turn left you will find an open door. Now go near the open door. Now slightly turn left. You will find another open door. Now step out of the door and keep moving forward. You will find an open door in front of you. Now go and stand at the entrance of the door. That will be your final destination.

94577.instruction: You are in a restroom facing towards the wall, with a towel hanged to the hanger. Take a left turn. Move little forward, and exit from the restroom. Take a left turn, walk little forward. Go straight towards the entrance of a room in front of you. Slightly move forward. And here is your destination at the entrance of a bedroom.

94638.instruction: Facing the painting on the wall, turn to your left and walk up three stairs. At the landing, in front of the next three stairs, turn to your right and enter the room. There is a table with two chairs on either, a chair on either side. Cabinetry on both sides of the room. Turn to the right and walk towards the cabinetry on the right. Staying to the right of the picture that's on the cabinet, the large picture. Once you're standing in front of the cabinet, on the right shelves there's some decorations, you're done.

94663.instruction: Now you are in front of the entrance of the bedroom, facing towards the wall, turn around and walk straight in between the bed and the cabinet. Now take right and exit the room through the door. Turn left and walk in between the walls. Now take left and enter into the living area through the entrance. Now walk straight in between the couch and the teapoy towards the fire space. Now take right and exit the living area. Now walk straight in the dining room in between the dining table and the cabinet. Turn right and exit the dining room through the door. Now walk straight by taking right towards the kitchen and stand in front of the sink and the cabinet which is in front of the window which is the endpoint.

94664.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn around and move towards the cabinet. Slightly turn right and exit the room through the open white door. Slightly turn left and walk towards the wall in the front. Turn left and enter inside the arch. Slightly turn right and move towards the fireplace. Turn right and exit the living room through the open door. Keep walking straight till you reach the white door in the front. Turn right and exit the room. Enter into the kitchen . Walk straight and stand in front of the sink. You have reached your point.

94817.instruction: Okay, now you are in the bedroom with a bed on your right side, slightly turn to your right and move forward. Now you are standing next to the sofa chair, which is on the right side. Slightly turn to your right and in front of you there is an open door, exit the bedroom through that open door. Now you are standing next to a portrait, which is on the right side. Turn left and go straight towards the staircase, which is on the left side. Now slightly turn to your right and in front of you there is a corridor, walk straight in the corridor until you reach in front of a portrait. Now turn right and in front of you there is a narrow passage, walk straight in the narrow passage until you reach in front of an open door. Now enter through that open door and stand in front of the portrait. Now turn left and go straight towards the white cabinet, which is in front of you. Now turn right and go straight towards the open entrance, which is on the right side. Now turn right and enter through that open entrance. Now you are standing at the entrance of the washroom and this is the end point.

94818.instruction: Now you are facing towards the closed mirror window, turn to your right walk straight towards the open entrance. Now on your right side  you can see a white sofa, turn to your right move forward towards the open door. Turn to your right exit the bed room, turn to your left walk straight towards the edge of the railing. Move forward walk through the railing continue walking straight, move few steps forward walk straight towards the white wall, where you ca see a painting on the white wall. Turn to your right walk through the narrow passage now you can see in-front of you open door, walk towards the open door enter the room. Turn to your left move towards the white cabinet, turn to your right walk straight towards the white colour relaxing chair. Turn to your right enter the bathroom, now you are standing in-front of white bath tub , which is your final destination.

94966.instruction: You are standing in a narrow passage facing towards the glass wall. Turn left and move towards the open entrance. You are now facing towards an open entrance turn to your left. Now move forward in between the glass walls towards the open entrance straight ahead of you. Now your are standing in front of the open entrance. Take slight right and enter inside the room. You are now standing in front of the table and chair facing towards the window, which is your endpoint.

94967.instruction: Okay, now you are facing towards the glass wall, turn left and go straight through the open entrance, which is on the left side. Now you are facing towards the edge of the open door, slightly turn to your left and walk straight in the narrow passage until you reach in front of an open entrance. Now you are standing at the entrance and in front of you there is a white table and black chair, go straight and stand in front of the white table and that is the end point.

95058.instruction: Move forward from the place you are standing, you can find a dining table to your right, go near the black cabinet which is behind the dining table, turn back, you can find a fridge infront of you, go behind the fridge, now you are facing towards a portrait, slightly turn to your right, you can find a narrow path, go through the narrow path, you can find a washroom infront of you, enter the washroom, that would be your end point.

95059.instruction: Now you are in a room standing next to a beam bag, which is on the right side. Walk all the way straight passing the white refrigerator on the left. Now you are standing next to a sink, which is on the left. Turn to your right and move forward, now you are standing in front of a blue curtain. Take a step forward towards the right side of the marble island counter. Right in front of you, you see a dark open door entrance in front of you. Take a step forward towards the entrance of the dark open entrance. Now, there's a marble desk with a black chair attached to it, to the left side of you. Take a step forward on the grey carpet in the, the hallway entrance in front of you. Turn around, and face right. Take a step forward, passing the three wooden chairs on your right. Now, right in front of you, you see an open doorway and a closed-brown door. Take a step forward to your left, standing at the entrance of the open doorway. Now, you're standing at the entrance to a heater room. There are two silver heaters on the left side of the wall. Take a step forward towards the two silver heaters. Now, turn around, face left. You'll see an open brown doorway. Take a step forward to the entrance of that brown door. Now, you're looking into a smaller closet with a tan shelf. Take a step forward to the right side side of that closet. Take another step forward to the right. Once you're standing in front of a brown bag, to your left, you see a tan shelf, to your right, you see light cabinets, you're done.

113598.instruction: you begin by looking at a corner, you should see that all the walls and ceiling are the same pale wood. and the corner is a stained wood, if you turn your body to the left you should see a grey couch and a pretty thick bed. a t the very end of the room there is a door that is open head to that door. head outside of the door. and turn your body to the left you should see a staircase leading up. you are going to walk in front of the staircase and take two steps up the staircase. and once more step. once you are about halfway up the staircase, to your left there should just be a wall and you can kinda see a vent. oh sorry to your right there is a wall and you can kinda see a vent and to your left there is a hand railing leading upwards, once you are there you are done.

113711.instruction: You are in a hallway you should be facing two open doors in front of us. Go to the open door that has a little mat on the floor, on our left. Now we are in a  corridor that has a little table and a mirror ahead of us. Walk a few steps to the table and turn left going into the door with the fire hydrant on the wall. This door is open and leads us to a kitchen and a table with a brown chair ahead of you. Walk to the brown chair and the black table and turn right.Go around the black table and walk to the front of the double refrigerator. You want to stand so that the refrigerator is on your left and the stove and oven is in front of you. You are done.

113712.instruction: Right now you're facing an entrance of a room. Now turn left, you can see an entrance to the bathroom in front of you, step in to the bathroom and turn behind. You can see three cupboards in the room, move towards the cupboards and turn left. You can see a television to your right and beds to your left and an open door in front of you, move towards the open door and exit the bedroom. Now, you can see an open door to your left, move towards the door and enter in to the room and it will be your end point.

113741.instruction: You are near the doorstep of your bed room, Keep moving forward and climb up the stairs, which are in front of you. Move ahead beside the staircase, which is on you left and you enter into your living area. In front, you can find a sofa set, which is on your left and a table of a kitchen area on the right. Walk between them and go to the other end of the table. Turn around and move forward to the other side of the table, into the kitchen area. Keep moving forward and walk along side of the stove, which is on the left side. In front, you can find a fridge. Go near the fridge and you reached your destination.

113742.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a staircase, climb up two steps which are in front of you and move towards the staircase. Now slightly turn right and move towards the table which is in front of you. Now slightly turn left. There is a sofa set to your left and a platform to your right, move forward and pass in between them up to the bar chairs, cross the platform which is to your right and turn behind. There are two sink platforms in front of you, move forward and stand in between them. There is a stove to your right, move towards the stove, cross the stove and stand in between the cupboards which are to your left and right and it is your end point.

113763.instruction: you are looking out a window and you see a couple of grills. turn to your right youll see a painting made of 4 squares, in a diamond shape. to the right of that is a control system on the wall and a vent. step to the wall with the control system. when the control system is on your left and you are facing the fridge, turn left down this hallway. now you should be  in a hallway that has a sink, black washer/dryer, and a closet with an open door. step into the closet. step into the bathroom to the left. walk directly out of the bathroom thru the doorway thatch across from you. you'll pass the bathtub on your right and TV on your left. when you've reached the bedroom turn to your right and stand in front of the night stand.

113987.instruction: You'll start with a massage table to your left straight ahead is a doorway. Exit the room through that doorway and turn left. Now you'll be looking down a hallway with some pictures on the wall to your left. Walk down that hallway into the next area. Now there will be three lounge chairs along the wall to your left. To the right of those chairs is two doorways. You're going to keep right and enter the right doorway. Walk straight passing the mirrors on your left and there's another massage table in there it looks like. You're going to walk into the next doorway and you'll see there's a toilet and a sink. When you get here, stop.

114174.instruction: You will start by standing on the purple carpet in the living room. Walk towards the front of the blue couch on your right. In front of you you will see two plants on the left side of the balcony. Walk towards those plants and take one more step towards the railing. Once you're in front of the railing and overlooking the city, then you're done.

114184.instruction: You are facing towards the couch, slightly turn to your right and move towards the single couch, turn left and move a bit forward, you are facing towards a dining table, slightly turn to your right and move forward, slightly turn to your left, you can find a sink to your left, move a bit forward, now you are facing towards a chair, slightly turn to your left and move forward until you see an opened door infront of you, now you are at the entrance of the room, slightly turn to your left and move towards the portrait which is infront of you, where to the left you can find a tv, that would be your end point.

114185.instruction: Right now we are standing beside the couch slightly take right and move forward slightly take left and towards the white couch take left and move towards the brown colour sofa infront of you, infront you can see the two steps climb up the steps and move forward infront you can see the open arch move forward, slightly take left infront you can see the counter top move towards it take left and move forward on the right you can see the cupboards on the left you can see the portraits on the wall slightly take left and move forward, move little forward on the right you can see the portrait on the wall and on the left you can see the chair near the wall move little forward on the left you can see the closed glass door and on the right you can see the open door move forward, move forward infront you can see the open door enter into the room on the right you can see the ash colour sofa set and on the left you can see the chair, move little forward on the left you can see the television and infront you can see the portrait on the wall and this is your final destination.

114203.instruction: You begin looking at an arched window, outside. Turn to your left and move towards the pillar with the counter connected to it. Once you're there turn right and move towards the kitchen sink on the island. Turn right again and you should see several stairs up, pass the oven and move towards those stairs, continuing up one... Two... Three... Three flights of stairs. Not the last one, but just the first three. Once you are there at the top of the third, then turn left and move past the little dividing railing, turning right and moving to the corner next to the sliding glass doors that are closed. Once you are in that corner, to the right of the closed sliding glass doors, you are done.

114215.instruction: You are facing towards dvd player and remotes. Turn left. Go forward to the sofa. Move forward to the opening while crossing some things on left side. Go through the opening in front of you. Go to the closed door, while crossing the closed door on your left and an almarah on the right. You have reached your destination.

114216.instruction: From the starting point turn left now you are opposite to the white sofa, move forward through it move in a forward direction exit through the arch, and move forward towards the closed wooden door stand on the red mat that will be your final destination.

114217.instruction: You are in the kitchen area right now, turn right, you will be entering into the living room, to the left you can find a dining table, take right and go near the black table where there is a book on it, enter the washroom which is right to the black table, stand infront of the door, that would be your final destination.

114235.instruction: We're standing by a glass counter. Let's turn around, and enter the room with a very colorful bed and we can just stop here.

114251.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, slightly take right and move forward, now you are facing towards closed wooden door, slightly take right and move towards the gate, move forward and enter into the house through the open door, now slightly take left and move forward, again slightly take left and move forward, move forward till you find a round table in front of you, now slightly take left and move towards the glass door, now turn to your left and move forward you are facing towards the round table, now slightly take left and move towards the refrigerator, it is your end point.

114252.instruction: Now you are facing the wall and walk through the narrow path beside the closed glass door on your right, now you can see an open door enter the room. Now you are facing the brown colour wooden cabinet, turn left move towards the piano, and go straight towards the round dining table with six chairs, there you can see the glass door move towards it, turn left you can see the round table move towards it, slightly turn left, and stop in front of the refrigerator this is the destination.

114307.instruction: Begin facing a tub, turn around and head into the carpet by the tub. From here turn right and you'll see a WC. Head towards the sink, Then turn around and head to the foot of the bed by the dresser. Round the bed to the side with the fireplace. You'll see an open door to the hallway by the balcony. Head into the hall and you're done.

114400.instruction: Ok we are starting with a wall just in front of us, a yellow wall, a tile wall. We are going to turn to our left to take the hall and then we are going to turn again to our left to walk through that hall entering this room. It looks like a family or resting room. But we are walking through this room outside of this door and taking the stairs. Ok, we are now here at the kitchen we are going to turn to our left. As you can see we have the kitchen area to our right and the dinning table to our left. We are goin to walk through this are turning slightly to our left to end just in front of this red figure.This is going to be our final destination.

114461.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a glass door. Now turn left and move towards the walkway which is in front of you. Now turn left, there is a swimming pool to your left and an open door in front of you, move towards the open door and enter in to the room. There is a portrait on the wall in front of you. Now turn left, there is a bed in front of you, move towards the bed and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

114462.instruction: Okay right now you are facing the glass door. Turn to your left and walk straight. Now turn slightly left and there is pool to your left side and an opened door in front of you. Walk straight towards the door. Once you enter the door, there is a frame in front of you. Now turn left and you see a bed in front of you. Walk towards the bed and stop in between the table to your right and television to your left. That is the end point.

114510.instruction: Right now you are in front of the wall. Now turn right and go straight near the window. Now turn right and go straight you will find narrow opening on the right side. Now enter into the narrow opening. On the left side you will find bathroom. That will be your final destination.

114511.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn right and walk towards the glass window. Turn right and walk towards the arch opposite to you, enter into the arch. You are now facing towards seven candles, you have reached your destination.

114566.instruction: Now you are facing towards the white colour rack, turn slightly left and move straight till the open door, from there take right turn here you can see lamp on your left side. Go straight and enter into the open door, here you can see washbasin and mirror in front of you, from there take right turn and move out through the open door, now turn right till the entrance of the door and again back to same place, here you can see brown colour desk and a white colour pot is placed on the table and in front of the table is your final destination.

114567.instruction: You are facing towards the shelves take a slight left, move froward and take a left beside the bed, and exit the room through the opening. Then turn to your right you can see another open door, go through that door then turn to your right. Enter into the opening take a about turn move forward, and stand in front of the wooden shelves which has books in it.

114589.instruction: Go straight from the place you are standing. Now slightly turn left and exit from the door. You will find stair case. Now walk down through the stairs. Now turn left and go straight. Now turn left and go straight near the piano table. Now go straight and stand in front of the glass window. That will be your final destination.

114590.instruction: You are now facing the wall, from there slightly turn to your left. Start walking straight near to the entrance of the door and from there go near to the staircases, go down the staircase and stand in front of the wall, now take a right turn. Go down the stairs and stand in front of the wall, from there take a left turn, walk a few steps forward and stand in front of the main door which is to your right side. Take a left turn, walk straight near to the sofa and from there go near to the glass window which is in front of you and stand there.

114628.instruction: Okay, now you find yourself in a bedroom, facing towards the wall in front of the wall you can see a white chair and a wooden cupboard head towards the cupboard and take a right immediately towards the white open door, from the open door, turn left and immediately turn right towards the open arch and enter the narrow hallway which leads you to the living room. Head straight towards the pillars from the first pillar take a slight right towards the circular dining table, now you find yourself facing towards the glass window and onto your there is a circular dining table. This is your final point.

114629.instruction: You are facing towards the drawers, turn left and move forward. Turn right and move towards the open door. Turn left and move out of this room. Turn right and move towards the open arch. Slightly turn right and walk straight till the first round pillar. Now you are facing towards the 3 chairs and standing near the round pillar. Turn slight right and move towards the window which is near the chairs. Now you are facing towards the window and you are standing next to the chairs. The position you are standing is your final destination.

114640.instruction: We’ll see a large sofa on the right side of the room. Let’s go out of this room. Let’s turn to the right walking up the small stairs case. Take one step in the direction of the brown door on the left hand side. Or I guess that was the bookshelves. Now turn and go into a room. You will see a closed door directly in front of you, to the left of you and an opening to the right with two small windows up high from this vantage point. Walk into that room and you will see it actually has a lot of high windows. Hop over the single chair and stop when you are beside the blue couch and the landline.

114698.instruction: Now you are facing towards an open door. Turn slightly right. Move forward. Turn left. Move forward near the snooker pool. Turn left. Move forward near the photo on the wall. Turn left. Move forward near the mirror on the wall. Turn slightly right. Move forward near the steps. Get down the steps. Turn right. Move forward near the wall. Turn right. You can see an open door. Go into the open door. Turn left. Move forward near the closed door. Turn right. Move forward near the bed side table. You have reached your destination.

114699.instruction: You are facing towards a snooker table, go forward just beside the railing, slightly turn left and go forward towards the snooker table, turn left pass through the entrance, turn left pass through the arch and go forward towards the wall in front of you, slightly turn right and go forward towards the stairs, go down stairs until you reach the ground floor, after going down stairs turn right and go forward towards the wall, turn right and enter the bedroom passing through the opened door, turn left and go forward towards the curtain which is on to the left of the glass door, turn right and go forward towards the white cabinet, here just in front of the white cabinet beside the bed you have reached the destination.

114774.instruction: We start off in a laundry room facing an open doorway. Walk through the open doorway and towards the black uh leather chair in the back on top of a black rug. Turn to your right and you'll see the railing on your right and a poster or sign with a number one on it. Walk towards that number one. Hop over the railing so you're on the top of the steps. You'll now be facing a large opening on your right and an open doorway directly in front of you. Walk through that open doorway directly in front of you and turn to your left. You'll see a table with two circular footstools on the floor. Take a step towards the black footstools and turn to your right. Take a step onto the white rug in front of the bed. Turn to your right. You'll see an empty closet space. Walk into the closet space and take a step towards the two white uh shelves in the corner and stop you're done.

114808.instruction: You begin looking towards the head of the bed, a nightstand with a telephone and a lamp on it, etcetera. Turn around all the way and move through the open wooden door onto a hallway with a railing on the right. Continue left, keeping that railing on your right, until you have passed by a little trunk on your left. There should be an exit door in front of you, and just phase straight through that exit door. Once you are outside, you are done. You should be looking over a railing onto a cement-looking roof of a patio? You're done.

115138.instruction: You will start out facing a concrete wall. If you turn to your left you will see glass doors and if you continue turning to your left you will see a patio with a pool. You want to walk on the patio along the glass doors toward the two planters near the house. Continue walking forward until you have reached the first planter. Once that first planter is directly in front of you, you want to hop over it into the space between the first and second planter. You should now be standing behind the second planter. Ahead of you, you can see an open door into the house and a third planter. You want to hop over that second plant and land between the third pot and the pool. From here you want to turn slightly right toward the house and go through the open door inside the house. Then you want to take a sharp right. You are looking into what appears to be the kitchen. There is a wooden table or island in the middle of the room. You want to walk through that small doorway into the kitchen. Continue on through the kitchen to the left of the wooden table in the middle of the room. Once on the other side of the kitchen, you will be in a small hallway with stairs on the left side going up. Go up those stairs all the way to the top. Once you reach the top of the stairs, you will be in a room that has a circular table in it. There are two chairs directly in front of you. You want to go just to the right of the right hand chair. And now you will see that you are standing at the edge of a kidney-shaped desk with two chairs and one black leather chair on the back side. You want to go to the black leather chair on the back side of that desk and that is where you will stop.

115142.instruction: You are in a dining area facing towards the wall, take a left turn and move forward near the glass wall, take a slight right turn and move forward near the staircase, and go straight to the staircase, take a left turn and go upstairs, and turn around and go upstairs, and move forward near the door, take a slight right turn and move forward in the corridor, and again move forward near the cupboards, and go straight to the front door, and enter into the bedroom, take a slight right turn and move forward near the rug, take a slight left turn and move forward to the door near the curtains. This is the endpoint.

115143.instruction: You're now facing an open entrance. Turn slightly left and walk towards the glass window. From there, walk straight towards the stairs and climb up the stairs completely and turn right. Now walk straight in the passage till you reach a bed on your right side. From there, turn slightly left and walk towards the open door at the end. Stand in front of the door near the entrance, facing the bathtub and that is your end point.

115168.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, slightly take right and move forward,  move a bit and turn to your right there is an open glass door, exit the room through the open glass door, now you are facing towards the sofas at the backyard of the house, now slightly take right and move towards the another open glass door, now slightly take left and move towards the wooden chairs, now turn to your right and move towards the grey chair, move forward towards the white chair, there is an open glass door move towards it, slightly take right and move towards the round table which is at the balcony of the house, now move forward and stand in front of  the wall facing towards the road, it is your end point.

115169.instruction: You're standing near the door, exit the room, and go straight, you'll find an entrance to the right, turn right, again turn right, go straight, then turn right, you'll enter in to living room, then go straight, you'll find black color sofa, go straight, you'll enter in to balcony, there near the glass table, beside black color plant pot, you'll find your destination.

115220.instruction: You will start by standing in front of a sliding door. On your right side you will see the overview of the city and the balcony. Walk  towards the left side of the balcony and you should now be standing on a doorway leading towards the bedroom. In front of you there is a grey and black carpet. Walk towards that. Once you're inside the room, turn to your left and you will see a doorway. Walk towards the doorway. In front of you you will see a wooden wall. Walk towards the wall and on the right side of that is another doorway. Walk through the doorway. Here you will see a hallway. Keep walking on the hallway to your right. There will be a black statue right beside the railing of the stairs. Turn to your left side going down the stairs. Take two steps down the stairs and you're done.

115268.instruction: You are in a kitchen, look left you will see stairs in the distance heads toward them. At the landing of the stairs look right and you will see a living room with a white loveseat and a beige couch past it are two sliding glass doors. Head to the left side of those doors and look right stay inside. You will see another open door at the end of the hallway and to the right of that a black cabinet, console. Stand where you can see the yellow horse painting on the wall on the right to the left of  you will be two brown doors, stop.

115404.instruction: You are now facing towards the glass. Turn right and move forward, there some photographs hanging on the wall to your right. Move forward and enter into the open brown door and stop facing towards the white colour pillar, and this is your endpoint.

115405.instruction: You are facing towards the glass wall, turn right you can see a narrow path, move in the path till you reach an open door in front of you. Now enter into that room. Now you are facing towards the round pillar. The position you are standing is your final destination.

115499.instruction: You are at the door, move little forward, you can find another door, turn around and walk straight towards the mat, move little forward you can find an open door, exit the house, move little forward, there is a rock wall at the either side, turn left, move forward passing the flower pot and a pipe, the position now you are standing is your destination.

115500.instruction: Right now you're facing towards an open door and move forward. Now you're in entrance of a room, turn around and move forward. Turn slight left you'll see an open door, move towards the open door and go outside from the open door. Turn left and take two steps forward and that is your end point.

115533.instruction: You are facing a doorway.  Facing the doorway you are going to turn to the right and you are going to hop up the black steps.  Once you hop up you are going to continue up these steps.  You are going to take them all the way to the top.  Once at the top you are going to make a left.  And you are going to walk into a bedroom.  You are going to hop over the corner of the bed closest to you.  And once you hop over the bottom corner of the bed you will be on the aqua rug with a table and chairs there to your left.  Now you are going to hop over the other bottom corner of the bed going towards the door to the bathroom.  And from here you are going to enter the bathroom.  You are going to stop right in front of the toilet facing the shower and you are done.

115582.instruction: You're now facing a table with white colour cloth. Walk along the table towards right and you will find the other table with same white colour cloth. After crossing that table, turn right and take immediate left. Now walk straight, you will reach a pot. From there, turn right and walk straight towards the small wooden door which is close and you will reach your destination.

115583.instruction: You are facing towards the door, turn slight left and move towards the door. Keep moving forward. Now you can see an open entrance to your right, move towards it. Turn slight left and move towards the door. Now enter into the room. You are facing towards the wall, turn right and move forward. Now move towards the corner sink. Now you are standing in front of a door and to you are right there is a sink, which is your final destination.

115668.instruction: Now you are in a bathroom turn towards your right and exit the bathroom there is a opened brown door in front of you pass through it and exit the bedroom there is another opened brown door in front of you pass through it and go near the mirror which is mounted on the wall towards your left side that would be your final destination.

115669.instruction: You're standing in the bath tub facing towards the wall. Turn right and exit the washroom. You're in the bedroom. Walk forward and exit the bedroom. Walk into the open door beside the car painting, which is a washroom. Walk forward and stand near the commode. This would be your end point.

115722.instruction: You begin facing a wall with a vase on a wall mount. Turn to your left and exit the doorway in front of you staying between the table on the left and the piece of furniture on the right. Now once you're standing in this arched doorway, walk through this small area here between the door on the right and the island on the left and keep going, again between the islands in this kitchen area and once you reach the end of this pathway, turn to the left, where you'll see two pillars and walk into this living room. Now keep to the right alongside the pillar but not entering the room and you're going to turn right into the first alcove here and then you're going to make another left into a very small bathroom. Take one step forward so that you're standing in front of the wall and you're done.

115723.instruction: You are standing near a stool staring at a mirror on the wall, turn left and exit through the opening on your left, turn first left after you exit , now you should see their is an office desk with two white chairs on your right, go near that and look straight ahead their is a planter, an empty planter or a pot on your right, go near that and keep on walking straight ahead, crossing the brown wooden counter on your right and reach for the first opening on your right after the front desk. you should be standing in front of the two brown doors , like partitions , once you are standing in between them, their should be sliding doors in front of you and their is an opening on your left beside the two, their are two openings on your left so go to the second on the left after the two circular arts on the floor. It's a men's washroom, go straight ahead reaching the brown door, straight ahead, passing the lockers on your right and the water fountain on your left reaching for the closed door straight ahead. Once you are at the last stall on your left a closed door in front of you , you are done.

115724.instruction: You are facing towards a small brown cupboard, turn slightly right and move forward and exit through the open door which is right in front of you. Turn slightly left and move towards the wooden partition, turn slightly right and move forward, walk straight, turn slightly right and move forward. You can see two open doors right in front of you, enter the door which is on the right side. Turn slightly right and move forward. Now turn slightly right and move forward towards the white coloured equipment which is in the corner of the room. Now turn to your left and move forward towards the wall. You are now facing towards a lamp which is on the wall and this is your end point.

115725.instruction: You will be facing an open wooden door, walk towards it and exit the door. Turn slightly left and walk towards the wood and glass partition. Turn slightly right and continue walking straight through the hallway. You will be walking towards the ceiling which has the wood square pattern. You will face four open rooms, continue walking straight and enter into the room which is right side of the sink. Enter the room, this room will have a medical sauna kind of arrangement in it, walk towards the sauna arrangement. Turn slightly right and walk towards the control center which is in front of you. Now turn left and you will see a lamp on the wall, which is on the right side of the sauna table, walk towards the lamp and stop.

115799.instruction: You are going to start facing a dining room table. You should see two pillars in front of you, walk between the two pillars. Turn to the left and take the hallway to the left. Take your first left turn, and take one more step to be in front of the sink. No need to go further. Once you are facing the sink and the door of that restroom, you are done.

115813.instruction: You are at the door, slightly turn right exit the room and move forward, walk straight till you find an open door at the right side, move towards the open door, turn around diagonally you can find a closed doors in front, walk straight towards the closed doors, turn left move forward, you can find number of closed doors at the right side, walk straight there is a closed door in front with stairs A  and there is a wall at the left side and right side, the position now you are standing is your destination.

115814.instruction: Okay, now you find yourself at the entrance of the room, facing towards the open door and glass wall. Take a slight right from the entrance and exit the room and take a right immediately and head straight into the walk zone of the office and turn a slight right where you can find an open door, at this point you can see two white tables and two black arm chair's from this point take a left immediately towards the brown closed door's and head towards the brown closed door in front of you in the narrow walk zone and stop next to the last door on to the right. Now you are facing towards the brown closed door and a white wall which has an exit written on to it. This is your final point.

116049.instruction: "Now you are facing towards the photo frame, turn towards your left, walk forward, you can see a door towards your right, exit it, then after, turn left, you can see other door, wall forward, get down the steps, you can see two sofas walk in front of them there you can see open door, exit it and walk forward towards the railing and stand beside the chair, you had reached your destiny."

116050.instruction: Right now, you're facing towards the wall. Turn left and move towards the white door which is in front of you. Now, turn slightly right and move forward and you can see an opened door on the left. Now, turn left and move towards the entrance of the room, which is on the left. From there, slightly turn right and move forward until you reach a large glass door in front of you. Pass through through the glass door and take a few steps, where you will be facing towards the glass railing and that is the end point.

120681.instruction: Begin in  a washroom facing a small black and white photo. Turn around and exit the room to your left. Head out into the hall and make a left into the bedroom. Towards the black rug. Pass the black rug and head behind the grey couch head onto the balcony to the right of the patio chairs. and you've arrived.

120719.instruction: You are standing at the back of the white sofa, straight ahead as you move near the white sofa their is a planter on your right near the patio door, stand near the plant and turn left , looking straight ahead towards the brown counter in the kitchen, walk near it and turn a slight right, walking at the back of the kitchen stools, and now when you are standing next to kitchen stools look straight ahead their is a staircase on you right and their is a console on your left, walk towards that and keep on walking straight ahead towards the entrance and exiting the house, when you exit the house proceed straight ahead towards the planters on your left, the planters are look alike and go towards the middle planter and you are done.

120819.instruction: You are facing a brown counter with little bookcases on it. Turn to your right and go out the glass doors. Now go right into the next set of glass doors on your right. You are facing a desk with a wooden pane on top of it. Walk to the right of the desk down the hall between the bathroom on your right. Keep going and turn left at the second wooden pane on your left. When you turn you will see a bronze hamper  on the right and to the right of that a desk with white cups. Walk forward between the hamper and the wall on your left. Go into another hall which has a large iron decoration on the wall on your left.  Continue past the decoration toward the square white and gray rug in the middle of an open area. When you get to the rug, turn right. There are two rooms ahead of you. Go to the one on the right. You will see a long massage table on the right. You want to walk between the bed and the white wall toward the back. Stand in front of the shower. To your left will be a thermostat reader.  You are at your destination.

120859.instruction: You're currently standing in the bedroom. Turn slightly to the right, and take three steps forward, passing the grey bed on your right and the black desk on your left. Now, you're in the wooden hallway. Take one step forward to your left, passing the open archway in front of you. Now, turn slightly to the right. You'll see a round rug in front of a closed brown door. Take a step forward to the left side of that round rug. Now, you'll see a brown dining table on your left and the round rug to your right. Turn slightly to the right. Hop over the round rug, towards the open entrance. Now, you're at the entrance to this study room. This study room has a brown desk, a brown chair and a brown armchair. Take a step forward to the right side of the brown desk with the computer on it. Turn slightly to the left. Take a step forward in between the two brown chairs against the wall. Once you're standing right in front of the flat screen TV with the brown desk behind you, you're done.

120992.instruction: Now you are in a ward room go out of the room through the opened brown door in front of you then turn to your right you will see a mirror mounted on the wall and a wash basin, go near the wash basin and then turn to your right again go two steps forward and then turn to your left there is an opened brown door in front of you pass through the door you will see walk way in front of you enter the walk way and this is your final destination.

120993.instruction: You are facing towards the wall and there is an iron box in front of you, slightly turn right, there is an open door in front of you, go straight and exit the door, now you are in the washroom, slightly turn right, there is a mirror and washbasin in front of you, go straight, now you are in front of the mirror, turn right, go straight, slightly turn left, go straight, there is an open door in front of you, go straight and exit the door, slightly turn right, go straight, there is a railing in front of you and stop in front of the railing, this is your final destination.

121015.instruction: Now you are standing in the middle of the stairs facing towards the glass window, now turn slightly right and walk down the stairs completely till the floor. Now take immediate right turn so that you can see washbasin on your left side and gas stove on your right side, walk until you find a closed white colour window in front of you, from there take left turn and walk little steps, here you reach your final destination.

121016.instruction: You are standing in middle of the stairs, turn right and get down the stairs, after going downstairs completely turn right and go forward, turn left and go one step forward, here just beside a book which is on the cabinet you have reached the destination.

121051.instruction: So you'll be in a small room with a large window, with a statue of a man riding a bicycle. Turn around and make a left towards the stair case. From the stair case you're going to head past the staircase towards a glass dining table. To the left of the table will be an open entrance. Head towards here. Head into this room. Head out of the room. Once you've turned around head to a brown couch at the end of the room. Take a left and head into the kitchen area. Make a right and head past the stove, and you've arrived.

121094.instruction: You are facing towards a black stand that has some books kept on it. Turn right and walk towards the two chairs. Turn left and exit the room through the open brown door. Turn right. There is a bed towards your right side. Walk straight and exit the room through the open brown door. Walk two steps ahead till you reach the arch in the front. There is an open brown door towards your right side and left side. Stand in front of the arch. You have reached your point.

121095.instruction: You are facing towards a chair, slightly turn right and move towards the opened door, now you are facing towards two chairs, slightly turn left and move a bit forward towards the round table which is infront of you, slightly turn right, you can find three rooms, move towards the second room, now you are at the entrance of the room, move a bit forward, where you can find an opened door on your right and left, that would be your end point.

121143.instruction: Now you are standing on the steps, turn back and climb all the steps, now take left, again take left, you can see a stair case to your left side, climb the stair case and stand on the fourth step from the top, that is your end point.

121144.instruction: You are on the stairs right now, go up the stairs, slightly turn to your left and move forward, turn to your left, you can find another stair case, go up the stairs, stand on the fifteenth step, that would be your end point.

121210.instruction: Slightly turn back there is a chair in front of you, Go straight till you find an entrance to a room, there is an entrance to a room at left side enter into it, walk straight you will find a sofa at left side, go straight from there you will find a table in the middle and a sofa in front, go straight from there and take left there is an entrance at the left and a room in front, just go straight till you find a room its a bedroom enter into it and take left, go straight till you find a chair at the right side, at the back of the chair you will find an entrance to another room, enter into it and turn right and go straight, walk five steps ahead you will find your destination.

121211.instruction: You are facing towards a cactus plant, turn around and walk towards the open entrance of the house. Slightly turn left and walk towards the bedroom opposite to you, enter into the bedroom and walk towards your left, there is a glass wall on your left, slightly turn right and walk towards the purple chair. You are now facing towards a narrow path, take a few steps ahead till you reach a vase, slightly turn right, you can see several cupboards, walk towards the second cupboard and stand facing towards it. You have reached your destination.

121299.instruction: Right now you're on the staircase facing the wall. Now turn left and get down the stairs and it will be your end point.

121300.instruction: Now you are facing towards a wall, you can see ladder to your right, slightly turn to your left, now you are standing in-front of a wall, that's your end point.

121301.instruction: You're going to start facing a rock wall and big green vase. We're going to turn to our right. We should now see a big room with desks. We're going to take a right between the two desks, that we have in front, and work towards the desk with the orange chairs. 121314.instruction: You're facing towrads two ash color stools, walk few steps forward, and slightly turn to your right from the two resting chairs, you can see few steps climb the steps, walk through the narrow path beside the swimming pool, now slighlty turn to your left, you can see an open entrance near the ash sofa, walk behind the sofa and towards your right you can see an open glass door, enter the door you can see white curtain towrads your right, walk straight till the couch, from the couch turn to your left, now you can see black dining table towards your right, from there slighlty turn to your left, walk straight, towards your left you can see an open wooden door, enter the door and stand in front of a single couch and that is your final destination.

121338.instruction: You begin looking at a plane white wall. Turn to your left, you'll realize you're on some stairs. Once you're at the top of the stairs continue forward through the double doors, into a kitchen type area. 121370.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a pillar, slightly turn left and move forward on the carpet and turn right and walk straight o the carpet and you can see two open door in front of you, enter into the left side door, walk straight and slightly turn left and you can see three chairs beside the couch. Walk forward towards the chairs and this is your final point.

121371.instruction: You are facing towards the pillar, turn left and move forward. Turn right and move towards the staircase near the pillar. Turn slight left and move towards the sofa. You are standing in front of the sofa and facing towards the glass window, which is your final destination.

121389.instruction: You are on the stairs, facing towards the wall. Turn right, climb the steps, and stand at the seventh step, this is your end point.

121390.instruction: You are standing on the staircase facing towards the wall. Take a slight right, climb few staircase. You have reached your destination.

121399.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a table. Now slightly turn right and move towards the chair which is in front of the table.
