121400.instruction: Opposite to you, you have three chair couches and a table. Walk straight, take a right. You can see an open door, exit the room. Take a left turn and walk straight. This is the end point.

121501.instruction: You will begin facing a white wall and a window, turn to your left , you will see that you're standing on a staircase, behind you there should be a staircase going up, leading to a very tall mirror, take 2 steps to go up the staircase, and then turn to your right, you will see that there is a very abstract painting, take a step towards the painting, you should now be standing in the middle of a hallway, looking at the painting slightly to the right, behind you should be another hallway, you are done.

121559.instruction: Right now you're at the entrance of a bedroom facing a door and a bed in the left. Now turn right and you can see a small walkway and a opened door in the right, move towards the entrance of the opened door, now take a right turn and enter the room. You can again see a opened door in the right and move towards the opening and enter the other room. You can see a portrait on the left and a mirror in front of you and a bed on the right. Move towards the chair in the left and all the move towards the mirror in front of you, and stand in front of the mirror and it will be your end point.

121560.instruction: You are at the entrance of a bedroom facing towards the edge of the door. Turn right and exit the room. Turn right and walk through the open door. Now you have another open door on your right side. So walk through it. You are now at the entrance of a bedroom. Walk straightly towards the mirror that is in between the two windows. Now you are standing near the mirror. So that will be the end point.

121576.instruction: You are standing just beside the washbasin, turn to your right. You will find an open door in-front of you. Enter into that door, you will be landed outside the room. Right now you are in-front of a swing and black colour sitting architect. From there turn to your left, you can see large number of tables and chairs in-front of you, and on your left side you can see wooden pillars. Go and stand in-front of the first wooden pillar. You have reached your destination.

121577.instruction: You are standing a washroom, facing towards the wall with tissue paper holder on it, turn right, in-front of you there is an open door, walk to the open door, Exit the washroom, in-front of you there is an entrance, walk through the entrance, slightly turn right, in-front of you there are multiple dinning tables, walk to the dinning table which is beside the glass door, slightly turn right, in-front of you there is a glass door, walk to the glass door and exit the room, turn left, in-front of you there is a black bench, walk to the bench, to the left you can see a green glass door, stand in-front of the glass door, that's your end point.

121641.instruction: You are facing the wall. Turn right and get down through the stairs. At the fourth step, turn slightly left and move towards the wall, then turn left and walk straight, and take the next right wherein there is a open door. Move forward, you are facing the shower room. Turn slightly right and move forward and stop facing towards the toilet seat, and this is your end point.

121642.instruction: You are standing on the staircase facing toward the wall. Take slight right and climb down the stair case. You will find your self in front of a wall where there are two photo frame hanged. Onto your right side there is white color door which is open. Take a slight left where you can find white color cupboards. Now take a slight left turn, where you can see a corridor. Walk through the corridor, till you find three different directions. Now a take a slight right turn where you can see a mirror and a stool near that. Take few steps towards the mirror and take a slight left. You can see another room with a toilet seat. Step inside the room, you have reached your destination.

121647.instruction: Starting facing the living room with cow hide squares and a coffee table in front of us, we are `going to turn to the left so we can face the kitchen. And two blue armchairs. We're going to walk between the floor lamp and the side table, into the kitchen. Walking through the kitchen with the counter top to the left and the breakfast nook and dinning to the right, we're going to continue through, until we reach the pantry at the end. Come to a stop in the pantry. The pantry has a couple cups and various other things. And this is where we stop.

121706.instruction: Facing the graffiti wall, turn to your left, and walk down the hall with the graffiti wall keeping the graffiti wall on your right. Take the first doorway on your right and walk up the black chair in the office. The room is 366, you're done.

121765.instruction: You will start by standing on the left side of the bed. Turn to your left and you will see the balcony. Go through the sliding doors and walk to the right side of the for wooden chairs. Stand on the foot of the sunbathing chair. Now walk towards the foot of the other sunbathing chair. Once you're there, turn to your right and go back inside the house on the left side of the sliding doors. Once you're inside, you will see a couch on your left and a coffee table. Walk towards the desk, closer to the TV. Once you're in the middle of the couch and the TV, take another step towards the plant with white flowers. Once you're in between the counter with drinks on it and the other table with the telephone. You are on your destination.

121935.instruction: You're in a bathroom, to your left you'll see a bathtub to your right you'll see a room with a sink and a toilet. If you look to your left you'll see a bedroom. Walk outside into this bedroom. In front of you you'll a see brown shelf and to the right looks like a closet. You can see the front of the mattress to the left. Take one step towards the shelf. Once you're in front of the shelf you've reached the end.

122018.instruction: You are standing facing towards the door. Turn right and walk straight till you reach the chair towards your left. Slightly turn left and walk a few steps ahead. Turn right. Walk straight and turn left. You are now standing at the entrance of the bedroom. Enter into the bedroom. Walk a few steps ahead and enter into the open brown door in front of you. Stand at the entrance of the washroom. You have reached your point.

122019.instruction: You are now facing towards a closed glass door, turn to your right and move forward. Can see a fireplace on your right side, take a slight left and move forward into the walkway. Now turn right and move forward and enter the second room on your left. This is a bedroom and you can see another open door right in front of you. Take a few more steps and pass through the door. You are now standing facing towards a shower area and on your left side you have a comot and this is your end point.

122257.instruction: You are in a bedroom facing towards the open door, turn slightly left and exit the bedroom. Now turn slightly right and you can see an open arch, enter through it. Turn slightly left and move forward towards the portrait on the wall. Now turn around and you can see a staircase, get down the steps and turn slightly left, you can see an open door. Move towards the door and enter through it. Now turn slightly left and move forward towards the centre table. Turn slightly right and you can see a small table, move towards the table. You are now facing towards a round table with some chairs and this is your end point.

122258.instruction: You're in a bedroom, standing beside the door, go few steps forward, and exit the room, then turn right, go straight near the wall, on the top you'll find frame, turn right, you'll find stairs, get down the stairs, you'll find red, and cream carpet on the ground, from there turn left, and go straight, you'll enter the living room, go near the door, to the right you'll find table, and chairs, one step away from the chair, and to the right of the door you'll find your destination.

122287.instruction: We start off looking  at a picture frame. Turn to the right and go down the stairs. At the bottom of the stairs we will go into the room that is directly in front of us. It is to the right of the painting on the wall. Go in this room and step beside the desk. Then turn around and exit this room. Walk across the hallway to the closed room. Then turn left walking to the end of the hallway that has the three photos. Actually, before you get to the end with the three photos you will notice a cabinet with a mini fridge on your left hand side. You will want to stop outside of the...maybe it’s a dishwasher. That is your final destination.

122369.instruction: From the back corner of the elevator, turn left and exit the elevator. Make a left turn to proceed into the hallway. Continue down the hallway passing an open room to the right. Continue straight ahead and turn left to take 5 steps up the stairs and turn back around. When you go back down the stairs, veer to the left to walk into the living room. In the right corner of the living is gonna be a zebra print chair. Walk just past that chair and walk to the right to enter into the bathroom. When you're standing in the middle of the bathroom, in front of the sink and the mirror, this is gonna be your destination.

122386.instruction: You are on stairs facing a statue. Walk towards the statue. Then take left and walk all the way to the top of the stairs. Once you reach the top of the stairs, there is a mirror hanging to the wall and there are two rooms to either side of it. So now slightly turn left and enter the room with the bed. Now exactly at the entrance of that room is the end point.

122387.instruction: Right now you are on the stairs going upward direction. Go through the stairs. There is a statue on the corner. Once you reach upwards, take a left from the stairs. Now pass through the sofa chair and again take a left from here. Now you can see stairs in the upward direction. Pass through the stairs going upward. Take left from the stairs and go straight and there is a door which is the entrance of the room and that is your final destination and stop.

122395.instruction: Right now you are in front of the curtain, now turn back, on the left side, you will find table with chairs, on the right side, you will find window, now walk in between them, there you will find three chairs, now turn right, and go straight, and again turn left, there you will find stair case, walk all the way to the top of the stairs, now turn left, and go straight, again turn right, and keep moving forward, now enter into the room which is in front of you, there you will find table with two chairs, and in front of the table, you will find portrait on the wall, go near the portrait, and again step out of the room, and enter into the left side room, there you will find bed, now go near the bed, and turn left, you will find a frame on the wall, go and stand in front of the frame, that will be your final destination.

122396.instruction: Okay, now you are in a room facing towards the curtain. Take sharp left and walk straight passing the dining table on the left side, until you reach the first bar stool. Now turn right and move straight towards the fourth bar stool, which is on the left. Now slightly turn to your left and move forward, now you are in front of a staircase. Walk all the way up through the stairs, until you reach in front of a wall with portraits on it. Slightly turn to your left and move forward. Now in front of you there is an open entrance, walk straight towards that open entrance. Now you are standing next to a portrait, which is on the left side. Turn to your right and in front of you there is path, walk all the way straight through the path passing the cupboard on the left side, until you reach another room. Now slightly turn to your left and in front of you there is a table and a portrait behind the table, go straight and stand behind the table. Now you are standing behind the table. Turn behind, now in front of you there is a glass open door outside this room, go straight towards the glass open door. Now you are at the entrance of the room facing towards the glass door. Turn to your left and move towards the bed, now you are standing in front of the bed. Turn to your left and move forward, now you are standing in front of a photo frame and that is the end point.

122477.instruction: You begin by facing a small alcove that includes a shower. If you turn to the left,you're going to find yourself inside a home. Directly ahead of you, you will see a long hallway that branches off into several doorways on either side. Even further to the left than that is another section of the house. Ignoring that, walk forward through the door directly in front of you into the hallway and you're going to make your way to the first turn on the right. Now this is going to be marked by a beige wall with a white light switch. Once you turn here, make your way through the black-framed door into what looks to be a kitchen area. On the right side you have a table surrounded by white chairs with a chandelier and on the left side you have a gate with a white table and a small animal statue on top. Walk straight ahead past this tabe with the statue through the black-framed door directly in front of you. Now you'll find yourself in a small area that branches off both to the left and to the right. Directly in front of you there will be a white portion of the wall. Walk up to this white portion of the wall and you are done.

122577.instruction: You are facing the wall. Turn slightly right and climb up the stairs. Move forward into the open door room, walk straight. To your right there are some beds, move forward until you face the brown colour wall. Turn slightly right and enter into the bathroom and stop facing the toilet seat, and this is your end point.

122578.instruction: Now you are at the staircase facing the wall. Turn right and walk all along the staircase. Now move straight and enter into the living area through the door. Now move straight and enter into the bedroom. Now move straight in between the bed and the wooden wall. Now turn right and enter into the small washroom. Now stand at the entrance of the washroom near to the commode which is the endpoint.

122602.instruction: We are facing a bathroom. Turn lft. Go out in the hall. Now we are facing a room with two green chairs and a table on a square carpet.  Walk into that room.  Walk behind the second green chair and on the wooden floor. You are at your destination. Yes, to the right are two wood boxes on a white dresser and a plant and to your left in the second green chair.

122606.instruction: You're facing towards the sofa, now turn to your left, go near the lamp and turn to your right, you can find stairs climb up the stairs, after climbing up the stairs, slightly turn to your right, you can see a pool table, pass through the table, you can see stairs at your left, climb up the stairs and stop near the third last step.

122607.instruction: Right now you are in front of the sofa. Now turn left and go straight. Now turn right and go straight. You will find stair case. Now walk to the to the top of the stairs. Now slightly turn right and go straight near the chair. Now go straight. On the right side you will find pool table. Now keep moving forward till you reach the glass window. Now turn left. You will find stair case. Now walk to the top of the stairs and stand on the third step from the top. That will be your final destination.

122651.instruction: You are standing in the washroom facing towards the entrance of the washroom. Slightly turn left. Walk a few steps ahead and exit the washroom. You are now standing facing towards the brown cupboard in front of you. Walk till the cupboard. Turn left. Walk a few steps till you reach the bed in front of you. Slightly turn right. You are now standing facing towards a chair in front of you. Walk a few steps ahead till you reach the glass door behind the chair. Exit the room through the glass door. Walk a few steps ahead. You are now standing in between two chairs. Turn left. You are now standing facing towards four chairs and a table in front of you. Walk straight till the corner and stand near the chair. You have reached your point.

122652.instruction: Okay, so you are in the washroom, exit the room from the open door. Move forward, take a left turn and walk towards the bed. Take a slight right turn and walk straight. Now you are closer to the curtains which are on the left. Move forward to the chair and take a left turn. Exit the glass door,  take a left turn and walk straight. Stand beside the round table with chairs. This is the end point.

122800.instruction: You begin looking into a grand room with a gigantic chandelier overhead and a marble and gold table just ahead of you. Do not turn at all, just go straight forward until the first major right turn of the red carpet, the one that's unavoidable. Instead of turning there, jump over the velvet ropes to your left and onto the... Or, sorry, directly to the other side of the wooden circular table in the middle of this new room. Once you're on the other side of this wooden table, with a couch and five chairs right next to you, you're done... Six chairs if you count the chair on the other side of the couch. But there's five of- five chairs in a row, a couch, and one more chair. You should be in the corner of the first row of chairs, and the couch. Then you're done. You're done!

122844.instruction: Slightly turn right from the place you are standing. You will find an open door. Now go near the open door. Now slightly turn right and exit from the door. Now on the right side you will find kitchen area. Now turn around. You will find five rooms. Now enter into the second room and stand at the right corner of the room. That will be your final destination.

122845.instruction: You are facing the corner of a wooden room. Turn right and move towards the exit door to the room. Turn slightly right and move towards the dining table on the right. Turn slightly left and walk towards the wooden wall which is right side of the brown door and that is your final point.

123027.instruction: Your standing in a washroom at the entrance, facing towards a bedroom, now exit the washroom, in-front of you you can see a bed, turn to your right, in-front of you there is an another open door, walk to the open door and exit the room. Now turn to your left, you can see a staircase on your right, go to the staircase, turn back. You can see a bed, walk to the bed, now turn left, you can see a narrow path, walk to the narrow path and in-front of you there is an another open door, walk through the open door and enter the room,now your in a washroom, that's the end point.

123028.instruction: You are in the washroom right now, exit the washroom, you can find a bed over there, turn right and exit the bedroom, turn left, you can find stairs over there, go near the stairs, turn around, walk through the corridor which is left to the stairs where you can find a book shelf to your left and portraits, walk all the way to the bedroom which is to your straight, enter the bedroom, to your left there is a washroom, enter the washroom, stand infront of the door, that would be your final destination.

123078.instruction: You begin facing a hallway, proceed down this hallway, you will pass a very big arch on your right, after you pass that arch, enter the first door on the right, and then once you're standing in front of the toilet, you are done.

123180.instruction: You're going to start off in a bedroom facing a recess with some glass vases with some sakura branches in it.
